izzyondroid:be.cuypers_ghys.gaai.name: Gaai
izzyondroid:be.cuypers_ghys.gaai.summary: Android app for Powerdale Nexxtender Home/Mobile chargers
izzyondroid:be.cuypers_ghys.gaai.description:
The goal of this app is to control the Nexxtender Home and Nexxtender Mobile charger without requiring the Android Nexxtmove app. The Android Nexxtmove app is the official app for controlling the Nexxtender chargers and for syncing billing information to the Nexxtmove.me website for refunding. Both the Nexxtmove app and the Nexxtmove.me website require a username and password to login. Without it, it is impossible to use the Nexxtmove app and therefore impossible to operate the Nexxtender Home charger, which has no UI or input device on its own. If you no longer have a valid username and password for the Nexxtmove app, using Gaai is an option.
 Features: 
 Only requires to install Gaai.
 No additional hardware required.
 No www.Nexxtmove.me account required.
 Connects over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to the Nexxtender Home or Nexxtender Mobile.
 Finds and connects to the device based on its PN and SN. No MAC required.
 Shows real time data from the Nexxtender Home or Nexxtender Mobile: device information, charging status, current, power consumption, ...
 Allows to control the Nexxtender Home: start and stop the charger in ECO or MAX mode, sync the time with the mobile phone.
 Allows to configure the Nexxtender Home: default charging mode, max grid and max device current, off-peak hours.
 Management of badges (add, delete).
 Remembers the PN and SN of multiple devices.

izzyondroid:com.hhvvg.ecm.name: ExtClipboardManager
izzyondroid:com.hhvvg.ecm.description:
ExtClipboardManager is an enhanced clipboard manager. It is to inject the code when ClipboardService starts, and intercept and mark the key methods such as setPrimaryClip before or after they are executed.
 Features: 
 Timeout auto-clear clipboard: customizable time setting in seconds
 provide application whitelist and blacklist mode: whitelist mode in the whitelist application will not trigger the clear clipboard operation; blacklist mode in the blacklist application will trigger the clear clipboard operation
 Text exclusion function: text matching the rules will not be automatically cleared
 Caution: 
 Remember to check the system frame
 Input method may read the content of the clipboard several times after cutting, whitelist mode is recommended to add the input method to the whitelist, otherwise the number of times read is easily exhausted by the input method.
 In some cases, getPrimaryClip will not be triggered to read the clipboard, but the application can still read the clipboard, you may need to look at the source code to know what the reason is.
 Currently (probably) only available for Android 12+

TorrentSearch is a modern Android app that lets you search torrents across multiple providers simultaneously.

izzyondroid:dev.entropy.name: Entropy
izzyondroid:dev.entropy.summary: A offline, secure password generator with exact entropy bits measurement.
izzyondroid:dev.entropy.description:
Entropy is an open-source, fully offline password generator built for security-conscious users who want complete control over their credential strength.
 Instead of arbitrary password ratings, Entropy calculates and displays the exact mathematical entropy (in bits) of your generated passwords based on character pool dynamics.
 Key Features:
 Exact Entropy Calculation: See precise bit strength metrics updated in real-time.
 Fully Offline & Secure: No internet permission required. Your passwords never leave your device.
 Anti-Snoop Protection: Includes FLAG_SECURE window integration to block screenshots and hide app previews in the Android recents switcher.
 Customizable Character Sets: Toggle uppercase, lowercase, digits, special symbols, and exclude visually ambiguous characters (like 1, l, O, 0).
 Modern Material 3 UI: Clean, responsive layout with native Dark Mode support and Jetpack Compose architecture.
 Fast Copy: One-tap action to quickly copy generated credentials to your clipboard.
 Entropy is built with zero telemetry, zero analytics, and zero external network calls.

izzyondroid:eu.darken.myperm.name: Permission Pilot
izzyondroid:eu.darken.myperm.description:
Permission Pilot is a new kind of app to help you review apps and their permissions.
 With each Android update permissions are getting more complex. Android showing permissions in various different locations, doesn't make it easier to review them:
 App Info page
 Special Access
 Permissions Manager
 and more...
 Permission Pilot lists all permissions in a single location, giving you a bird's eye view of app permissions.
 Two perspectives are available: You can either view all permissions an app requests, or view all apps that request a permission.
 Apps tab All installed apps, including system apps and work profile apps. Clicking on any app will list all permissions that the app has requested, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access, along with their status. This will also include internet permissions, SharedUserID status!
 Permissions tab All permissions that exist on your device, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access. Permissions are pre-grouped for easier navigation, e.g. Contacts, Microphone, Camera, etc. Clicking on a permission shows all the apps that request access to that permission.
 Apps and permissions can be searched using free-text, sorted and filtered by different criteria.
 Overview A summary dashboard showing app counts by category — privacy, security, install source, and more. Each category row navigates directly to a filtered app list.
 Permission Watcher Get notified when an app update adds new permissions or changes existing ones. Permission Watcher checks your apps after each update and creates a report if anything changed.
 Data Export Export app or permission data in Markdown, CSV, or JSON.
 Manifest Viewer Browse raw app manifests with searchable, categorized sections. See which apps can discover other installed apps.

fdroid:app.pwhs.blockads.name: BlockAds: Clean Internet
fdroid:app.pwhs.blockads.summary: Block ads & trackers system-wide. Firewall, SafeSearch, profiles
fdroid:app.pwhs.blockads.description:
Tired of intrusive ads slowing down your phone?
BlockAds blocks ads across all your apps and browsers with just one tap — no root required.
 KEY FEATURES 
- System-Wide Ad Blocking: Smart DNS-based filtering for every app and browser. No root access required.
- Privacy Protection: Blocks trackers and spyware. Zero data collection — everything stays locally on your device.
- App Firewall & Profiles: Block internet access for specific apps (Wi-Fi/Mobile). Switch instantly between Default, Strict, Family, and Gaming profiles.
- Parental Controls: Enforce SafeSearch (Google/Bing) and YouTube Restricted Mode via Family-safe DNS providers.
- Detailed Statistics: View real-time blocked ad counters, 24-hour activity charts, and detailed DNS query logs.
- Fully Customizable: Add custom filter lists via URL (ABPVN, AdGuard, EasyList, etc.), create allow/block rules, and use custom DoH/DoT encrypted DNS.
- Modern UI: Material 3 design built with Jetpack Compose. Features Dark/Light themes, custom accent colors, Quick Settings tile, and Home screen widgets.
- Backup & Restore: Export your configuration to JSON and easily import it on a new device.
- Battery & Data Friendly: Minimal performance impact. Filters only DNS traffic, reducing unnecessary ad data downloads.
 HOW TO USE 
- Open BlockAds.
- Tap the power button and allow the VPN connection.
- Enjoy an ad-free internet experience! (You can also toggle protection via Quick Settings tile or widget).
 FAQ 
- Is BlockAds safe? 
Yes. BlockAds only filters DNS queries locally. No personal data is intercepted or transmitted to external servers.
- Why does it need VPN permission? 
It creates a local VPN tunnel on your device to route and filter DNS requests on-device. It is not a remote VPN service.
- Does it work with all apps? 
Yes, it works system-wide. You can also whitelist specific apps or use the firewall feature to manage access.
- Is it really free? 
Yes! BlockAds is 100% free, open-source, and contains no in-app purchases or ads.
- Will it slow down my internet? 
No. DNS filtering is extremely lightweight. It actually speeds up your browsing and saves battery by preventing ads from loading.
BlockAds is free, open source, and built with privacy in mind. Download now and take back control of your Android experience!

fdroid:ca.leradar.app.name: LE-RADAR
fdroid:ca.leradar.app.summary: Québec student newspapers, campus radio and sports, all in one place
fdroid:ca.leradar.app.description:
LE-RADAR gathers student newspapers, campus radio and sports from Québec cégeps and universities.
The app is for discovery and for a list kept on the device. It does not replace the publications. The full article opens on the outlet that wrote it, in the system browser, with that outlet’s name on the button.
• Follow a paper, a region or a keyword
• Hide a source
• Save a card and revisit recently opened articles
• Read the last loaded feed offline
• Share the original article or the LE-RADAR card
• Listen to a campus station when an HTTPS stream is available
Some feed items are in English and are marked EN.
Network use: on each start the app downloads the current feed, the source list and the radio list from https://le-radar.ca/. While a station plays, it also fetches what is on air from https://le-radar.ca/radio-nowplaying.json. If that fails, it uses the copy bundled in the app. Card images load from each outlet’s own website, and radio audio streams directly from the station.
No account. No ads. Follows and favorites stay on the device and can be erased in Settings.
The interface language menu is the same as on https://le-radar.ca/ : French, English, and the other languages offered there. Original keeps each article in the language it was written in. Known interface phrases are translated on the device. Other phrases use the LE-RADAR translation cache and the same public translation services as the website.
LE-RADAR means Le Réseau Académique de Découverte et d’Agrégation de Ressources. The website https://le-radar.ca/ stays available on its own.

fdroid:com.cocode.babakplayer.name: BabakPlayer
fdroid:com.cocode.babakplayer.summary: Plays shared media parts back in order, as one continuous playlist
fdroid:com.cocode.babakplayer.description:
BabakPlayer is a companion app for BabakCast. It imports media parts shared from other apps, such as WhatsApp, and plays them back in the order they were received, as one continuous playlist.
It supports common audio and video formats, including mp3, mp4, mkv, mov, and webm. If a file fails to decode, it is marked as failed and skipped so playback continues with the rest of the queue.
The interface is available in English and Persian, with the Persian layout running right-to-left automatically.
All imported files are stored locally in app-private storage. Deleting a file or playlist removes the underlying files permanently. The app works entirely offline, with no account, cloud sync, or backend service.

fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.name: DozeOff
fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.summary: Fix delayed notifications. Stop Android Doze from holding back your alerts.
fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.description:
Are your notifications arriving late, or not at all? You're not alone.
Android uses a system called Doze to save battery by putting your phone to sleep when you're not using it. The problem is that Doze also holds back notifications. Messages, emails, smart home and security camera alerts, and delivery updates can all sit waiting until you next pick up your phone.
DozeOff fixes that, and it gives you two ways to do it.
MAX MODE
Max stops your device entering Doze sleep in the first place. It does the best job of getting notifications from all your apps through on time.
The trade-off is that some devices will show a small alarm icon in the status bar, and may show a time on your lock screen. You will never hear an alarm. Whether the icon appears depends entirely on your phone, and many devices never show it at all. It isn't something DozeOff can turn off.
BALANCED MODE
Balanced lets your device sleep normally, then briefly wakes it at an interval you choose. Each wake pulls your phone out of Doze for long enough for pending notifications from every app to come through.
Nothing appears in your status bar or on your lock screen. The trade-off is timing: a notification arriving just after a wake waits for the next one.
Max is the default. Switch to Balanced any time from the home screen.
ALSO INCLUDED
* Pauses automatically during Do Not Disturb and Bedtime Mode, so it never interferes with your sleep settings
* Setup guidance for Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo, ASUS, Nokia and other manufacturers with aggressive battery management
* Adjustable wake interval in Balanced mode
* Simple one-time setup, then it runs quietly in the background
* Survives reboots and app updates
GOOD FOR
* Messaging apps
* Smart home and security camera alerts
* Email and calendar reminders
* Delivery and rideshare tracking
* Anything where a late notification is a problem
PRIVACY
This build requests no network permissions at all. DozeOff cannot make a network connection, because it has no reason to. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no account.

apple-macos:6798778906.name: ENYO Timer: Interval & Workout
apple-macos:6798778906.description:
A clean, practical workout timer for anyone who trains.
Intervals, rounds and rest — set in seconds, and big enough to read from across the room. Ready-made timers for boxing, MMA, HIIT and yoga. Hundreds of workouts already written out. A log that fills itself.
No ads. No account.
EIGHT TIMERS
FOR TIME: counts up, with an optional time cap.
INTERVAL: work and rest, in as many sets as you like.
EMOM: every minute on the minute, with a movement for each minute.
AMRAP: as many rounds as possible, counting down.
TABATA: 20 seconds on, 10 off, 8 rounds, all adjustable.
DEATH BY: one more rep every minute, until you can't.
FIGHT GONE BAD: stations, work and rest, set by set.
STOPWATCH: a plain clock, counting up.
BUILD YOUR OWN, AND KEEP IT
Every timer has its own page. Set the rounds, the work and the rest, name the movements, and press START. Save the ones you come back to and they are waiting on the home screen — and on your watch.
READY-MADE, BY SPORT
Boxing and MMA rounds on the bell. HIIT and Tabata ratios. Yoga holds with the transitions between them. Open one and press play; there is nothing to set up.
THE WORKOUTS, WRITTEN OUT
Sixty classic benchmarks — The Girls and The Heroes, from Fran and Cindy to Murph — with their time caps and movements already in. Thirty more for Halloween and twenty set on South Beach. Pick one and run it.
BUILT TO BE READ ACROSS THE ROOM
The screen fills with the time, the phase and the movement by name, inside a glowing aura that changes colour as work turns to rest. Light or dark, whichever you prefer. Turn the phone on its side and it splits in two: the clock on one half, the round on the other.
CUES YOU CAN HEAR
Beeps on 3-2-1 into every interval, a long tone into work, a lower one into rest, and a triple at the end. They mix with your music instead of turning it down, and they keep going when the screen locks — on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
A LOG THAT FILLS ITSELF
Every workout you finish lands in your log, on a month calendar. Nothing to write down, nothing scored, no streak to keep up. Swipe a row to tick it off or delete it. Your history syncs through your own iCloud, and finished workouts can be saved to Apple Health.
ON EVERY SCREEN YOU OWN
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, with the same timers and the same log on each. Connect a TV by cable or AirPlay and the clock fills the big screen while your phone keeps the controls.
PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Anonymous usage statistics show us which timers get used, and they cannot identify you. Your workout history stays in your own iCloud, which we cannot read.
EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Every timer, every workout, the log, iCloud sync and Apple Health are included. There is an optional tip in Settings, and it unlocks nothing.
Privacy Policy: https://enyotechnologies-timer.netlify.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6770082936.name: Tempo Calendar: Daily Planner
apple-macos:6770082936.description:
Tempo. A calendar in tune with your day.
Tempo is a clean, lightweight calendar designed to make everyday actions quick and easy.
We focus on a natural feel over flashy features, an at-a-glance view over complicated settings, and a clean interface.
- A minimal layout that’s easy to read
- Seamless integration with Apple Calendar
- Automatic iCloud sync
Key features
[Full Apple Calendar integration]
Tempo lets you view and edit events from every account connected to your device’s system calendar, including iCloud, Google, and Naver. There’s no need to move your data or create a new account.
[Automatic iCloud sync]
Events added on your iPhone automatically appear on your iPad and Mac. Events sync through your connected calendar accounts, while individual event colors, date ranges, and other details set in Tempo sync through iCloud.
Add an appointment on your iPhone during your commute, then organize your schedule on your Mac at the office. Switch devices and pick up with the same events, without any extra steps.
[Monthly and weekly Home Screen widgets]
Add a large monthly calendar widget to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen. See a whole month of events at once, switch months, and add events right from the widget. Tap a date to open that day in your calendar.
[Lock Screen widgets]
Check a two-week calendar that includes today, or see upcoming events, right from your iPhone Lock Screen. Spot the days with plans or view up to three upcoming events to get a quick sense of your day without opening the app.
[Custom colors for individual events]
While the system calendar assigns colors by calendar, Tempo lets you choose a color for each event.
Use red for important meetings, yellow for family plans, and green for study time to see what matters at a glance.
[Date range highlights]
Outline multi-day periods such as time off, business trips, vacations, or exams with a visual border on your calendar. Unlike a regular event entry, this makes the entire date range easy to see at a glance.
[30-day event recovery]
Accidentally deleted an event? Don’t worry. Tempo safely keeps snapshots of deleted events for 30 days. Bring them back at any time during that period from "Restore events" in Settings.
[Notifications and quick access]
Get notified at the time you choose so you don’t miss an important appointment. Tap a notification to go straight to the event. Tempo integrates smoothly with Apple’s notification system for a simple, familiar experience.
[Event search]
Quickly find events by title. Search ignores differences in case and diacritics, so even part of a word can help you find a matching event.
What Tempo stands for
[Smooth interactions]
Every interaction should feel instant. Tempo focuses on natural, lightweight responses rather than heavy animations or complicated screen transitions.
[Minimal design]
Essential information is clear, and unnecessary elements are left out. By reducing visual clutter, Tempo helps you focus on your events.
[At home in the Apple ecosystem]
Tempo follows the design language of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. It makes natural use of Apple’s built-in calendar, notifications, widgets, iCloud, and more.
On the move or at your desk, keep your day flowing with Tempo.
Tempo. A calendar in tune with your day.

fedora-packages:bcd/bcd.description: BCD allows to denoise images rendered with Monte Carlo path tracing and provided in the form of their samples statistics (average, distribution and covariance of per-pixel color samples). BCD can run in CPU (e.g., renderfarm) or GPU (e.g., desktop) mode. It can be integrated as a library to any Monte Carlo renderer, using the provided sample accumulator to interface the Monte Carlo simulation with the BCD internals, and comes with a graphics user interface for designing interactively the denoising parameters, which can be saved in JSON format and later reused in batch. BCD has been designed for easy integration and low invasiveness in the host renderer, in a high spp context (production rendering). There are at least three ways to integrate BCD in a rendering pipeline, by either: * Dumping all samples in a raw file, using the raw2bcd tool to generate the rendering statistics from this file and then running the BCD using the CLI tool. * Exporting the mandatory statistics from the rendering loop in EXR format and running the BCD CLI tool to obtain a denoised image. * Directly integrating the BCD library into the renderer, using the sample accumulator to post samples to BCD during the path tracing and denoising the accumulated values after rendering using the library.

fedora-packages:cvs/cvs.name: cvs
fedora-packages:cvs/cvs.description: CVS (Concurrent Versions System) is a version control system that can record the history of your files (usually, but not always, source code). CVS only stores the differences between versions, instead of every version of every file you have ever created. CVS also keeps a log of who, when, and why changes occurred. CVS is very helpful for managing releases and controlling the concurrent editing of source files among multiple authors. Instead of providing version control for a collection of files in a single directory, CVS provides version control for a hierarchical collection of directories consisting of revision controlled files. These directories and files can then be combined together to form a software release.

firefox-addons:2786203.name: ChatGPT Glarity - Summarize YouTube & Translate
firefox-addons:2786203.summary: Summarize YouTube videos and translate web pages using ChatGPT (Free and Ad-Free)
firefox-addons:2786203.description:
💡Glarity - Summary for Google search results / YouTube videos with ChatGPT (AD-Free)
This is an open-source extension that uses the power of ChatGPT to generate summaries of web page content, including Google search results, YouTube videos, and other web pages.
With Glarity, you can quickly and easily digest the most important information from Google &YouTube.
Source code: https://github.com/sparticleinc/chatgpt-google-summary-extension 
Core Features:
⭐ YouTube Summaries:
✅ Generate video summaries in over 12 languages.
✅ Produce highlights with precise timestamps.
✅ Create FAQs for YouTube videos.
✅ Generate market-ready subtitles for YouTube content.
✅ Engage in interactive AI chats based on YouTube videos.
🔍 Google Summaries:
✅ Comprehensive search summaries that offer detailed explanations and answers.
✅ Cross-language search capabilities, enabling broader inquiry with AI assistance in evaluating relevance.
📄 Web Summaries:
✅ Summarize any webpage effortlessly.
✅ Converse with AI about web content, including custom prompts for extracting page-specific information.
📑 PDF Summaries:
✅ Create multilingual summaries for local PDF files.
✅ Interactively chat with PDF content using personalized prompts like "ask anything about this PDF."
✅ Extract and translate selected text from PDF documents.
🌐 Translation Services:
✅ Side-by-side translation for easy comparison of original and translated text.
✅ Four different translation engines: seamlessly switch between LLM Enhanced, LLM, Google, and Microsoft options.
✅ Customize translation prompts and areas for a richer translation experience.
✅ Bilingual subtitles for YouTube videos.
🖼️ Screenshot & AI Interaction:
✅ Translate text from screenshots and images into multiple languages.
✅ Capture the current browser tab and save it locally.
✅ Utilize AI for text translation, interpreting mathematical formulas, and answering questions presented in images.
✍️ Writing Assistant:
✅ Generate AI-assisted replies for Gmail.
✅ Rewrite web page content.
✅ Compose engaging posts for Twitter.
👍 ChatGPT Model Support:
✅ Switch effortlessly between ChatGPT 3.5 and ChatGPT 4.
✅ Interact with ChatGPT from any interface (hotkey: Ctrl+M).
👍 Claude.ai Model:
✅ Free access to the Claude WebApp without token consumption; simply sign up for a Claude account and authorize access to Claude.ai cookies for uninterrupted use.
✅ The Claude WebApp excels at summarizing extensive texts, delivering faster and more efficient results.
🌐List of websites supported by Glarity Summary Google search/ YouTube/ Yahoo! JAPAN News/ PubMed/ NewsPicks / Nikkei/ GitHub/ PubMed
More: https://blog.glarity.app/getting-started/user-guide/summary-list
📙--------------FAQ--------------
1. What is ChatGPT?
ChatGPT is a language model developed by OpenAI. It's a large, pre-trained Transformer-based neural network designed to generate human-like text in response to prompts provided by users. It has been trained on a diverse range of internet text and can respond to a wide range of topics, including general knowledge questions, conversational responses, and creative writing.
2. What is Glarity - Summary for Google/YouTube (ChatGPT)?
Glarity is an open-source extension that uses the power of ChatGPT to generate summaries of web page content, including Google search results, YouTube videos, and other web pages. With Glarity, you can quickly get the gist of some web page without having to read all the text.
3. Is Glarity - Summary for Google/YouTube (ChatGPT) free to use?
Yes, the extension is free to use.
4. Which websites are supported?
Currently, Glarity supports any webpages
5. Do I need a ChatGPT/OpenAI account?
No, you don't need an account. Glarity offers a mode that allows you to enjoy summaries from Google and YouTube without a ChatGPT/OpenAI account. However, if you do have one, you can choose the ChatGPT mode or OpenAI key mode, both of which are free and robust.
🔐 Privacy and Security
At Glarity, we prioritize your privacy. We have implemented strict measures to ensure that your data stays within your browser and is not shared with anyone. Our focus is on protecting your privacy, which is why we don't display ads or sell your data. We have put in place various online security measures to safeguard your information. Additionally, we don't store any of your web information on our servers. Glarity operates directly on your browser, ensuring that your data remains local.
Here are the specific types of data we handle:
1. Personally Identifiable Information:
If you decide to create an account with Glarity, we will securely transmit your username and password to our server for authentication purposes.
2. Web page data and prompts:
Glarity uses the GPT language model provided by OpenAI. When you interact with the AI through the extension, we only exchange data related to your actions, such as the prompts you provide and the content of the web pages you're browsing.
3. Anonymized extension usage statistics:
We collect anonymous usage statistics and monitor various metrics to analyze feature usage and identify any bugs or issues that need improvement. This helps us enhance the product and provide a better experience for our users.

firefox-addons:3037021.name: Ultrafill — Zoom Video to Fill
firefox-addons:3037021.summary: Zoom, crop and pan HTML5 video to fill your player. Automatic bar detection, custom ratios, optional picture effects and profiles. Free and open source. Local by default, with opt-in browser sync. No analytics.
firefox-addons:3037021.description:
Ultrafill fits HTML5 video to your player, reducing letterbox and pillarbox bars on ultrawide and other displays.
 Zoom, crop and pan with the toolbar, player controls or keyboard shortcuts.
 Detect stable black bars automatically, or choose cinematic, ultrawide and custom picture ratios.
 Place the player button in any corner and choose automatic hiding, always visible or hidden.
 Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and shadows. Optional controls add elastic stretch, sharpness, vibrance, ambience and motion interpolation.
 Save named profiles and remember framing for a video, tab, site or globally.
 Choose panel themes and size, manage site rules, and export or import settings.
Pixel effects require readable video frames and WebGL2. Protected or unreadable streams retain ordinary playback and manual framing. Use player/wrapper fullscreen for pixel effects. Motion interpolation adds approximately one source-frame of visual delay. HDR highlight boost additionally requires a known SDR source, supported WebGPU extended output and an HDR display. Expensive effects start off, and processing adapts to load.
Settings are local by default. Optional browser-account sync carries preferences, profiles and chosen site rules; saved site/tab viewing state, video frames and audio samples are excluded.
Free and open source under the MIT license. No ads, analytics, subscriptions or premium gates.
Shortcuts: Alt+Z toggles fill; Alt+Up/Down adjusts zoom; Alt+X resets. Rebind shortcuts in Firefox's extension shortcut settings.
Project: https://redbulllunatic.codeberg.page/ultrafill/ 
Source and contributions: https://codeberg.org/redbulllunatic/ultrafill 
Bug reports: https://codeberg.org/redbulllunatic/ultrafill/issues

firefox-addons:2642780.name: HLS Downloader
firefox-addons:2642780.summary: Download fragmented media files with HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) downloader.
firefox-addons:2642780.description:
HLS Downloader lets you easily download fragmented media files (with .ts file extension) from the internet. 
HLS or HTTP Live steam is a new media format developed by Apple Inc. It contains a master playlist with ".m3u8" file extension. First, the extension downloads the master playlist, and then within the master, it finds playlist content. Each playlist has several fragmented items. All items are displayed in the UI with a download and a remove button. When you press on the download button the extension downloads all fragmented media and merges them all to generate a single media file. 
Note #1: the UI for the extension can be opened in the toolbar popup, tab, or a separate window. Please right-click on the toolbar button to choose the appropriate context. Within the UI, there is a toggle button to turn the addon ON or OFF.
Note #2: HLS Downloader is NOT responsible for media contents that you download with this add-on. We strongly recommend that you verify the related media copyright permissions on each website before downloading any media file(s).
Note #3: to download HLS stream you gave 3 options. (1) to add a stream URL manually, please enter the desired URL with the ".m3u8" file extension in the UI. (2) as you browse the internet, this extension monitors the webpages and captures all HLS media files, and if anything found, automatically downloads the playlist and updates the badge number accordingly (only when the addon is turned ON). The third option for downloading the HLS stream is via the context-menu item. Please right-click on ".m3u8" streams and then select - Download with HLS Downloader - from the context menu.
If you have a feature request or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:853338.description:
Instructions 
 Access context menu by right-clicking on a tab or anywhere on a webpage.
 Hotkeys:
 New Tab ( Ctrl/Command+Shift+1 )
 Duplicate Tab ( Ctrl/Command+Shift+2 )
 Note 
 Due to Firefox's new extension development standards, developers can no longer modify context menu items' ordering. We know this is mildly annoying, but there's always shortcut keys. 
 UPDATE: This extension will continue to work even with Firefox's new Duplicate Tab function starts rolling out as Firefox's implementation d̶o̶e̶s̶ ̶n̶o̶t̶ ̶d̶u̶p̶l̶i̶c̶a̶t̶e̶ ̶t̶a̶b̶ ̶b̶e̶s̶i̶d̶e̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶c̶u̶r̶r̶e̶n̶t̶ ̶t̶a̶b̶ does not duplicate beside any tabs being right clicked on. 
 UPDATE v.2.2: We hear ya. New Tab function now directly accessible upon right-clicking a tab, without the hassle of having to reach a sub-menu. The Duplicate Tab function will still work by using hotkey, as Firefox has implemented this feature for some time anyway. 
 This extension has not been (and will not be) tested in Firefox Developer Edition (or any other experimental releases) as it was not our intention to develop this outside of Firefox's mainstream releases. Thank you for your understanding and for using our extension.

每張照片3元, 運費台灣為45元，其他國家依重量而有不同。 （尺寸為 4x6）
Q: 沖洗相片的時間需要多久?
1 至 4 個工作天(六日及國定假日不算喔)，以郵局掛號或宅配送達; 收件人請記得填寫真名，以免掛號查無此人退件

Q: 和去超商或一般沖洗店洗相片有什麼不同?
隨時隨地都可以透過App沖洗，不用再跑去店面，也省去使用記憶卡或是傳輸線的麻煩；此外，相片直接送達指定地址，分享給親友更方便
Q: 手機拍出來的照片沖洗品質如何?
在戶外及光線充足環境下所拍攝的相片，手機相機的品質已經達到一般數位相機的水準；此外，由於 nuPhoto App 針對不同款式的 手機分別作色彩及銳利度之最佳化處理，讓手機沖洗出來的相片品質比一般沖洗店更佳；不過，在光線不足的環境下，手機拍攝相片中的雜訊還是比數位相機高一些
Q: 可以沖洗滿版的相片嗎?
若您喜歡傳統滿版的相片，可在沖洗設定中選擇 "不留邊框" ，但要提醒您，由於各家手機拍出來的影像 長寬比例和 4x6 相片不同，所以相片內容邊緣會有少許部份被裁切
Q: 可以沖洗 Instagram 的相片嗎?
可以，建議您選擇 "白邊簡約" 的設定，洗出來的照片會有類似拍立得的風格喔
Q: 為什麼只提供珍珠版面?
我們採用質感和成本都比較高的頂級珍珠版面相紙，除了讓您珍貴的回憶可以被妥善地被保存外，也可避免發生亮面相片容易留下指紋的問題
Q: 可以沖洗不是手機拍出來相片嗎?
您可以把其它相機或手機的照片上傳到手機，透過 nuPhoto App 來沖洗相片，另外我們也有Web版喔
http://nuphot.com.tw
Q: 相片可以寄到國外嗎?
您可以在全世界有網路的地方使用 nuPhoto App 來沖洗相片，但目前相片送達的地址限定台灣,中國,港澳,及新加坡。
Q: 關於相片的版權
相片以及數位照片都具有版權，未經過擁有者同意而複製照片將觸及法律條規，若有侵權行為或第三者質疑時，使用者應自負法律責任，與 nuPhoto 無關
Q: 關於退換貨
消費者於收到購買產品時，在未經使用發現非人為惡意損壞之瑕疵，nuPhoto 將依法於使用者收受產品七日內，視實際發生情況提供適宜的產品處理辦法
Q: 關於網路相本
為了避免您沖洗的珍貴數位相片遺失，我們提供 網路相簿 服務方便您備份和分享照片(需登入才可以使用；可自行設定為個人或公開相簿，預設為個人相簿)；若您不想使用此服務，可於完成訂單後自行至 網路相簿 (http://nuphoto.com.tw/album) 刪除相本
Q: 信用卡付款問題
nuPhoto的金流系統由國泰世華銀行提供，您將於安全連線下於國泰世華銀行頁面輸入您的信用卡, nuPhoto 並不會儲存您的信用卡卡號 Visa金融卡也可以用來付款. 國外發卡也能刷喔。
Q: 美國怎麼洗照片？ 
推薦 https://printage.cc 美國當地製作 當地寄出
Q: How to print photos in USA?
We suggest you use Printage App. https://printage.cc
Prints are made in US, and the quality is great, too.
*Hundreds of stylish photo frames
*4x6 prints and 8x8 photo book
* $0.11 per photo and $9.99 for photo book
Facebook https://facebook.com/printageUS
Q: 磁鐵的照片品質
我們也是採用一樣的相紙去沖印覆膜處理，所以影像品質比一版磁鐵更優，可保存更久。
Q: 磁鐵的吸力
大圓/長方形磁鐵為強力磁鐵，可以吸附6張A4紙張
PS: 測試環境為一般冰箱門

bluejetty:00136050:ios.description:
Explore real film and TV filming locations worldwide. Recreate iconic scenes with our integrated ShotSync camera feature and plan unforgettable screen-inspired travel.
SetJetters turns your favorite movies into travel destinations - From Reel to Real. 
Discover Real Filming Locations
Explore a global database of real film locations and television filming locations from around the world. Search by movie title, TV show, video game, franchise, actor, or real-world destination to uncover the exact spots where iconic scenes were filmed. Join the growing trend of set-jetting!
From major studio franchises to independent films and timeless classics, SetJetters connects you to authentic movie locations across cities, remote landscapes, and hidden gems worldwide.
Whether you're searching for a famous filming location nearby or planning international movie travel, SetJetters helps you find it - and navigate directly to it.
Explore with an Interactive Map
Our searchable, interactive map makes discovering movie and TV filming locations simple and immersive.
* Find filming locations near you
* Explore movie locations worldwide
* Search by destination, title, or franchise
* Save and share your favorite cinematic journeys
Whether you're traveling abroad or binge-watching at home and wondering, “Where was that filmed?”, SetJetters transforms curiosity into exploration - turning screen tourism into real-world adventure.
Recreate Scenes with ShotSync
With our exclusive ShotSync™ camera, you don’t just visit filming locations - you step directly into the scene.
Overlay the original movie frame onto your live camera view to perfectly align your photo with the iconic shot. Capture a side-by-side recreation and share your cinematic experience with the SetJetters community or on social media.
Stand where the scene happened. Frame it. Capture it.
Plan Film-Inspired Travel
SetJetters goes beyond filming locations with our “Beyond the Frame” insights - offering local context that enhances every visit.
Discover:
* Cultural and historical background
* Nearby attractions and landmarks
* Food, accommodations, and travel tips
* Additional filming locations in the region
Whether you're building a full film tourism itinerary or adding a single movie location to your trip, SetJetters turns movies into destinations and screen moments into travel inspiration.
SetJetters is designed for:
* Film Tourism and any Screen Tourism
* Film, TV, and Video Game fans
* Movie travelers
* Pop culture explorers
* Destination discovery enthusiasts
Download SetJetters today and explore the world - one scene at a time. Thank you for trying out our portal to film and travel. Share with a friend, leave a review, and contact us through the app to let us know what you would like to see on SetJetters.
The SetJetters Team

bluejetty:00138973:ios.description:
Football Chairman is back and it's bigger than ever!
Create a soccer club from scratch, starting as a tiny non-league team, and see if you can make it through seven divisions to the very top.
See your players win play-offs, cup competitions and eventually conquer Europe and the World!
Hire and fire managers, develop your stadium, negotiate transfers, contracts and sponsorship deals... while keeping the fans and the bank manager happy.
Over three million users have downloaded the Football Chairman games since launch, and they have won multiple app store awards.
Football Chairman Pro 2 is the newest and most in-depth version of the game, which is updated every season free of charge with the very latest data!
FC Pro 2 retains the fast-paced, addictive gameplay that made the earlier versions so popular, while adding a whole host of new features, including:
- Updated domestic, European and international cup competitions for 2026/27
- Compete with clubs from all over the globe in a World Team Cup
- Load or create updated datapacks featuring teams from all over the world
- Design your club's home, away and goalkeeper shirts each season
- No time limits or adverts, and all in-app purchases are 100% optional
- Managers have more detailed profiles, including age, personality and preferences
- Negotiate manager contracts and renewals
- Take over 'real' teams or go back to your previous clubs
- More flexibility over signings with a new 'Transfer shortlist'
- 'Hall of Fame' to honour your club's greatest ever players
- New 'Financial Fair Play' challenge scenario to test your skills
- More detailed financial insights to help you manage your club's money
- 99 achievements to aim for, including 49 brand new ones
- Trophy Cabinet to show off your club's silverware
- Redesigned interface
- Plus thousands of other improvements to the gameplay!
Good luck... you'll need it!

The app displays the live status of Choghadiya and Hora. To get more details about any day, just click over that day and you will get all details of that day. The almanack can be used to forecast celestial phenomena including solar eclipse weather(rain, dry spells etc) and other occurrences. it follows a traditional unit of Indian 
timekeeping and provides all important dates and their calculation in tabular from the Swaminarayan religion follow this Indian Vedic almanack it is commonly consulted for the purpose of planing travels finance and other aspects of life The almanack has been evolving for the past 5,000 year

bluejetty:00129398:ios.name: rekordbox - DJ App & DJ Mixer
bluejetty:00129398:ios.summary:
Start your DJ journey, or master the art of mixing.
rekordbox is a DJ app that enables everyone, from beginners to professionals, to experience the excitement of DJing.
With this app, anyone who loves music can easily start DJing for free
bluejetty:00129398:ios.description:
Start your DJ journey, or master the art of mixing.
rekordbox is a DJ app that enables everyone, from beginners to professionals, to experience the excitement of DJing.
With this app, anyone who loves music can easily start DJing for free.
You can also take things to the next level by combining this app with compatible DJ equipment such as the DDJ-FLX4, DDJ-FLX2, 
DDJ-GRV6,DDJ-200 and all-in-one DJ systems XDJ-AN.
Professional-level DJing for free
-rekordbox is the no. 1 DJ app.
-All the basic features you need for DJing, including decks, samplers, mixers, effects, loops, and more, are available for free.
-DJ at home parties, bars, clubs, and festivals. Mix EDM, hip-hop, electro, pop, or any other music you like.
Give it a try, there's a world of fun waiting for you. 
-Not sure you can do it? No skills? No knowledge of music? No problem! 
-It’s easy to dive into the world of playing music.
-Even if you don't have your own music, you can use songs from Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Beatport Streaming, TIDAL, and other streaming services, so you can get into the party mood right away.
Remix your favourite music 
-rekordbox includes loads of features you can use to get creative and put your own stamp on your favourite songs.
-With Pad FX, simply touch the pads on the screen to rearrange the composition of a track or add a new texture to the sound.
-Using Key Shift, you can change the key of the music in a single touch, without affecting the speed. Try making a track sound high or low for a new perspective.
Blend 2 songs into 1
-When it comes to DJing, mixing is everything.
-It’s easy to mix 2 songs together naturally as if they were 1.
-First, use Beat Sync to match the tempo and beat, then you're ready to move the faders to blend the tracks together.
Make DJ sound effects, even if you’ve never done it before
-Don't worry if you don't know much about DJing.
-You can use the sampler to create DJ sounds.
-Try hitting the pad and tap Horn.
-Then tap it to the rhythm of the song.
Touch and scratch the sound
-Try touching the sound displayed in white, yellow, and blue waves.
-Move your finger backward and forward to scratch the track.
Slow down the music without changing the pitch of the notes
-If you have a song that’s so fast you can’t understand the vocals, you can change the tempo and play it back slower, but without changing the pitch of the notes.
-This is great not only for DJs, but also for changing the speed of backing tracks when practicing with musical instruments or dancing.
Use rekordbox anytime, anywhere
-Maybe you use rekordbox on your smartphone, tablet, or computer?
-With Cloud Library Sync, you can manage your favourite playlists and meta data, such as cue points, using one library in the cloud.
-So, you can prepare playlists on the go before a gig, then open your laptop and use it to DJ – all your changes will be seamlessly synced.
-If your DJ equipment supports rekordbox CloudDirectPlay, such as the CDJ-3000, you can sign in and play tracks from the latest version of your rekordbox library directly from the hardware.
Have even more fun with Alphatheta / Pioneer DJ equipment
-Want to play on DJ gear like a professional?
-You can connect DJ equipment such as the DDJ-FLX4, DDJ-FLX2, DDJ-GRV6 ,DDJ-200 and all in one system XDJ-AN to take your performances to the next level.
-You can also DJ with your favourite playlists by connecting to professional DJ equipment in clubs such as the CDJ-3000 or XDJ-XZ with PRO DJ LINK.
Play all your own music
-Want to DJ with your own tracks?
-rekordbox supports MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, and ALAC, so you can import and play all your music files.
Want to go to the next level? Subscribe today
-Got the hang of the basic functions?
-Then it's time to upgrade.
-Subscribe to get even more advanced features.
-A free trial is available so you can test out one of our plans before you subscribe.
Get into the DJ lifestyle with rekordbox.

bluejetty:00128188:ios.description:
Tracing Projector – Creator helps you trace, sketch, and create impressive artwork fast — even if you have zero experience.
Creating art has never been this easy. Pick any image from your phone, project it onto a surface, and follow the outline to build your sketch step by step.
With our projection-based tracing tools, you can sketch on almost any surface you like — paper, wall, board, or canvas. Want structured practice? Use the grid layout to trace proportions and patterns more accurately.
You can create clean outlines for portraits, designs, tattoos, crafts, or street-style artwork. Just choose an image, grab your pencil, pen, brush, or spray can, and start tracing.
Key Features
Trace on Any Surface
Project your chosen image and follow the guide to trace lines and shapes on paper, walls, boards, and more.
Learn Sketching Faster
Practice by tracing outlines on-screen, then add shading and color to improve your skills naturally.
Smart Alignment & Better Accuracy
The app helps keep your image positioned so you can focus on tracing and sketching without frustration.
Easy to Use
Choose an image from your gallery, allow camera access, and start projecting. You can also use your flash if you need extra light.
It’s like having a guided tracing projector in your pocket — you simply follow the projected outline and bring your sketch to life. Create artwork anytime, anywhere, with minimal effort.
This tool can also support creative workflows in areas like fashion, crafts, design mockups, and prototypes — helping you trace faster and turn ideas into sketches more quickly.
Once your sketch is complete, enjoy adding color and finishing touches your way. With the right colors and a clean outline, your final piece will look polished and professional.
Create beautiful sketches on paper, board, tablet stands, or walls — and turn simple outlines into masterpieces.

bluejetty:00016744:ios.summary:
Mega Photo is the #1 app for transforming your photos and videos into fun and inspiring masterpieces with 800+ of FREE effects!
Twist, morph, pinch, and warp your photos into outrageous designs! You can even spin your images in 3-D. There
bluejetty:00016744:ios.description:
Mega Photo is the #1 app for transforming your photos and videos into fun and inspiring masterpieces with 800+ of FREE effects!
Twist, morph, pinch, and warp your photos into outrageous designs! You can even spin your images in 3-D. There are over 800 free effects to choose from and you see them all in real-time. You can take videos with the effects too! You can pause the recording to switch effects in the middle of your video. Make a music video by selecting a soundtrack from your music library!
Effects include: tunnel, mosaic, puzzle, hue shift, motion blur, tile, emboss, spinning cube, x-ray, collage, night vision, halftone, light tunnel, and many more. There's also 40 vintage camera effects for a retro feel.
Mega Photo will transform your photos and videos with amazing effects you won't find in other photography apps. It's the most fun you can have with your photos!
** TRANSFORM YOUR PHOTOS IN AMAZING WAYS **
Mega Photo makes your photos and videos as unique as you are. Over 800 free effects are shown to you in real-time. You can play a tile puzzle with a live camera feed, go through a wormhole tunnel, view a spinning globe, and much more!
The app can switch from the front to rear facing camera with the touch of a button. You can use the live camera or a still image - just choose a favorite picture from your library or take a new picture.
Many of the photo effects are interactive so you can personalize it even before taking your picture or video. Tap and drag, zoom with two fingers, rotate, and more to make it your own.
** SHARE THE FUN WITH FRIENDS **
Photos are more fun with your friends, and Mega Photo makes it easy. Share your zany and funny photos (like you as the Mona Lisa!) easily. Just tap to email your photo or post to Facebook or Twitter.
Are your friends nearby? Snap a photo with all of you using the helpful timer. Set the timer for up to 30 seconds so all your buddies can get in the picture. Don't forget to choose your favorite photo transformation to amaze your friends.
** APP FEATURES **
• Transform Your Photos - Distort, pinch, and change colors of your photos and videos
• 800+ Free Effects - Apply eye-popping effects to your images with just a tap of your finger
• Interactive Adjustable Filters - View and change your photo effects in real-time
• Share with Friends - Easily post your photos to Facebook or Twitter, and email to friends and family.
• Use Existing Photos - Snap a new photo or use your existing pics on your camera roll. 
• Play Games - Take your photos and play classic arcade games with your photos.
• Take Video - Mega Photo can be used for video too with effects that would make Michael Bay jealous.
• Add Music to Videos - Add music to your videos and become the next Justin Bieber with Mega Photo... or not.

bluejetty:00153440:ios.description:
###A Fitness App for Everyone###
Feel better. Get stronger. All from the comfort of home.
Whether you're just starting out, juggling life as a busy mom, navigating midlife changes, or simply need a little extra motivation—EaseFit is your all-in-one fitness companion designed just for you.
EaseFit gets you:
- Want to burn fat, tone up, or feel younger—but don’t have time for the gym?
- Worried about injuries or don’t know where to start?
- Craving workouts that are effective but not overwhelming?
We’ve got you!
EaseFit offers personalized support for your body and keeps you motivated every step of the way.
Why You’ll Love EaseFit:
- Customized Workout Plans – Tailored to your lifestyle, preferences, and fitness goals.
- No Equipment Needed – Get moving anytime, anywhere.
- Simple, Guided Workouts – Step-by-step instructions and videos ensure you move safely and confidently.
- Safe for Every Body – Gentle, joint-friendly options ideal for recovery, beginners, and anyone concerned about injury.
- Workout Variety You’ll Actually Enjoy – Cardio, Yoga, Pilates, Stretching, Bed & Chair exercises, and more.
- Fun & Rewarding – Stay motivated with progress tracking and achievement badges.
- All Levels Welcome – Whether you're new or experienced, EaseFit makes fitness approachable and enjoyable.
Start today and become the stronger, more confident version of yourself with EaseFit！
Subscription Information:
• Up to $49.99/year for unlimited VIP access
 • Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation
 • Subscription auto-renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
 • Renewal charges occur within 24 hours before the period ends
Note: Always consult a physician before starting any new fitness program. Individual results may vary.
Terms of Use: https://landing.easefit.fit/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy: https://landing.easefit.fit/privacy-policy.html

Save time, learn new skills, and add variety to your exercise routine with Grokker pr
bluejetty:00134592:ios.description:
With 1000s of fitness, yoga, meditation, and healthy cooking videos, Grokker makes it easy to find and save the right exercise videos for your busy life.
Save time, learn new skills, and add variety to your exercise routine with Grokker programs. Ranging from one week to six weeks in length, programs are organized to save you time. Our expert instructors will help you achieve your goals one video at a time. With over 80 goal-oriented programs to choose from and new programs added monthly, there's something new for you every day of the year.
Check out some popular programs:
* 21-Day Athlete: Build strength, shed excess weight, and improve your mobility with 15-minute workouts optimized to get you maximum results in minimal time.
* Weight Management Jumpstart: Get moving with beginner workouts, learn how to build sustainable habits, and start improving your nutrition in just one week.
* 21-Day Happy Yoga Challenge: Lower stress levels, practice self love, increase body confidence and experience more happiness each and every day through the combined practice of yoga and mindfulness exercises
* 14-Day Sugar Reset: A step-by-step program to help reset your sugar cravings and make a reduced sugar lifestyle a long term habit.
* 7-Minute HIIT: Achieve maximum results in minimal time with this high-intensity interval training (HIIT) program.
* Perfect Pilates: 5 workouts, 20 minutes each - these workouts can be fit into the busiest of schedules.
* Daily Muscle Relief: These 20-minute, low-impact exercises will strengthen and lengthen your muscles to alleviate pain and improve posture.
* Deep Sleep Release: Skip the hours of tossing and turning and turn on a sleep story with Natasha Kerry.
And many more.
Watch Anywhere: At home with our Apple TV app or on-the-go on your iPhone (requires iPhone 4s or iPad 2 or later)
Track Progress: We make it easy for you to keep track of minutes practiced and calories burned to stay motivated and achieve your goals.
Save & Organize: We'll organize the videos you watch, save, and love so it's quick and easy to find your favorites.
Find Something New: Filter by topic, difficulty level, and duration, or search by keyword to find the right video for your current level and schedule.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Grokker users can add calories burned from Grokker fitness workouts to Apple Health as well as Mindful Minutes for time spent doing meditation videos. Apple Watch users get real time updates of their heart rates and calories while doing workouts, and can contribute to their Activity Rings.
Grokker is free to download and use. Upgrading to Premium adds the ability to watch an unlimited number of premium videos per month and is available through an auto-renewing subscription. A monthly subscription is $14.99 and a yearly subscription is $119.99. There is a free trial period during which you may try out Grokker Premium without being charged. Payment will be charged to an iTunes Account at the culmination of the free trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. A subscription automatically renews at the listed monthly or yearly price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. A subscription may be managed in Account Settings after purchase.
Grokker's Privacy Policy may be found at https://grokker.com/privacy
Grokker's Terms of Use may be found at https://grokker.com/tos
Contact us support@grokker.com

Save time, learn new skills, and add variety to your exercise routine with Grokker programs. Ranging from one week to six weeks in length, programs are organized to save you time. Our expert instructors will help you achieve your goals one video at a time. With over 80 goal-oriented programs to choose from and new programs added monthly, there's something new for you every day of the year.
 
Check out some popular programs:

* 21-Day Athlete:  Build strength, shed excess weight, and improve your mobility with 15-minute workouts optimized to get you maximum results in minimal time.

* Weight Management Jumpstart: Get moving with beginner workouts, learn how to build sustainable habits, and start improving your nutrition in just one week.
 
* 21-Day Happy Yoga Challenge: Lower stress levels, practice self love, increase body confidence and experience more happiness each and every day through the combined practice of yoga and mindfulness exercises
 
* 14-Day Sugar Reset: A step-by-step program to help reset your sugar cravings and make a reduced sugar lifestyle a long term habit.
 
* 7-Minute HIIT: Achieve maximum results in minimal time with this high-intensity interval training (HIIT) program.
 
* Perfect Pilates: 5 workouts, 20 minutes each - these workouts can be fit into the busiest of schedules.
 
* Daily Muscle Relief: These 20-minute, low-impact exercises will strengthen and lengthen your muscles to alleviate pain and improve posture.
 
* Deep Sleep Release: Skip the hours of tossing and turning and turn on a sleep story with Natasha Kerry.

And many more.
 
Watch Anywhere: At home with our Apple TV app or on-the-go on your iPhone (requires iPhone 4s or iPad 2 or later)
 
Track Progress: We make it easy for you to keep track of minutes practiced and calories burned to stay motivated and achieve your goals.
 
Save & Organize: We'll organize the videos you watch, save, and love so it's quick and easy to find your favorites.
 
Find Something New: Filter by topic, difficulty level, and duration, or search by keyword to find the right video for your current level and schedule.
 
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
 
Grokker users can add calories burned from Grokker fitness workouts to Apple Health as well as Mindful Minutes for time spent doing meditation videos. Apple Watch users get real time updates of their heart rates and calories while doing workouts, and can contribute to their Activity Rings.
 
Grokker is free to download and use. Upgrading to Premium adds the ability to watch an unlimited number of premium videos per month and is available through an auto-renewing subscription. A monthly subscription is $14.99 and a yearly subscription is $119.99. There is a free trial period during which you may try out Grokker Premium without being charged. Payment will be charged to an iTunes Account at the culmination of the free trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. A subscription automatically renews at the listed monthly or yearly price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. A subscription may be managed in Account Settings after purchase.
 
Grokker's Privacy Policy may be found at https://grokker.com/privacy
 
Grokker's Terms of Use may be found at https://grokker.com/tos
 
Contact us support@grokker.com

bluejetty:00131567:ios.description:

Those member to member interactions are ultimately what will make your courses, challenges, events and memberships successful. Mighty powers them using its proprietary People Magic AI, which is designed to surface the most interesting and relevant members to each other and help them break the ice. 
On Mighty, a creator, entrepreneur, coach or community leader can host groups and subgroups, offer courses, livestream, run events, and more. They can offer those things for free or charge for access on a recurring or one-time basis. 
Every day millions of members contribute to communities on Mighty centered on diverse topics — health and wellness, spirituality, career, relationships, personal development, and hobbies are all well represented. 
Brands also use Mighty for customer communities, ambassador activations, and employee engagement. 
“It was very important to me to not have my community on Facebook. Mighty Networks has been a great alternative and has only gotten better in the five years I’ve used it.” - Tara W., Mighty Host

“My Mighty Network is incredibly dynamic and keeps getting better. The features they offer make it easy to build a community and, more importantly, keep my members engaged. Their team is also highly responsive, another reason I love Mighty. In short, A+” - Dana Wilde, Mighty Host
“There are so many ways to customize your community and offerings, with new features coming all the time.” - Steff B, Mighty Host
The future’s more interesting when we’re in it together. Climb aboard—and let’s go.

bluejetty:00099360:ios.description:
BATTLEFINITY – BF6 LOADOUTS, META RANKINGS, STATS, AND SETTINGS
Battlefinity is the Battlefield 6 companion that helps you play smarter. Find the best meta loadouts, see which guns are most popular, compare weapon stats, track nerfs and buffs, optimize your settings, and share your builds with the community.
FEATURES:
- Meta loadouts and weapon rankings for BF6
- Gun popularity and usage trends
- Advanced weapon stats and comparators (TTK, recoil, RPM, damage, velocity)
- Patch history with nerfs and buffs
- Best BF6 settings (sensitivity, FOV, controller, graphics)
- Create a loadout and share with the community
- Creator profiles and verified builds
META LOADOUTS AND RANKINGS
Discover meta builds for every playstyle. See ranked lists of top assault rifles, SMGs, LMGs, marksman rifles, and snipers, updated after each patch so you’re always using competitive setups.
GUN POPULARITY
See which guns are trending. Track popularity and usage to understand what the community is running and spot rising meta picks before everyone else.
ADVANCED WEAPON STATS AND COMPARATORS
Compare weapons side by side with in-depth metrics: time-to-kill by range, recoil behavior, rate of fire, damage profiles, bullet velocity, ADS and sprint-to-fire, hipfire spread, and more. Quickly switch attachments to see how each change affects performance.
NERFS AND BUFFS HISTORY
Browse a clear history of weapon balance changes. See exactly what changed in each patch so you can adjust your class setup immediately.
BEST SETTINGS FOR BATTLEFIELD 6
Dial in optimal sensitivity, FOV, aim response, controller layouts, and graphics settings. Practical recommendations to improve clarity, consistency, and aim control across modes.
CREATE A LOADOUT
Build your own class with attachments and equipment, save variations, and share a unique link or image with the community. Discover community builds and copy setups in seconds.
CREATOR PROFILES
Follow creators and skilled players, view their verified builds, and keep up with their latest meta recommendations. Share your profile to grow your audience.
READY FOR THE BATTLE ROYALE REDSEC
Get the best meta loadouts for the new Battle Royale Redsec.

“Speaking Japanese used to feel overwhelming whenever I needed to include specific d
bluejetty:00154854:ios.description:
Sakuraspeak offers a unique, fun, and faster way to practice Japanese & Korean through conversations, designed for both language learners and travelers. 
“Speaking Japanese used to feel overwhelming whenever I needed to include specific details like dates, times, or numbers in a sentence. I’d get stuck halfway through and wasn’t sure how to connect everything properly. For instance, I wanted to say, ‘I’d like to make a dinner reservation for 2 people on Saturday at 6 pm,’ but I couldn’t figure out how to piece it all together. Thanks to Sakuraspeak, I was able to complete the sentence effortlessly. The app has been a lifesaver for those moments when I know part of what to say but need help to finish it confidently.” - Amanda D.
“Your AI product is exactly the kind of thing that I've been hoping to find and to come to exist." - Thomas, Korean language learner for 20 years
"So far I'm really liking the app. I've been using it to ask grammar questions and its been really useful. get to practice speaking and do some grammar study at the same time." - Crater
“Before using Sakuraspeak, I struggled with speaking Japanese confidently because I wasn’t sure if I was making mistakes or using the right grammar. It was frustrating not knowing how to improve. With Sakuraspeak’s correction and explanation features, everything changed. The app not only points out my mistakes but also explains them clearly, so I can learn and avoid repeating them. Thanks to Sakuraspeak, I’m building confidence in speaking Japanese and making real progress every day!” - Benjamin
Why Sakuraspeak?
Real-Life Conversations: Practise speaking with role-play scenarios like ordering coffee, asking for directions, or ordering food at a restaurant – perfect for everyday use and travel
AI-Powered Speaking Partner: Feel like you're talking to a real person. Our AI provides instant feedback on pronunciation, grammar, and fluency, helping you improve with every conversation. 
Daily Speaking Practice: Just 10 minutes a day! Conveniently fit SakuraSpeak into your daily routine, anytime, anywhere. 
Tailored for All Levels: Whether you’re a beginner or advanced learner, our app adapts to your pace and level. 
Key Features:
Role-Play Scenarios: Experience different situations to learn how to speak the language like a local.
Personalized Learning Paths: Tailored exercises based on your proficiency level.
Daily Practice Reminders: Stay on track with daily notifications.
Progress Tracking: Monitor your growth and celebrate your achievements.
Speak Fluently: Regular practice to build fluency and boost confidence.
At Sakuraspeak, we understand the challenges of learning a language. Our team created this app to provide an immersive, enjoyable, and effective way to learn languages. Practice speaking in realistic scenarios and feel confident wherever you go!
Ready to Start Speaking?
Try the app out today and start your journey to fluency. 
SAKURASPEAK MEMBERSHIP
Sakuraspeak offers both monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions. Become a Sakuraspeak Member to gain unlimited access to all lessons, role-play scenarios, review material, and other content within Sakuraspeak.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Privacy Policy: https://sakuraspeak.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://sakuraspeak.app/terms

bluejetty:00021936:ios.description:
Clue Tracker is the ultimate letterboxing app. Quickly and easily find Atlas Quest and LbNA boxes, view maps, record finds, save and organize itineraries of letterboxes and much more.
Features:
• Find nearby letterboxes based on your current location.
• Search for boxes by location, box name, planter, box ID, and much more.
• View detailed letterbox information including last found date, series details, and comments.
• Show letterboxes on a map and get directions to a box.
• Built-in compass display (device support required).
• Quickly and easily record finds.
• Save clues and other letterbox information for offline use.
• Organize saved letterboxes into your own lists and reorder boxes to create custom itineraries.
• Share a list of saved letterboxes with another Clue Tracker user (or transfer the list to another device).
• Sort and filter search results and lists of saved letterboxes.
• Change the location of a saved letterbox.
• Add Word-Of-Mouth (WOM) letterboxes.
• Add your own photos to saved boxes and WOM boxes.
• Add personal notes.
Are you new to Letterboxing? Learn more about this intriguing activity at AtlasQuest.com or Letterboxing.org.
Pearl Crescent and Clue Tracker are not affiliated with Atlas Quest or LbNA.

bluejetty:00088215:ios.summary: แอพ วันมงคล - Calendar 2026 เป็นแอพ ปฏิทินไทย 2569 ปฏิทินฤกษ์มงคล และ ปฏิทินจีน 2569 ที่ช่วยบอก ฤกษ์มงคล ฤกษ์ดี วันดี ฮวงจุ้ยดี เหมาะสำหรับผู้ที่กำลังมองหาฤกษ์ ขึ้นบ้านใหม่ แต่งงาน เปิดกิจการ ซื้อรถ วันสำคัญของไทย แสดงเทศกาลสำคัญต่างๆ วันหย
bluejetty:00088215:ios.description:
แอพ วันมงคล - Calendar 2026 เป็นแอพ ปฏิทินไทย 2569 ปฏิทินฤกษ์มงคล และ ปฏิทินจีน 2569 ที่ช่วยบอก ฤกษ์มงคล ฤกษ์ดี วันดี ฮวงจุ้ยดี เหมาะสำหรับผู้ที่กำลังมองหาฤกษ์ ขึ้นบ้านใหม่ แต่งงาน เปิดกิจการ ซื้อรถ วันสำคัญของไทย แสดงเทศกาลสำคัญต่างๆ วันหยุดนักขัตฤกษ์ วันพระ บันทึกการนัดหมาย เวลา ในปฏิทิน
- ดูปฏิทินได้หลายวิธี - ปฏิทินวันหยุด , ปฏิทินวันสำคัญไทย , ปฏิทินวันสำคัญจีน , ปฏิทินฤกษ์ดี , ปฏิทินฤกษ์มงคล , ปฎิทินวันพระ
- ปฏิทินจันทรคติจีน 
- ปฏิทินจันทรคติไทย ข้างขึ้น ข้างแรม
- ฤกษ์แต่งงาน ฤกษ์ออกรถใหม่ ฤกษ์เปิดกิจการ ฤกษ์เปิดร้านค้า ฤกษ์ขึ้นบ้านใหม่ ในแต่ละเดือน
- ดู ฤกษ์ดีประจำเดือน เช่น ฤกษ์ดี มกราคม 2569
- วันดี วันชง ปีที่ไม่ถูกกัน 12 เดือน ปี 2569
- ปฎิทินวันพระ 2569
- วันสำคัญไทย วันสำคัญทางพุทธศาสนา เทศกาลสำคัญ
- วันสำคัญจีน วันไหว้ วันตรุษจีน วันสารท เทศกาลกินเจ 
- วันหยุดนักขัตฤกษ์ วันหยุดราชการ วันหยุดธนาคาร
- ระบบแจ้งเตือนวันพระ และ วันหยุด 
- ระบบปฎิทินกิจกรรมของคุณ บันทึกกิจกรรม เช่น การนัดหมายต่างๆ จดบันทึก โน๊ต ตารางเวลา ของคุณลงในหน้าปฏิทินของแอพ
- ตั้งเวลาแจ้งเตือนกิจกรรม/วันนัดหมายล่วงหน้าได้
** ข้อมูลในปฏิทินอัพเดททุกปี
** วิธีการอัพเดทแอพเวอร์ชั่นใหม่ เพื่อให้ข้อมูลกิจกรรม / ตารางนัดหมาย ที่ผู้ใช้บันทึกไว้ในเครื่องไม่สูญหาย คือ ให้กดปุ่ม “อัพเดท” บนหน้า App Store เท่านั้น

bluejetty:00023886:ios.description:
You want to join in the world of colorful bubbles, with cute characters and have a fun time? Then Panda Bubble Shooter will be the right option for you. You will join with Panda in this adventure, and help him rescue his friends in this fun and relaxing puzzle game. And here is how to fulfil this mission
HOW TO PLAY
- This bubble game is an updated version of classic bubble shooter puzzle. Therefore, it is very easy to simple to play
- Simply aim and shoot bubbles of the same color. You need to match at least 3 bubbles with the same color to make them pop and blast to rescue Panda's friends
- Match bubbles with unique aiming line to help you shoot perfectly
- A helpful squirrel will stay by your side and give you helpful boosters, so that you can overcome the level more quickly
- Keep in mind that you only have a limited number of bubblers. Therefore, you should strategize your moves carefully
FEATURES
Panda Bubble Shooter Puzzle Game is an updated version of classic bubbles shooter game; so it contains many features of classic bubble puzzle, along with a lot of new and stunning features
- 1000+ stunning levels. This game is simple, yet challenging. Thus, it can challenge your brain and improve your IQ
- Beatiful boosters
- Cute and eye-pleasing characters. This helps you relax after a stressful day
- Great sound effect, as well as ASMR sound will help you relax and have a fun time
In short, if you want to train your brain, and still have a fun time, then Panda Pop Bubble Shooter will be a great option for your to try

bluejetty:00023349:ios.name: Charades! Pictures
bluejetty:00023349:ios.summary: The days of writing on tiny ripped up paper and choosing from someone's smelly ball cap are behind us. Our new & improved version of Charades allows you to dive right into the laughter and good times! Perfect for any type of gathering - the
bluejetty:00023349:ios.description:
The days of writing on tiny ripped up paper and choosing from someone's smelly ball cap are behind us. Our new & improved version of Charades allows you to dive right into the laughter and good times! Perfect for any type of gathering - there are categories for any occasion! 
Use your imagination & get creative to sing, dance, act, draw, describe, or even hand jive clues to the person guessing. Whatever medium you choose, remember to do it quickly before the timer runs out! 
Awesome App Features:
- Unlimited amount of players
- 10+ Categories to choose from
- Kid & Family friendly categories 
- Unlimited game play, without ads
How To Play:
1. Choose a category 
2. Select player one - have them place the phone on their forehead horizontally 
3. Ready, Set, Go!
4. All players call out clues to help player one guess the item on their forehead before the timer runs out
- If player one guesses correctly, tilt the phone down/forward.
- If player one isn’t sure, tilt the phone up to cue next item.
5. Once the timer is up, see the score you got! 
- Pass phone to the next player.
To access all features, content, and functionality of the Charades - you can subscribe to an annual auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. 
Privacy Policy: https://appcano.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://appcano.io/terms

bluejetty:00179072:ios.summary: GPS Area Measure - Mapulator is a powerful measurement app for iPhone designed for professionals and individuals who need field area measurements, GPS measure distance, and land surveying tools. Whether you're working in land survey, proper
bluejetty:00179072:ios.description:
GPS Area Measure - Mapulator is a powerful measurement app for iPhone designed for professionals and individuals who need field area measurements, GPS measure distance, and land surveying tools. Whether you're working in land survey, property lines mapping, fieldmaps, or need a distance calculator for land navigation, this app provides quick and accurate results.
Accurate GPS-Based Land and Distance Measurement
Turn your iPhone into a digital tape measure and map maker with precise area measurement, radius map, and measure angles capabilities. Ideal for roof, room measurements, and land measurement calculations, Mapulator helps you get the most out of your measurements.
Key Features:
• Multiple Measurement Tools – Measure land area, perimeter, distance, and radius map with precision.
• GPS Live Mode – Walk or move to measure distance in real time.
• Multiple Units Supported – Work with meters, acres, hectares, and more.
• Customizable Maps – Use land maps, field maps, and terrain views for better accuracy.
• Advanced Calculation Tools – Includes an area calculator, measurement calculator, and measure angles tool.
• Undo/Redo Feature – Easily correct measurements without restarting.
• Search & Export – Find locations quickly and export data in KML or GeoJSON.
• Offline Support – Access field area measure tools even without an internet connection.
Why Choose Mapulator?
• Highly Accurate GPS Measure Distance – Get reliable land surveying results.
• User-Friendly Interface – Easy to use for professionals and beginners.
• Versatile Application – Ideal for roof measure, room measurement, property lines mapping, and more.
• Free Measuring App Features – Access essential tools in the measure-free version.
Who Can Benefit?
• Surveyors & Engineers – Conduct land surveying with field area measure accuracy.
• Farmers & Landowners – Use land map tools to measure and calculate property lines.
• Construction Professionals – Plan projects with a measurement calculator for roof and room measurement.
• Outdoor Enthusiasts – Navigate with land navigation and GPS measure distance features.
Welcome to GPS Area Measure by Mapulator! We're an ecstatic mapping tool for precise area, perimeter, and distance calculations. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just exploring your surroundings, Mapulator empowers you with accurate measurements at your fingertips.
Dive into a world of seamless mapping and precise calculations. Explore our intuitive interface and discover the power of real-time GPS measurement, customizable map views, and versatile measurement tools. From land surveying and agricultural planning to construction management and outdoor adventures, Mapulator is your trusted companion for all your measurement needs.
How to Use the App?
1. Select a Measurement Tool – Choose from area measure, measure distance, or radius map.
2. Mark Points on the Map – Use the interactive map maker to outline areas.
3. Customize Settings – Adjust map layers for field map visualization.
4. Enable GPS Live Mode – Measure distance tracking on the go with GPS.
5. Save & Export – Store and share your land map and measurements.
Accurately measure areas, perimeters, and distances on maps with GPS Area Measure by Mapulator. Perfect for land measurement, agriculture, surveying, construction, and more.
Precise Mapping Tool for Professionals & Enthusiasts
Mapulator is the ultimate mapping tool for professionals and enthusiasts. Whether you're a land surveyor, real estate agent, farmer, construction manager, or simply curious about your surroundings, Mapulator provides the precision and flexibility you need. Easily calculate areas, distances, and radii directly on the map, transforming your mobile device into a powerful measurement instrument. 
Get GPS Area Measure - Mapulator, the free measuring app that simplifies land surveying, distance calculations, and area measurements for iPhone users.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://mapulator.app/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00086158:ios.name: Tappsk: ToDo & Habit Tracker
bluejetty:00086158:ios.summary:
Our mission is to replace your planner, habit tracker, reminder app, and calendar with a single app, so you can concentrate on whatever needs to be done instead of wasting time on each separate app.
We've put an incredible amount of effort
bluejetty:00086158:ios.description:
Our mission is to replace your planner, habit tracker, reminder app, and calendar with a single app, so you can concentrate on whatever needs to be done instead of wasting time on each separate app.
We've put an incredible amount of effort into our interface, and as a result it came out clean and simple, while at the same time uniting all of Tappsk's functionality on one screen.
Our pride and joy:
• The home screen, on which you can see all your tasks and can edit each date with the swipe of one finger.
• Forming helpful habits: they're easy to create and even easier to track.
• A calendar to see your list of tasks for a particular day.
• Reminders you'll never miss! Tappsk will keep reminding you of your pending task until you decide what you want to do with it.
• Using your voice to record your tasks has never been easier...
• Share your tasks: use any convenient method to send them to your friends and they'll automatically show up in their Tappsk.
• Subtasks: create checklists and divide your tasks into smaller chunks.
• An array of routine activities based on your interests: select and set the activities you do on a regular basis to appear as often as you like.
• Hidden lists: eg., lists of books or movies, which will not show up on the home screen.
• A logbook that allows you to analyze your task history from any given day.
Lots of tasks, one Tappsk :)
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact our support - hello@tappsk.com, we are always ready to improve!
"Premium" feature payment:
If you decide to use an unlimited number of recurring tasks, reminders, habits and the "share" function (this is optional), your iTunes account will be charged as soon as you confirm the purchase. The Premium subscription is billed annually.
The App Store will automatically renew your subscription after 1 year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://tappsk.com/privacy_policy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://tappsk.com/license.pdf
