bluejetty:00164532:ios.name: MVGO - Mobility app Munich
bluejetty:00164532:ios.summary: MVGO is the official mobility app of MVG, used by over 1 million people in Munich and the MVV region. It combines MVV tickets and subscriptions such as the Deutschlandticket, journey planning, real-time service updates, and sharing services
bluejetty:00164532:ios.description:
MVGO is the official mobility app of MVG, used by over 1 million people in Munich and the MVV region. It combines MVV tickets and subscriptions such as the Deutschlandticket, journey planning, real-time service updates, and sharing services from Voi, Dott, and MyRadl — all in one app. Register once and access everything directly in MVGO.
Public transport & sharing in one app
MVGO seamlessly connects public transport and sharing services. Find scooters and e-bikes from Voi and Dott, as well as bikes from MyRadl, directly on the map or in the route planner. Rent instantly via MVGO — no additional apps required, just your M-Login.
MyRadl – Free minutes with your Deutschlandticket
With the Deutschlandticket or other selected MVV subscriptions, you benefit from 30 free minutes per ride on a MyRadl Classic bike. Simply add your subscription in your MVGO profile under “Sharing benefits” and save automatically on every ride – flexible and affordable Munich and the surrounding MVV region.
MVVswipe, Deutschlandticket & MVV subscriptions
Whether it’s MVVswipe, the Deutschlandticket, or other MVV subscriptions – you’ll find the right ticket in the MVGO app. No paper tickets, no queues – everything from booking to validation happens digitally.
Live Mode for stress-free travel
Stay on track with real-time departure updates, transfer forecasts, and alternative routes. Track your MVG bus or tram live on the map and adjust your walking speed accordingly. The location indicator helps you know exactly when to get off – even underground.
Trusted in Munich
With over 2 million downloads and 17,000+ reviews, MVGO is one of the most widely used mobility apps in the region. Join now and use the official MVG app for tickets, sharing, and real-time travel information.
Download MVGO now and explore Munich!
Notes
(1) Mobile tickets are valid throughout the entire MVV network.
(2) No guarantee can be given for the accuracy or completeness of information.

bluejetty:00036236:ios.description:
Recipe Keeper & Saver - Recify: Your Ultimate Cookbook Organizer & Manager
Transform your cooking experience with Recify, the smartest recipe keeper and meal planner app available today! Save and organize all your favorite recipes in one beautifully designed digital cookbook. Never lose track of that perfect dinner idea again!
The Ultimate Recipe Saver for Food Enthusiasts
Effortlessly collect and save recipes from social media platforms and websites with just one tap. Our powerful AI technology instantly transforms even the messiest recipe posts into clean, organized cookbook formats that make your cooking journey seamless and enjoyable.
Your Personal Cookbook Manager
Recify works as your personal cookbook organizer and manager, helping you build a comprehensive digital collection of your favorite meals. Whether you're planning a quick weeknight dinner or preparing a special meal plan for the entire week, having your recipes organized in one place makes cooking more efficient and enjoyable.
Plan Your Week with the Meal Planner
Recify's meal planner turns scattered recipes into a clear weekly plan. Map out your week by adding the recipes you want to cook to any day, then see your whole week at a glance. Just pick from the recipes you've already saved in your Recify collections and drop them onto the days you want, so you always know what's for dinner before you step into the kitchen.
Key Features That Make Cooking Better
• Instant Recipe Import: Seamlessly save recipes from any website, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or YouTube link with a single tap
• AI-Powered Transformation: Watch as our technology converts unstructured recipe posts into beautifully organized cookbook-style formats
• Custom Recipe Collections: Create personalized collections to organize your recipes by cuisine, occasion, or meal type
• Step-by-Step Cooking View: Follow clear, distraction-free instructions while cooking your favorite meals
• Food Recipe Library: Build your comprehensive personal cookbook with all your favorite food recipes in one place
• Macro and calories for every recipe
Coming Soon: Even More Exciting Features
• Smart Grocery Shopping Lists: Automatically generate shopping lists that adjust ingredients based on serving sizes
• Recipe Upload Options: Add recipes from photos, scans, or manual entry
• AI Recipe Chat: Ask questions about ingredients, cooking methods, substitutions, and more
• Cooking Time Optimizer: Find recipes that fit your available preparation time
• Grocery List Integration: Seamlessly connect your meal plan to create efficient shopping lists
Why Food Lovers Choose Recify
Recify isn't just a recipe keeper, it's a complete cooking companion that helps you discover, save, and prepare delicious meals. Whether you're looking for quick dinner ideas or planning elaborate meals, our cookbook manager keeps everything organized in one beautiful, user-friendly interface.
From saving that perfect pasta recipe you found online to planning your entire weekly meals, Recify streamlines your cooking process from inspiration to plate. Say goodbye to scattered recipes and hello to organized, stress-free cooking!
Subscription Options
Get unlimited access to premium features with Recify Pro:
• Monthly or yearly subscription plans available
• Unlimited recipe uploads and saves
• Create multiple cookbook collections
• Automatic access to all future pro features as they launch
Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage your subscriptions easily in Account Settings. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current subscription period.
Transform your cooking experience today by downloading Recify!

DYNAMIC SLID
bluejetty:00170747:ios.description:
PixFolio is a photo gallery and slideshow app for iCloud, Google Photos, Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, Dropbox, pCloud, and Flickr. Designed for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, PixFolio brings your cherished memories to life.
DYNAMIC SLIDESHOWS
Transform your device into an advanced digital picture frame. Enjoy auto-updating slideshows with custom animations, video playback, clock, weather, and photo info from your favorite cloud photo storage:
· iCloud
· Google Photos
· Google Drive
· Microsoft OneDrive
· Dropbox
· pCloud
· Flickr
Refine the slideshow so it is as beautiful as your memories:
· A dozen slide animations
· Play videos, muted or unmuted
· Auto update when new photos and videos are added
· Add clock, weather, and photo info
· Change font and size
· Shuffle (randomize) or play using the current sort
· Auto start slide show when app starts
· Slideshow a folder, an account, or all accounts
· Schedule times for the slideshow to sleep
DISPLAY
· Auto resize pictures to fill screen
· Showcase your images with blurred photo backgrounds
· Multiple thumbnail layouts (list, square, 4:3, collage, etc)
· Sort folders by photo info
LOCK PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Lock access to your photos and videos. Keep your photos hidden by locking down teh app with PIN and Touch ID. Protect your privacy and secure access to your cloud photos today.
CHROMECAST & APPLE TV
Cast photos and videos to Chromecast enabled devices or smart TVs. Install the app to your Apple TV to show photos on your big screen.
OFFLINE ACCESS
Save folders for offline access to enjoy your images anytime, anywhere, without network delays. Opt for thumbnails or offline video storage to optimize space.
MORE
· Share photos
· Set a starting folder for each account
· Download folders to camera roll
· Hide folders you don't want to see
· Enable passworded read only mode to prevent changes
· View photo and video info
· Enable maximum brightness
· Enable dark mode
· Filter pictures by favorites, name, or caption
CUSTOMER EXAMPLES
· Grandparents: Keep up with grandchildren with auto-updating slideshows in read-only mode from Google Photos.
· Businesses: Display marketing materials and menus, updating remotely from Microsoft OneDrive.
· Schools: Convert PowerPoints to images for auto-updating digital signage on an Apple TV using Google Drive.
· Memorial services: Create a moving slideshow of memories to honor a loved one.
· Lock the app with PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID for added privacy
PURCHASE
iCloud and local photos are always free to use in PixFolio. Connection to Google Photos, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Flickr requires a low cost purchase:
· A monthly renewable subscription: Enjoy everything for 1 month with a 7 day trial.
· A six month renewable subscription: Enjoy everything for 6 months with a 7 day trial.
· A one time Lifetime purchase: Enjoy everything forever.
· A one time Business purchase: Enjoy priority support.
Yearly subscription starts with a 7-day free trial. After 7-day free trial, your Apple ID account will be charged and renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Download PixFolio today and showcase your cherished photos and videos.

bluejetty:00060669:ios.description:
If your library uses Atriuum as its cataloging software, you can download Librista - the companion app for patrons. With Librista, you can search the library’s online catalog and view your items out, renew and reserve items, create book lists, and more. 
To begin, use the Library Locator to find your Atriuum library by location or searching. To log on, enter the same credentials you normally use to access your library’s account. Based on your library’s policies, you may be able to register for a new account. 
Librista features:
- View trending and newly added items.
- Access eBooks if your library partners with other providers.
- Place holds on books, DVDs, etc. 
- Watch subjects, authors, or series to be notified if your library acquires new items.
- Save items and categorize them in book lists, such as Favorites, To Be Read, etc.
- Find out about community groups/events if your library posts this information.
- View account information, including items out, fines, etc. 
- Set preferences for when you receive alerts (based on your library’s notification policies). 
- Scan ISBNs to see if your library has a specific book before you purchase it.
- Switch between different catalogs if you sometimes visit other libraries in your area.

Introducing the Construction Master 5, an innovative feet-inch-fraction builder's calculator that revolutionizes project efficiency and ac
bluejetty:00128687:ios.description:
FREE Try Before You Buy trial, your App Store account is not charged by Apple during the free trial.
Introducing the Construction Master 5, an innovative feet-inch-fraction builder's calculator that revolutionizes project efficiency and accuracy. For over thirty years, this award-winning tool has been a vital asset in North America's construction industry, trusted by professionals for its precision and reliability. 
The Construction Master 5 was built for professionals, including Builders, Contractors, Designers, Fabricators, Framers, Carpenters, Tradesmen, and Advanced Do-It-Yourselfers.
-----
VERSATILE FUNCTIONALITY FOR CONSTRUCTION PROFESSIONALS
-----
• Tailored to meet the needs of Builders, Contractors, and Designers
• Essential for Fabricators and Framers/Carpenters
• Invaluable for Tradesmen across specialties
• Perfect for Advanced Do-It-Yourselfers requiring precise measurements
• Aim to enhance speed, accuracy, and productivity in dimension-focused projects
-----
OPTIMIZED FOR MOBILE DEVICES
-----
• Compatible with both iPhone and iPad
• Replicates the trusted functions of our traditional handheld calculators
• Enhanced with exclusive features for mobile users
• User-friendly design with a comprehensive User’s Guide
• Includes Searchable help and a 'press and hold' feature for instant help on functions, supported by tutorial videos
-----
ADVANCED CALCULATION CAPABILITIES
-----
• Equipped with a robust core engine from Calculated Industries
• Assures unmatched reliability and precision
• Perfect for construction or DIY projects requiring exact measurements
• Offers powerful built-in solutions for layouts, plans, bids, and estimates
• Works in and converts between various dimensional formats, including imperial and metric units
-----
COMPREHENSIVE BUILT-IN SOLUTIONS
-----
• Extensive dimensional math and conversion capabilities
• Features complete right angle and rafter calculations
• Includes area and volume solutions for square, cubic, and circular calculations
• Special functions like Board Feet, Cost per Unit, and Advanced Paperless Tape
• User-definable preferences and memory function for personalized use
-----
ENHANCED APP FEATURES
-----
• Entry-editing Backspace Key for easy corrections
• Context-sensitive help is available for each function
• Ability to save or email calculations and outputs like cut lists
• Facilitates complex calculations with ease
• Designed for efficient use in the field, office, or on the go
With the Construction Master 5, take your construction and DIY projects to the next level of efficiency and precision. This tool not only simplifies complex calculations but also brings a new level of professionalism and accuracy to your work. 
Whether working on the job site, in the office or tackling a home project, the Construction Master 5 is your indispensable partner, ensuring that every measurement and calculation is on point. Upgrade your toolkit with the Construction Master 5 and experience the future of construction and project planning today.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Your Free Trial period is free of charge. Subscriptions offered will automatically renew at the end of the chosen period. Upon purchase confirmation and completion of a free trial, payment will be charged to your Apple account. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off or the subscription is canceled in settings at least one day (24 hours) before the subscription period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple account Settings > Account (Apple ID) > Subscriptions. 
TRADEMARKS
Construction Master® and Calculated Industries® are registered trademarks of Calculated Industries, Inc.
Copyright 2024

bluejetty:00088228:ios.description:
Omi AI records your meetings and conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries, action items, and memories — across iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, the web, and when paired with Omi wearable devices (Omi Pendant / Omi Glass).
Stay focused and present in meetings, classes, or daily chats while Omi captures everything. Later, just search, ask, share, or export. Real privacy and control. Start for free or go unlimited.
Download now and unlock your super memory! Features (aka Superpowers!):
Capture Everything:
- Transcribes everything you say and hear
- Auto-generates summaries, tasks, and memories
- 25+ languages (mono/multi-speaker + translation)
- Precision recognition (Speech Profiles)
- Online/Offline: Record live or without a connection
Recall Instantly:
- Search across summaries, tasks, and memories
- Ask Omi AI (context-aware + web search)
- Daily Recap (your day at a glance)
- Brain Map (visualize how your memories connect)
- Tap, talk & answer: Instant responses
Automate Your Work:
- Sync action items with your favorite apps
- Custom summary templates
- App Marketplace (thousands of tools)
- Folders & favorites to stay organized
- Quick share for transcripts and summaries
Build & Extend:
- Open Source: Open hardware + software
- API + MCP Server: Work with your own data
- One-click AI apps: Create no-code tools
- Custom STT: Choose your own transcription provider
- Publish to the Omi App Store
Own Your Data:
- Enterprise security: SOC 2 + HIPAA
- Run locally (go cloud-free if you prefer)
- Encryption: TLS in transit + AES-256 at rest
- Full, easy export
- Delete specific items or everything whenever you want
You just got yourself a second brain!

bluejetty:00138887:ios.description:
Simply snap or upload a photo of an image of rocks, crystals, minerals and gems. The all-in-one Stone Identifier app will tell you all the information about it in a few seconds.
Are you looking to learn more about stones and gems? Do you want to know the name of the stone you own? Are you curious about the details and properties of the stones and gems you own? 
Here is it! Our Stone Identifier app will satisfy all your needs!
Key Features: 
- Stone Identification Kit
Take a photo of any stone or gem you have, and the Stone Identifier app will instantly provide accurate information. This rock scanning application can identify a variety of rock types, helping to identify, test and discover information about rock properties.
- Library of Stones & Gems
Stone Identifier provides a list of stones classified according to their uses and characteristics such as: Healing Crystals, Tumbling Stones, Birthtones, Zodiac Gemstone
- Chat directly with stone experts
This Stone Identifier application not only provides you with stone identification, but also helps you expand your knowledge and answer questions about this field with stone experts by chatting directly via chat.
- Real and fake gems
Diverse articles on gemstone, crystal identification methods, helping users learn for themselves how to determine whether gemstones are real or not.
- Create attractive rock collections
Collect your rocks and minerals by adding desired rocks, crystals and gems to your Collection.
- Metal detector
Have you lost a metal object and are struggling to find it? With the Stone Identifier app and specifically our Metal Detector function, you can quickly locate metals by measuring the surrounding magnetic field strength. Put an end to the frequent loss of metal objects.
Join us now and don't miss the door to the world of stones, crystals, minerals and gems as well as the opportunity to improve your knowledge to soon become an expert in the future!
Please note that terms and conditions, as well as our privacy policy, apply.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/terms-of-service-rock-scanner
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacy-policy-rock-scanner
For any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the app, please contact us.
Contact us: contacts.stoneidentifierapp@gmail.com.

* Create Stunning Video from your Photos
* Add our in-built movie Themes and make your albums with your photos
* Add Animated backgrounds to your video
* Add Music from our in-built library
* You can choose song or music of your own choice if you wish
* You can arrange the images according to your choice
* Add Title to your Video/Photo
* Option to choose photos from your camera roll
* In-built option to share your Awesome video with social networking sites
* You can share on Facebook, Instagram, email, YouTube, Viddy etc
Steps to create your movie 
1. Select Create Project and select your Aspect Ratio and all photos from your album. 
2. Add your Favourite transition. 
3. Select your background, background
4. Select animation transition
5. Select music from music library or from our app. 
6. Add effects to photos. 
7. Enter your movie title. 
8. Click on done button to create your movie. 
9. Share with your friends(supports Facebook,Instagram, email,YouTube ,Viddy etc). 
Or 
You can use our huge collection of Themes and make movie with photos and videos too.
How Does VideoMaker App Works?
You don't need be a video editor at all to use this app. Just use our app as a movie maker. VideoMaker app will analyze your photos and focus on users automatically and creates a professional looking movie from photos that you have selected. 
It will give you an option to select effect and music according to your Choice/mood and make your video even more interesting/Compiling.

bluejetty:00149888:ios.name: Corporate Phone
bluejetty:00149888:ios.summary: We built Corporate Phone for small businesses, but it’s useful for anyone who cares about personal privacy. With Corporate Phone, you get a second number that routes to your existing device. Choose your own number with almost any U.S. area
bluejetty:00149888:ios.description:
We built Corporate Phone for small businesses, but it’s useful for anyone who cares about personal privacy. With Corporate Phone, you get a second number that routes to your existing device. Choose your own number with almost any U.S. area code. And of course, enjoy unlimited calling and texting without any extra fees. Great for anyone who wants to keep their personal number out of the hands of scammers, marketers, and strangers.
PHONE NUMBER PRIVACY
We believe your primary phone number is sacred. Keep it with your nearest and dearest, and get a second number for government paperwork, online shopping, the apps, clients and customers, or even just your weird neighbor who you don’t like that much. They’ll never know the difference.
UNLIMITED CALLING & TEXTING
No per message or per minute fees. Get started immediately—no restrictions on SMS or MMS.
CHOOSE YOUR OWN AREA CODE
You don’t want your number to look sketchy. Choose a phone number with almost any U.S. area code you want.
CUSTOM VOICEMAIL
Set up your voicemail with a personalized greeting with whatever vibe you’re going for—professional, casual, or totally anonymous. Customize how many rings you want before a call goes to voicemail, and decide how long to store voicemails. All voicemails are downloadable, including transcripts.
SPAM & UNWANTED CALLER BLOCKING
Block robocalls, spam, and repeat offenders. Get into a flow without interruptions.
CONTACTS MANAGER
Maintain a list of contacts for easy access to their info.
LOW MONTHLY COST, EASY CANCELLATION 
No contract—cancel anytime with a few clicks inside your account.
WHO THIS IS FOR
Small businesses, freelancers, side hustlers, online sellers, landlords, event planners, remote workers, active daters—anyone who enjoys work-life balance, privacy, and organized communications.

bluejetty:00119420:ios.name: NOVAmobile
bluejetty:00119420:ios.summary: Designed with today’s workplace demands in mind, NOVAtime’s Mobility Suite offers true Workforce Management / Time and Attendance functionality on the go. Whether you are a remote employee or a manager supervising a team of employees in the
bluejetty:00119420:ios.description:
Designed with today’s workplace demands in mind, NOVAtime’s Mobility Suite offers true Workforce Management / Time and Attendance functionality on the go. Whether you are a remote employee or a manager supervising a team of employees in the field, NOVAmobile offers flexibility that allows you to accomplish critical workforce management tasks when and where needed. 
Powered by NOVAtime’s industry-leading SaaS solution, the NOVAmobile application incorporates many of the latest NOVAtime 5000 features to transcend typical Time and Attendance. From an HR, Payroll, and Accounting perspective, NOVAtime is a strategic part of the daily management of your company.
Additionally, the intuitive interface minimizes the learning curve and puts the power of data in your hands immediately. NOVAmobile offers easy configuration and installation, while also providing secure access to authorized users only. For large organizations and those supporting BYOD policies, general validation procedures further streamline app deployment. 
Key employee features:
- Clock in/out
- Perform job/project transfers
- Review/submit timesheets
- View current and upcoming work schedules
- View accrual balances
- Request sick leave, vacation, etc.
- View time-off requests
- Submit expense reports
- View and edit employee profile
Key supervisor features:
- Review/manage timesheets (add/edit/delete time)
- Approve timesheets
- Submit team punches/transfers
- Build teams on the go
- Review/approve time-off requests
- Enable geo-fencing auto-transfer and lockout capability
Additional features:
- Offline punching to support transactions in remote areas (data synchronizes once network is connected)
- Duel supervisor/employee functionality to allow users to toggle seamlessly between roles
- GPS capture upon punch transactions to accurately track work locations
Important Notes:
1. Server configuration is required for app usage.
2. To access app features, your employer/organization must be an existing client using the NOVAtime 5000 Workforce Management SaaS solution.
3. Contact your system administrator or an authorized reseller to configure app access on your device.
Disclaimers: NOVAmobile is designed and built for iOS devices.
1. Use of the NOVAmobile app requires data usage, subject to additional charges. Data charges will depend on the mobile phone service provider and actual usage patterns.
2. This app collects and transmits (or allows the transmission of) geolocation information to the NOVAtime Workforce Management solution. The app accesses geolocation information for the sole purpose of recording the location of employee time punches to allow supervisors/managers to verify permissible work premises. The app saves geolocation information within separate electronic timesheets for each employee. GPS data capture requires employee (app user) authorization. Location information will not be collected if GPS is not authorized.
3. The app transmits geolocation information only to the NOVAtime database of the client company with which an employee is associated. Geolocation information collected by the app is the property of the client and may be used and shared at the client’s discretion. NOVAtime is not responsible for the client’s release of geolocation information.
4. GPS location accuracy depends on physical location, signal strength, and the mobile phone service provider. NOVAtime cannot guarantee the capture of exact locations.

bluejetty:00038479:ios.description:
▼With the EX app, you can:
- Reserve Shinkansen seats through the app easily
- Discount for early booking
- Reserve Shinkansen seats up to 1 year in advance
- You can make as many changes as you need, free of charge, before getting on the train
- Reserve a set of Shinkansen seats and hotel rooms!
- Reserve activities, hotels and car rentals!
- Select any seat from the seat map (*reserved seats only)
- Information on services available in stations and trains
- You can log in quickly by using fingerprint authentication. 
(only for compatible models)
▼ Main features
- Membership registration
- Purchase ticket/Reserve seats (time designation, train name designation, easy free seat reservation)）
- Confirm reservation
- Change and refund reservation (reducing the number of persons)
- Display purchase history and receipt
- Check, change member information
- Display QR-Ticket for boarding
- Designate or register IC card for boarding
- Service status information (Link)
▼ Notes
- Membership registration is required to use this app. For registration, personal information is required, such as member name, date of birth, and a valid credit card, etc.
- Ticket purchase (reservation) payment will be taken from the credit card registered on the account.
-- You need to register or designate IC card for public transportation (*) to travel ticketless with IC card.
(*) Kitaca, PASMO, Suica, manaca, TOICA, PiTaPa, ICOCA, Hayakaken, nimoca, SUGOCA
- You need the pickup code to pick up tickets from ticket vending machines, etc., at main stations of Tokaido Sanyo Kyushu Shinkansen, such as Tokyo, Kyoto, Shin-Osaka, Hiroshima, Hakata, Kumamoto etc.
- Please do not use this app to make a seat reservation for Japan Rail Pass.
- This service is available only in English.
- For more details on this service, please see the website.
*The email address below is for inquiries about application specifications. Please note that we cannnot answer inquiries about the service.

bluejetty:00025335:ios.description:
Connect the Dots: Line Puzzle
Dot Line Puzzle is a fun and challenging brain game designed to train your mind and improve logical thinking. If you love simple yet addictive puzzles, this puzzle game is perfect for you! Tap, link, and connect the dots with a single line to complete each level. It’s a relaxing and smart way to pass the time while boosting your brainpower.
How to Play Line Connect Game:
Connect all dots using one continuous line.
Avoid retracing the same dot line twice.
Think carefully and plan your moves using brain.
Each new level introduces a unique puzzle challenge.
Brain Game Features:
Hundreds of carefully designed logic puzzles.
Increasing difficulty to challenge your brain.
Smooth connect controls and minimalistic visuals.
No time limits – play at your own pace.
Hints available when you get stuck.
Play offline anytime, anywhere.
Whether you want a relaxing puzzle to wind down or a brain teaser to test your skills, Connect the Dots has you covered. With a clean interface, satisfying gameplay, and rewarding progression, this dot linking puzzle will keep you engaged for hours.
Why You'll Love Dot Connect:
Simple mechanics, deep strategy
Great for improving brain focus and memory
Daily brain training with new challenges
Free to play with optional hints
If you're a fan of connect puzzles, line mazes, or flow-style games, you’ll enjoy every level of this dot connecting journey. Each puzzle helps develop mental agility and spatial awareness while offering a calming, satisfying experience.
Ready to take the mind challenge? Download now and start connecting the dots!

bluejetty:00156383:ios.description:
LUXY Ride connects travelers searching for an affordable and reliable airport transfer with licensed and professional black car chauffeurs anywhere. 
Every trip is supported by our cutting-edge technology and 24/7 Live Client Care, ensuring a stress-free journey, every time. 
- Always all-inclusive pricing with taxes, tolls, and gratuity upfront
- Simply schedule your black car service for any occasion
- Reliable and stress-free booking all in one place
HOW IT WORKS
We partnered with the largest network of certified professional chauffeurs and built technology to increase their efficiency on the road while reducing carbon emissions. By minimizing the wasted fuel and time spent traveling empty, we can then pass those savings on to the traveler. 
BOOK A RIDE ANYWHERE
Schedule an airport transfer for near on-demand or well in advance at 100+ airports and in 5,000+ cities around the US. The LUXY Ride app is making black car service easy and affordable.
RECEIVE UPDATED ALERTS
No more missing flights because your ride didn’t show up. With LUXY Ride, you can stay notified when your chauffeur is on the way, track your flight status, and so much more right from the app. 
SECURE YOUR TRIP
Selecting Trip Protection guarantees your airport pickup when there is a last-minute change like Flight Delays, Diversions, or Cancellations. Don’t get left behind without transportation, add coverage to your ride and we’ll be there when you need it.
RATE YOUR CHAUFFEUR
Let us know how we’re doing and if you enjoyed your experience by submitting a 5-star rating and comments after your trip. 
> Safe and Reliable
We partner only with professionally certified chauffeurs and licensed limousine companies. Unlike rideshare, every ride is monitored by our 24/7 Care team and if you have a question you can actually reach us. 
--Save $50 Today!
Just join the Ride Rewards program and you can earn free rewards for every ride you complete. Sign up today from https://luxyride.com/join/ride-rewards

bluejetty:00115673:ios.description:
Build your dream wardrobe with an AI fashion stylist: organize clothes, get custom outfit ideas, and shop what’s missing—all to make you feel more confident, no matter what. 
Meet OnStyle—an AI outfit maker with your own clothes, color analysis, and a digital closet organizer that makes every look uniquely yours. Whether you’re planning outfits for work, packing for a trip, or solving the daily “what do I wear?” stress, this app helps you get dressed with ease. 
With OnStyle, you get: 
• An organized, personalized closet—a visual wardrobe built from your own clothes and curated essentials that’s easy to browse, style, and re-style. 
• Custom outfit ideas—daily looks matched to your style, location, weather forecast, and wardrobe with items you can shop instantly. 
• Expert-guided styling—smart AI suggestions shaped by real stylist insights with the colors that flatter you most. 
Once you’re in the app, you can: 
• BUILD YOUR DIGITAL WARDROBE 
Easily create your customized digital wardrobe. Simply snap or upload photos of your own clothes, and OnStyle will keep them neatly sorted by category. Want to skip the uploading? This wardrobe clothing app can create a curated essentials capsule collection using items from its built-in library. 
• WORK WITH YOUR PERSONAL AI STYLIST 
Experience the luxury of having your own expert-trained AI fashion stylist. OnStyle understands your style, performs a precise color analysis, and checks the weather to suggest looks that suit you perfectly. 
• GET DAILY OUTFIT INSPIRATION 
Wake up to fresh outfit ideas tailored to your location, weather forecast, and style. Find outfit inspo that goes beyond your wardrobe and gives you the confidence to try something new. From busy mornings to special events, your AI fashion stylist will help you decide what to wear in seconds. 
• FIND YOUR COLOR MATCH 
Identify your personal color palette with a quick color analysis when you first open the app. OnStyle will then highlight the shades that flatter you most and use them in every outfit recommendation. 
• SAVE AND PLAN YOUR FAVORITE LOOKS 
Save your favorite looks, create a list of go-to items, and build your personal outfit archive. As your handy outfit planner, OnStyle helps you make the most of what you already own and plan looks for any occasion. 
• GET EXPERT-BASED TIPS 
Receive outfit suggestions based on real stylist insights. Your AI closet organizer and outfit planner will help you create looks that are personalized and exciting. 
HOW IT WORKS 
1. Discover your colors—start your journey with a quick color analysis to see which shades flatter you most. 
2. Build a personalized closet—upload your clothes or add curated essentials to create a visual wardrobe. 
3. Explore outfit ideas—browse expert-guided looks tailored to your style, lifestyle, and wardrobe. 
4. Save, plan, and shop—keep favorites, organize outfits with your AI outfit planner, and check price and purchase details. 
Feel the difference in your mirror—and in your confidence. Download OnStyle to make every look feel truly yours! 
FAQ 
Q: Do I need to upload photos of my wardrobe? 
A: Not necessarily. You can upload your own clothes or start instantly with a curated essentials capsule wardrobe—whatever works best for you. 
Q: Will the app help me shop for new items? 
A: Yes. You can view prices and buy items you love right from your outfit suggestions. 
Q: Are my looks private? 
A: Absolutely. Your photos and personal information stay securely on your device and are used only to create personalized recommendations. 
ONSTYLE PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION 
• Your subscription gives you unlimited access to all app features. 
• Payments are charged automatically based on your selected plan. 
By using OnStyle, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: 
https://aiby.mobi/style/privacy/en/
https://aiby.mobi/style/terms/en/

bluejetty:00095131:ios.description:
Show your love to your partner and strengthen your relationship with Honest!
Honest is a game app designed to bring partners closer through intimate questions and answers, exchanging warm messages in a shared chat, and tracking meaningful dates. The app is suitable for any couple — it doesn't matter how long you've been together; what matters is that you want to understand your partner better and be closer.
With Honest, you can:
- Send questions and unlock each other's honest answers.
- Get sweet, thoughtful messages from your partner.
- Explore deep questions that inspire real conversations.
- Celebrate milestones, like anniversaries or your first date.
- Track your streaks and relationship progress.
Premium Features (Honest+):
- Access expert-designed deep questions.
- Explore guided journeys based on love languages, conflict resolution, and more.
- Play quizzes and games made for couples at every stage.
- Personalize your experience and go deeper, together.
Why couples are trying Honest:
- Built to strengthen your relationship, one question at a time.
- Inspired by leading relationship research and expert insights.
- Designed for couples at any stage — dating, married, or long-distance.
- Backed by a growing community of couples who want to connect more deeply.
Includes in-app purchases.
Our app offers two auto-renewing subscription options: $14.99 per month or $39.99 per year. Once you've confirmed your order, the payments will be charged to your account at the right price for your country. The subscription will automatically renew at its end date. You can stop the automatic renewal at any time. To avoid the renewal, cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the date of your subscription. No refund is available for unused time.
Ready to take your conversations and relationship to the next level? Download Honest and start building deeper connections today!
Terms of Use: https://thehonestapp.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://thehonestapp.com/privacy

Be a SUPER STAR and play in front of a huge crowd in My City: Popstar, where all the lights are on you!
Sing songs in more than a million ways on the concert stage, with the help of your own band! After the success, be sure to sign your music CD, take interviews and talk with your fans! Before the next concert be sure to relax in your own band bus, play mini games, dance and play in all of the games' locations. 
8 new locations including concert stage, dressing room and your very own bus. 20 characters ready to sing your own songs!
- All My City games connect to each other, Easily Move characters and items between games.
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: Easy enough for 4-year-olds to play and super exciting for 12 years to enjoy. My City games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
TO CONNECT THE GAME TO OTHER MY CITY GAMES:
Please ensure that all your My City games are installed and updated in your device.
PLAY TOGETHER
We support multi-touch so kids can play games together with friends and family on the same screen!
WE LOVE CREATING CHILDREN GAMES!
If you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City please do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames/
ABOUT US
My Town Games studio develops digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

Welcome to Spades Fever, the ultimate Spades classic card game! Immerse yourself in the world of Spades and fall in love with the world of classic spades card games like never before. Chat with your friends and tell them you're playing Spades Fever for an unforgettable multiplayer experience or challenge other live players online. Boost your stats by playing this classic spades card game with a touch of innovation now! 
Have you heard of the classic spades card game? Let us train you! If you like other classical card games like Hearts, Euchre, Pinochle, Rummy, or Whist, you'll love Spades Fever! A winning combination of simplicity, social interaction, strategy, and cultural influences has contributed to the timeless popularity of classic spades card games. 
If you already know how to play spades…
In Spades Fever, the spades cards take center stage, providing players with thrilling solo modes, challenging bids, and exciting daily challenges. As you immerse yourself in the spades world, you'll discover the joy of playing free spades with friends or engaging in intense multiplayer battles. The essence of spades card games is beautifully captured in Spades Fever, where timeless gameplay meets the modern era. 
Sharpen your skills 
Strategize your moves and Bid wisely to conquer each round! 
Whether you prefer classic spades, or want to explore new modes, Spades Fever has it all. 
Spades Fever Features
Enjoy this social game and chat with live players worldwide! 
Play Solo Spades in this 4 players card game 
Competitive Leaderboards - Become the brightest Spades Master! 
HD Graphics and a Beautiful Design 
Unique live trick-taking card games 
Several game options to boost your stats 
Outstanding card animations 
Free Bonuses Hourly & Daily! 
Embark on an offline adventure or connect with friends for an online multiplayer spectacle. Challenge opponents, train your brain, earn trophies, and unlock special prizes as you boost your ranking. 
The Spades Fever community is super welcoming, creating a space where classic Spades enthusiasts gather to celebrate their love for the game. Spades Fever is not just a card game; it's a journey through the world of spades. With daily challenges, special events, and a range of classic modes, Spades Fever ensures every player experiences the thrill of a spades card game like never before by rewarding both strategy and social connections. Download the game now and become a part of the Spades Fever community. 
Experience the classic spades card game in a new light, where every play, every bid, and every triumph adds to the legacy of Spades Fever.

bluejetty:00142672:ios.name: Notewise - AI Notes, PDF, Docs
bluejetty:00142672:ios.summary:
Featured multiple times on the App Store. 8M+ downloads. Trusted by millions worldwide.
Your meetings, lectures, ideas, and research don’t arrive in one format. Your notes shouldn’t have to either. Notewise brings together what you write,
bluejetty:00142672:ios.description:
Featured multiple times on the App Store. 8M+ downloads. Trusted by millions worldwide.
Your meetings, lectures, ideas, and research don’t arrive in one format. Your notes shouldn’t have to either. Notewise brings together what you write, record, draw, read, and save. Capture it once, then find it again, ask about it, learn from it, and build on it.
Notewise is an AI note-taking app for iPhone and iPad with handwritten notes, audio recording and transcription, PDF annotation, documents, web sources, and AI search and chat.
■ CAPTURE EVERYTHING IN ONE NOTE
• Write, type, or handwrite notes
• Sketch ideas and diagrams on a freeform canvas
• Record meetings, lectures, conversations, and voice notes
• Import 25+ file formats, including PDFs, documents, slides, images, and more
• Add website links and bring web research into your notes
• Scan paper notes and whiteboards
Start with whatever is in front of you. Add things in any order, and keep related notes, recordings, files, and ideas together as you go.
■ SEARCH & ASK ACROSS YOUR NOTES
Search handwritten notes, typed text, audio transcripts, PDFs, documents, and images.
Ask Notewise AI about the note you’re in or across all your notes. Search the web when you need more context. Answers can cite the notes, recordings, files, and sources behind them, so you can always see where the information came from.
Search less. Pick up where you left off and keep thinking.
■ RECORD, TRANSCRIBE & ASK IN REAL TIME
Stay focused on the meeting, lecture, or conversation instead of trying to write down every word.
• Automatic transcription in 20+ languages
• Key points, decisions, and next steps
• Ask questions while a meeting or lecture is still happening
• Ask across past recordings later
• Keep audio, meeting notes, PDFs, and related documents together
Meeting notes become more than transcripts. Class notes stay useful long after the lecture ends.
■ WRITE, DRAW & ANNOTATE FREELY
Handwrite a page. Draw a diagram. Work through a problem. Mark up a PDF. Move things around until the idea makes sense.
Choose from 30+ brushes and tools — including pencil, oil paint, watercolor, highlighter, lasso, tape, shapes, tables, rulers, sticky notes, and more. Start from 20+ templates or create your own, from Cornell notes to meeting notes and custom workflows.
■ TURN NOTES INTO FLASHCARDS, QUIZZES & PODCASTS
Good notes don’t all look the same. Turn study notes, meeting notes, or research into AI notes, summaries, flashcards, quizzes, podcasts, and more — using the same material in the format that helps you most.
Summarize a recording. Ask questions about a PDF. Search handwritten notes. Find connections across different notes.
Sometimes you want AI. Sometimes you just want a blank page. Notewise gives you both.
■ FOR WORK, STUDY & RESEARCH
Use Notewise for meeting notes, lecture recording, handwritten and digital notes, voice notes, PDF annotation, research papers, brainstorming, and search across everything you save.
On iOS 27, use Siri AI to create, edit, and find information in your notes, or Visual Intelligence to surface related content from what you see.
Whether you’re building a company, studying for an exam, researching your next idea, or simply trying to remember what matters, Notewise gives your thinking one place to grow.
■ PRIVACY FIRST
Notewise is built by a small, independent team. We don’t sell your data or show ads. Your notes are encrypted, secure, and under your control.
■ TRY NOTEWISE FREE
Start with 10 free canvas notes and import your own slides and documents. Explore Notewise with a 7-day free trial, while core features remain free to use.
Write. Record. Draw. Remember.
Privacy Policy: https://www.notewise.dev/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://www.notewise.dev/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00121523:ios.description:
Kingdom Rush Frontiers is a whole new level of the furiously fast, enchantingly charming gameplay that made kingdom Rush an award-winning Tower Defense hit.
Defend exotic lands from dragons, man-eating plants, and ghastly denizens of the underworld -all with flashy towers, levels, heroes, and more goodies to help you crush your enemies to a pulp.
BUILD MIGHTY TOWERS!
• OVER 18 TOWER ABILITIES! Unleash Death Riders, pestilence clouds, or assassins that steal and kill your enemies!
• 8 SPECIALIZED TOWER UPGRADES! Slice, sizzle, and stomp your foes with Crossbow Forts, Mighty Templars, Necromancers, and even Earthquake Machines - hey, we told you we were shaking things up.
• UPGRADE SYSTEM allows you to min/max your towers towards your preferred strategy.
• Fortify the frontier in exotic news lands - hold the line in deserts, jungles, and even the underworld!
TRAIN LEGENDARY HEROES
• 16 LEGENDARY HEROES. Choose among mighty champions and train their abilities! Each has unique specialties that fit different play styles and strategies!
• Special units and features on every stage! Watch out for the Black Dragon!
DEFEAT THEM ALL
• OVER 40 ENEMIES with unique abilities! Stay on your toes as you fight through desert sandworms, tribal shamans, nomad tribes, and underground terrors. Action like you have never seen before!
• MERCILESS BOSS FIGHTS! Hey, we told you to get those upgrades...
MORE MIND-BOGGLING CONTENT
• Hours of army with OVER 80 ACHIEVEMENTS! what can you expect from Ironhide Games, the creators of Kingdom rush? You will be hooked for hours searching for Easter eggs and achievements!
• IN-GAME ENCYCLOPEDIA! learn all about your enemies and you will be able to plan the best strategy to defeat them. Study up!
• CLASSIC, IRON, AND HEROIC GAME MODES to challenge your tactical skills!
• 3 DIFFICULTY MODES! Are you up for a real challenge? Go with Hard mode!
• PLAY IT OFFLINE! No internet? No problem! You will be able to jump into real action even offline!

bluejetty:00120278:ios.description:
Learn (European) Portuguese is an easy to use mobile Portuguese phrasebook that will give visitors to Portugal and those who are interested in learning Portuguese a good start in the language. 
*We also have Learn Brazilian Portuguese app, please search for Codegent Brazilian*
Learn Portuguese is recorded using a native speaker and we have tried our best to be authentic in the pronunciation whilst ensuring it is easy to understand. Recommended app for tourists and business people visiting Portugal and Portuguese speaking countries. 
FEATURES 
• Universal app works on iPhone, iPod Touch, & iPad 
• Carefully translated list of essential phrases 
• 200+ common words and phrases included for FREE 
• Upgrade and unlock all 1,000+ phrases in 18 categories 
• Audio recorded by native speakers 
• Option to playback audio at slower speed 
• No internet connection required 
• Highlight important words with tips 
• Store frequently used phrases in favourites 
• Search by words inside the app 
• No adverts or annoying popups 
CATEGORIES 
FREE Categories: 
* Greetings 
* General conversation 
* Numbers 
* Directions and places 
* Transportation 
* Eating out 
* Emergency 
PRO Categories: 
* Time and date 
* Accommodation 
* Shopping 
* Colours 
* Towns and provinces 
* Countries 
* Tourist attractions 
* Family 
* Dating 
* Feeling sick 
* Body parts
* Occasion phrases
* Sports
* Action words
* Tongue twisters 
• HOW TO RESTORE PURCHASES?

• WE READ EVERY E-MAIL. 
We're a small company, but we reply to every support request. Let us try to help at support@codegent.com and we will do our best to help in any way! 
THANKS FOR ALL THE SUPPORT IF YOU LIKE THE APP PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW :-)

bluejetty:00024137:ios.summary:
Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and more with Pestle.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE

bluejetty:00024137:ios.description:
Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and more with Pestle.
IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE
Import recipes from anywhere on the internet to Pestle, and keep just the ingredients and steps. Just tap 'Share', and 'Save to my Cookbook'. 
GUIDED COOKING
Turn any recipe into a step-by-step process with Pestle's guided cooking experience. Control Pestle hands-free for those messy recipes, set as many timers as you want & get reminders for quantities with just a tap.
DEVICE SYNC
Find a recipe on your iPhone, and cook it for dinner on your iPad with seamless, instant sync. For the power users, you can even switch between your iPad & iPhone with Handoff.
HOUSEHOLDS
Create a Pestle Household and share all of your recipes with your family, and create Meal Plans together, too!
DISCOVER
Pestle learns where you save recipes from and suggests to you their latest creations. Add your favorite foodie blogs and always stay up to date.
MEAL PLAN
Pestle can help you plan out your next 14-days by allowing you to assign recipes to each day. And, of course, syncs everywhere.
SHOPPING LIST
Take every ingredient from your recipe and add it to your shopping list! Already got Olive Oil? No worries, just tap it to remove it from your list.
BOOKMARKS
When Pestle isn't able to intelligently extract recipe details, Bookmarks are saved to take you straight back to the source.
RECIPE SCANNING
We get it, not all recipes are online. If you have a big collection of physical recipes, worry not, Pestle has a recipe scanner to digitize them! 
There's a lot more you can do with Pestle, but we'll let you discover it!
The use of Pestle is outlined in our Terms of Use, which can be found at https://pestlechef.app/terms.

Write like you're texting and get a beautiful journal. That's Mymory, your self-care journaling app!
Record your day with a gentle tree. End it on a warm note with Birdy.
Start journaling your feelings in a forest of your own, today.
"A few words like I'm talking, and my journal writes itself"
"Life-changing app... the world feels different since I met my tree"
THE TREE WRITES YOUR JOURNAL — AND WRITES BACK
No pressure. No blank page. Just tell the tree what's on your mind, like texting a friend.
The tree turns your words into a clean, lovely journal entry, and leaves you a warm reply.
Oh, and send a photo along. The tree will add a caption that just fits.
BIRDY, A LITTLE BIRD THAT CONNECTS HEARTS
Need a little empathy today? Send off Birdy, the little bird perched beside your tree.
Birdy discreetly sums up your story, carries it to another forest, and brings back a reply. From anywhere in the world!
TODAY'S PROMPT — SOMETHING FRESH EVERY DAY
Stuck on what to write? Today's Prompt has you covered, from fresh takes on everyday life to playful flights of imagination.
Then peek at Birdy stories from others who answered it. Half the fun!
FUN LITTLE HABITS, BUILT RIGHT IN
Every morning, crack open a cute Fortune Acorn for a peek at your day.
After each week, your Weekly Report arrives. One journal for the week, highlights, and a tip for the days ahead.
Ready to go deeper? Try Rituals: programs of questions curated by psychology-expert trees, made for truly getting to know yourself.
YOUR PRIVACY, SAFE AND SOUND
Everything you tell the tree, and every journal it writes, is encrypted and safe in your Mymory forest.
Add a passcode and Face ID, Touch ID lock, and it's a secret diary for your eyes only.
Journaling isn't easy. With Mymory, it finally feels easy enough to stick.
A few lines a day can clear your mind and grow your power to reflect.
Take the first step today!
Mymory keeps growing: easier journaling and new self-care features for your mental well-being.

bluejetty:00077138:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00077138:ios.description:
Features:
- designed for travel lovers to test if you can recognize a landmark, city, natural site or UNESCO World Heritage site from its satellite view.
- 1118 levels in total covering 190 famous landmarks, 168 famous cities, 109 natural sites and 651 UNESCO World Heritage sites.
- you can also choose a specific country (currently 10 countries are available) to guess its most famous landmarks, cities, natural sites and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
- zoom in and out the map to investigate the details and find clues.
- various hints to help you progress (show approximate locations, reveal a correct letter, remove all wrong letters, reveal answer).
- Info screen offers detailed explanation of how to make the most of the app.
- easy to understand user interface.
- absolutely no forced ads, but you can choose to watch an ad to earn coins.
--------
The game
Welcome to Geo Mania! It's a fun geography game where your goal is to recognize a location from the satellite view of it.
The game contains a number of different locations: many famous landmarks, cities, natural sites (rivers, lakes, etc), and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
You can choose the location type directly, or browse by country.
--------
Level
In each level you get to figure out a single location. You can scroll around and zoom in and out while trying to identify it.
There is also an "Explore" map available for you where you can, for example, try to find a similar-looking coastline containing the name of the object.
To win the level, you need to enter the name of the location in the "Answer" page (bottom right corner). It is recommended to go through the levels from Landmarks (Easy) to UNESCO World Heritage (Extra Hard).
--------
Hints
If you're stuck, there are a number of hints which you can use to help you identify the location. Click on the question mark icon on the top right corner of the level to use them.
Location hint: reveals an approximate location of the landmark/city/site. Repeated usages improve the precision.
Reveal a letter: reveal a letter of the correct answer.
Remove wrong letters: keep only the letters which are in the answer.
Solve the level: simply show the answer.
--------
Coins
Using hints costs in-game coins. You get them by completing the levels and voting (if you think the level is fun or not). If you still need more coins, please visit the purchase page.
--------
Privacy Policy: https://www.dong.digital/geomania/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.dong.digital/geomania/tos/
Have fun exploring the world from above!

bluejetty:00184897:ios.description:
Relisten is the easiest way to carry 210,000+ live concert recordings in your pocket. Thousands of Grateful Dead shows, every Phish show on phish.in, and tens of thousands more from archive.org's Live Music Archive. Every recording comes from the tapers' tradition: fan-recorded with the artists' blessing and free to stream.
Every night of every tour, in your pocket.
Whether you're chasing a run, digging into a new band, or just hunting for a great random show, Relisten makes the entire archive easy to browse, play, and take with you.
What you get:
• Gapless playback between tracks — segues stay intact, the way the band played them
• Download any show for offline listening, anywhere
• CarPlay support for the road
• Cast to Google Cast devices at home
• Scrobble every play to Last.fm
• Shuffle or repeat, one song or a full show
• Browse by artist, year, venue, song, and source (SBD, AUD, and more)
• Sort by ratings, popularity, and what's trending right now
• Taper notes on every recording
• "Surprise me" random show when you can't decide what to play next
• Free, ad-free, and open source
Deep catalogs from the Grateful Dead, Phish, Widespread Panic, Billy Strings, Tedeschi Trucks Band, Dead & Company, Joe Russo's Almost Dead, Goose, Phil Lesh & Friends, King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, The Disco Biscuits, String Cheese Incident, Ween, moe., Yonder Mountain String Band, and Umphrey's McGee — plus thousands more artists from the Live Music Archive.
Built by live music fans, for live music fans.
Follow @relistenapp or join the Relisten Discord for updates, feedback, and what's coming next.

bluejetty:00118742:ios.description:
Airtable is the easy way to create your own connected apps. From indie filmmakers to cattle farmers, creators and creatives around the world are using Airtable to organize their lives, their way.
Use Airtable to create flexible checklists, organize collections or ideas, and manage customers or contacts — all in one place. Get started instantly with a variety of templates ranging from home improvement to store inventory, or easily piece together your own layout from scratch.
With Airtable, your iOS device suddenly becomes a database creation powerhouse — designed to let you easily swipe and tap your way to fully custom databases. It’s collaborative in real-time, so you can share with friends and teammates and always see their latest changes.
Here are some ways that Airtable is being used today:
▸ Organizing People and Customers
* Sales and customers
* Recruiting
* Public relations and media lists
* Business development
* Personal CRM
* Volunteer management
* Sports clubs
* Boy or Girl Scouts
▸ Cataloging Collections, Ideas, and Inventory
* Store or restaurant inventory
* Product catalogs
* Personal clothing collections

· Instantly redesign rooms, exteriors, and gardens with AI-powered previews

bluejetty:00178481:ios.name: Metro Paris - Map & Routes
bluejetty:00178481:ios.summary:
Metro Paris Subway is the original and No. 1 selling application for getting around Paris, France.
◉ Metro Paris Subway is recommended by the Financial Times and the Los Angeles Times. Featured by Apple.
**********************************
bluejetty:00178481:ios.description:
Metro Paris Subway is the original and No. 1 selling application for getting around Paris, France.
◉ Metro Paris Subway is recommended by the Financial Times and the Los Angeles Times. Featured by Apple.
************************************************************
DESCRIPTION
************************************************************
Metro Paris Subway for iPhone is a comprehensive guide to traveling through Paris, France. It includes official subway maps. Metro Paris Subway is officially licensed by RATP of Paris.
◉ Latest official map of Paris Metro, RER (the additional regional express network of Paris) and Paris Bus. Detailed map of each line in Paris (Metro, RER, Tramway, and SNCF Transilien).
◉ Precise location of each station on the map (with a red circle). This application is fully compatible with Apple Maps, each station is represented by a red pin, a popup shows you the distance, and it's updated live (thanks to GPS) as you walk down the streets of Paris.
◉ The journey planner tool allows you to find automatically the best route to get to your destination in Paris Metro. Interactive map to choose your stations for the route. To get better Route results, please switch into Best Route in the settings.
◉ The journey planner does not require a network connection to operate, it works perfectly while in the subway.
◉ A bookmark manager allows you to save your stations and routes.
◉ The application locates the nearest metro stations from your position in Paris. You can also provide an address in Paris, all the stations closest to that address will be displayed.
◉ Paris Metro Service updates (Real time travel news) are available.
◉ Metro Paris Subway application has added push notification support that allows you to be notified in background, even if you have closed the application. This new feature allows you to receive Paris Metro alerts in real time, when a disrupted line is detected, a notification is automatically sent to your iPhone. A numbered badge to Metro Paris Subway application icon shows the current number of disrupted lines.
◉ Paris Bus map is now available. This option allows you to switch between the underground and bus systems at any time using the same application. This add-on includes the official Paris Buses map from RATP with the key bus routes and locates the nearest bus stations.
◉ This application is available in English, French, Spanish, German and Japanese.

bluejetty:00014129:ios.summary:
Thousands of readers use BookFusion to manage, read and enjoy over 2 million eBooks.

bluejetty:00014129:ios.description:
Thousands of readers use BookFusion to manage, read and enjoy over 2 million eBooks. 
BookFusion is the best cross platform eBook reader and manager with cloud sync that allows you to easily read, organize and manage your eBooks across all your devices. 
 ◇ Features ◇ 
Integrated Reader - Read all your EPUB, PDF, & CBZ/CBR eBooks both online and offline with clean and intuitive interface . 
Extensive Reader Settings - Customize your reading experience from vertical/horizontal margins, line spacing, fonts, bold/italics, colors and much more. 
Seamless Syncing - Sync your reading progress, highlights & annotations, eBooks and bookmarks across all devices. Pick up exactly where you left off. 
Organize & Manage - Easily organize and access all your eBooks seamlessly whether offline or online. Organize your eBooks using virtual bookshelves or place them into Series. Quickly find the eBook you are looking for using the category, tags or author filters. The perfect eBook Organizer & eBook Manager in one. 
Light & Dark Mode – Dark or Light the preference is yours! 
Highlights & Annotations - Highlight with your preferred colors and add tags to highlights to keep them organized. Sort your highlights by date or reading progress and easily export them to use in other apps in CSV, Markdown, HTML and PDF formats 
eBook Cloud - Keep your entire eBook collection at the tips of your fingers by storing them in the cloud and downloading them to read offline only when you need to. Any title just a click away. 
Text-to-Speech (TTS) - Listen to your favorite eBooks with Apple's native natural-sounding text-to-speech feature. Customize reading speed, voice and accessibility. Ideal for audiobook lovers busy lifestyles and accessible for all readers.
Send to Kindle – Organize and quickly send your next read to your Kindle device with one click. 
Calibre Integration - The perfect Calibre Ally. Sync metadata, custom columns, series, tags and incremental updated PDF & EPUB files to all your devices. Your entire Calibre library on your devices when you need it. 
Vertical Writing Support - Read Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, and Japanese eBooks with ease. 
Image/Area Highlights & Annotations (PDFs) - Easily annotate/highlight images, tables, graphs or even text. Any element at all in your PDF can now be highlighted and annotated.
EPUB 3 Support - With support for the full EPUB 3 spec. You can read eBooks with rich interactivity support that includes video, audio, Q&A, games and much more. 
Widgets – Quickly view and jump back into your last read, currently reading, or highlights right from your home screen with iOS Widgets.
Multi-Window Support (iPadOS & macOS) – Open multiple books side by side, drag books into Split View, or read and view highlights simultaneously. Perfect for multitasking, studying, or comparing texts.
NOTE: You will need to install the BookFusion Calibre Plugin to sync your eBooks to all your devices. See the tutorial at https://support.bookfusion.com/hc/en-us/articles/360018852052-Installing-Using-the-BookFusion-Plugin-for-Calibre 
Open With - Don’t like the integrated reader? Use the open with functionality to send and read your eBooks with your preferred app. No lock-in 
Metadata & Book Details – Know what an eBook is about at a glance or easily edit the cover, description, author tags and other information. 
Additional Formats Supported via Web - These include: AZW, AZW3, AZW4, CBC, CHM, DJVU, DOCX, FB2, FBZ, HTML, HTMLZ, LIT, LRF, PRC, PDB, PML, RB, RTF, SNB, TCR, TXT, TXTZ in a single app. These must be uploaded via the Web App before using the iOS App 
Choose from over 70,000 eBooks
 ◇ Other ◇ 
Have feedback or just want to chat? We would love to hear from you. Drop us a line at support@bookfusion.com or join us for a chat on Discord at https://www.discord.gg/7v34UYq 
Terms of Service - https://www.bookfusion.com/terms 
Privacy Policy - https://www.bookfusion.com/privacy

bluejetty:00032864:ios.description:
OM Dictation Management System in the Cloud (ODMS Cloud) is a cloud-based dictation workflow system that allows you to share dictation files between authors and Transcriptionists anytime, anywhere. Your files are now stored on the cloud, which means a dedicated server is no longer required, and setup is easy to get started.
Designing your dictation workflow can be done through a simple interface which allows you to realize an efficient workflow.
This is software for performing dictation using a smartphone. Supports file editing functions necessary for dictation, such as additional recording, overwriting recording, and insert recording. Furthermore, basic information necessary for workflow design such as Author ID and Worktype ID can be received from the ODMS Cloud server and added to the Dictation file. The created Dictation file can be uploaded directly to the ODMS Cloud server from this app.

bluejetty:00087511:ios.summary:
Perx is a health app which gives you the functionality to simplify your health tasks into one easy daily schedule, remember due tasks and, the best part is, you can earn real gift cards for completing your daily tasks on time!
From gift c
bluejetty:00087511:ios.description:
Perx is a health app which gives you the functionality to simplify your health tasks into one easy daily schedule, remember due tasks and, the best part is, you can earn real gift cards for completing your daily tasks on time!
From gift cards to movie tickets to pharmacy vouchers, the clinically-supported Perx program rewards you for managing your health tasks and completing them on time - making your daily routine easy, fun and gratifying. 
Trusted by Aspire Allergy, QBE Insurance, NSW Health, Roche and Cystic Fibrosis Australia, Perx was created as a more positive, motivating way to manage your chronic conditions and/or recovery routines.
Our easy-to-use app helps you form healthy habits and stick to your schedule by providing reminders, important health information and best of all – real rewards! All personal or health information you enter into the app is securely stored in the Perx app and we do not share your information with any third parties per our Privacy Policy. 
Perx has been featured in The Sydney Morning Herald, Startup Daily, The Daily Telegraph, News Medical, IT Brief and have also had an academic study on the effectiveness of Perx in encouraging adherence to treatment plans published in the Journal of Medical Internet Research. We’re also currently running a randomised control trial with the University of Sydney.
EARN REWARDS & FEEL BETTER:
- Schedule health tasks such as medications, appointments, physical therapy and more
- Earn real rewards every time you complete tasks in the app
- Track your journey to better health with insights and Apple Health
- Schedule your appointments
- Medication facts and recommendations
- Improve your health & wellbeing
- Join the Perx family – connect with a community of people just like you passionate about improving their health by forming better habits.
Rewards for better health and peace of mind for your family.
WHY PERX WORKS
Our program leverages proven behavioural science and consumer engagement tactics to help you improve your health behaviours and achieve better outcomes.
We pulled together a team of game designers, consumer loyalty experts and behavioural economists to use best-of-breed strategies from other industries to help you stick with your treatment plans.
Our team comes to work excited everyday to make a solution that patients love to use and are genuinely rewarded for taking care of their health.
WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING ABOUT PERX
“I can’t express how appreciative I am for this app” 
“Honestly one of the best ways to earn rewards for something we should be doing anyway. The team is amazing, always 100% ready to help or take on (and even fix) any issues or feedback! Thank you guys, honestly. You’ve helped me stay on track and do the right thing for my health.”
“It has made my life a whole lot easier and less stressful” 
“Thanks for the great app I just won a fitness tracker last night. All is good. I feel so pleased to be part of this app and it helps me so much with my Parkinson's journey.” 
“I’m so happy to be part of the Perx family. I’m really enjoying it.”
Most importantly, Perx is designed with input from people living with chronic conditions who take medication daily and incorporates feedback from doctors, pharmacists and other health professionals.
Read more reviews below or better yet, try it for yourself! 
FEEDBACK & NEW FEATURES
We love hearing from our Perx community (it's actually our favourite part of the day) so please send us an email at support@perxhealth.com if you have any suggestions, complaints or issues with the app!
For more information, visit www.perxhealth.com
https://perxhealth.com/terms-of-use
https://perxhealth.com/privacy-policy

Proudly owned and operated by an Aussie Mum, an award-winning service that is LOVED by thousands of parents throughout Australia – just read our reviews, they say it all! 
Parents - Why use Kiddo?
All Kiddo Carers are ID & Working with Children Checked. Kiddo provides an independent review and rating system, so you really know who the superstars are. Keep your bookings in one place, stay organised with our in-app messaging.
Make bookings with as little as two hours notice and know that you’ll never have to find another ATM with Kiddo’s in-app payment system – allowing for overtime too.
NDIS Care
We provide parents with the very best support workers that are child focussed! Our extra features for NDIS care include better matching and automatic invoicing – saving parents even more time!
Ongoing Care
Kiddo can assist parents to find short term or long term recurring care arrangements with its Ongoing Care service.
Carers – How Kiddo can help you! 
Kiddo provides carers with a much-needed tool to manage their bookings, ongoing availability and build a brand. Be recognised for every booking you do, set your preferences to be matched to bookings that suit your needs. You set your own rates and are in control. Never have another awkward conversation about money again! Just focus on what you do best – providing exceptional care for children!
Kiddo is free to download, find out more by visiting our website www.kiddoapp.com.au
Terms of Use: https://kiddoapp.com.au/termsofservice/
Privacy Statement: https://kiddoapp.com.au/privacy/

bluejetty:00152140:ios.description:
**Welcome to Umbella - Your Safe Haven**
Umbella is more than just an app – it's your trusted companion for navigating the world as an LGBTQ+ individual. Whether you're exploring a new city, looking for supportive resources, or seeking a safe space to connect, Umbella has you covered.
**KEY FEATURES**
**Safe Space Discovery**
• Find LGBTQ+-friendly restaurants, bars, cafes, and shops near you
• View community-verified safety ratings and reviews
• Get real-time updates about welcoming businesses
• Discover hidden gems in your local LGBTQ+ community
**Essential Resources**
• Locate gender-affirming healthcare providers
• Find PrEP and HIV testing centers
• Access mental health and counseling services
• Connect with legal support and advocacy groups
• Discover community centers and support organizations
**Professional Support**
• Connect with LGBTQ+-affirming counselors and therapists
• Access confidential, professional mental health support
• Find crisis resources and emergency hotlines
• Get support for coming out, transition, and identity exploration
**Safety First**
• Anonymous reporting system for unsafe locations
• Community-driven safety alerts and updates
• Privacy-focused design with local data storage
• Secure, encrypted communications
**Community Connection**
• Share experiences and recommendations with the community
• Rate and review LGBTQ+-friendly businesses
• Help others discover safe and welcoming spaces
• Build a stronger, more connected community
**Privacy & Security**
Your safety and privacy are our top priorities. Umbella stores most data locally on your device, uses end-to-end encryption for communications, and never sells your personal information. You can use the app anonymously or create an account – it's your choice.
**For Everyone**
Whether you're just coming out, exploring your identity, traveling, or looking for community support, Umbella is designed to help you feel safe, supported, and celebrated for who you are.
**Crisis Support**
If you're in crisis, Umbella provides quick access to emergency resources and crisis hotlines. Remember: you're not alone, and help is always available.
Download Umbella today and join a community that celebrates diversity, promotes safety, and supports every individual's journey to authenticity.
---
*Umbella is committed to creating a world wher

bluejetty:00150134:ios.description:
Navkiran Nursing Classes is one stop solution for your licensure examinations and nursing entrance examinations. Whether you want to take RN or LPN license in Canada, Australia, USA, UK or New Zealand or UAE by cracking various registration exams. Or you want to excel into various nursing entrance exams, Navkiran Nursing Classes has it all. The single nursing platform which caters to the nurses for various entry level exams around the globe.
Our carefully designed modules helps nurses in cracking toughest registration and admission exams with ease. We focus on thorough rationale buildup and making concept base which helps aspirants to excel through these exams. Our real time lectures and classes make your preparation easier and interesting. Our modules are specifically designed for:
· NCLEX RN NEXT GENERATION
· REX PN
· NCLEX PN
· NMC CBT
· NORCET and other Indian Entrance Exams
· DHA MOH 
KEY FEATURES:
1. Introduction to all the registration exams and licensure process
2. Individually tailored modules according to each country’s healthcare
system policies and regulations
4. Test series according to latest NGN pattern.
5. Wide variety of test item types including case studies.
6. Must know, should know and good to know classification of material.
7. Thoroughly explained material with diagrams and self explanatory images.
9. Q&A discussion classes for interactive learning.
10. Downloadable notes in PDF format for studying.
11. Regular evaluations through mock tests for self-assessment.
12. Solved previous question papers
13. Benefit from insights and strategies provided by highly experienced faculty.V S
14. Tips and tricks to navigate through the complexities of licensing exams.
15. Regularly updated contents.
16. Boost your confidence with proven preparation strategies.
Moreover, Navkiran Nursing classes we make licensure journey of the nurses around the globe easy and efficient. Additionally, flexible schedules and mobile friendly interface makes it possible to prepare for your tests anywhere, anytime without disturbing nurse’s busy schedule.
Join us to make your licensure journey seamless and effective and also be ready to excel in the toughest of nursing entrance exams. In this competitive era, Navkiran Nursing classes is your dedicated partner striving towards your success and to achieve your career goals.
