bluejetty:00068953:ios.name: Pearls of Atlantis Magic Gems
bluejetty:00068953:ios.summary: Dive into the depths in Pearls of Atlantis, a satisfying physics-based puzzle adventure. Aim and drop magical pearls as you solve sweet match-3 challenges and unlock ocean treasures, new game modes, and powerful powerups. Use wheels, bumper
bluejetty:00068953:ios.description:
Dive into the depths in Pearls of Atlantis, a satisfying physics-based puzzle adventure. Aim and drop magical pearls as you solve sweet match-3 challenges and unlock ocean treasures, new game modes, and powerful powerups. Use wheels, bumpers, bouncy platforms and more to navigate obstacles and locked pearls. Line up the perfect shot to trigger massive chain reactions and explosive pearl pops! This game will help you relax while offering a fun challenge that keeps you coming back for more.
FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE
- Master the Drop: Watch pearls bounce, roll, and react with other pearls using realistic physics.
- Fun Never Stops: 1,500+ pearl-popping levels get more challenging as you progress through this underwater paradise.
- Daily Rewards & Boosters: Get great rewards and prizes to boost gameplay in this magic pearls match 3 game.
- Color Options: You decide which color pearls to drop and where to aim them to create the perfect combo match.
- Many Game Modes: Play the Daily Puzzle, Zen Mode, Treasure Run, and Score Challenge and enjoy different ways to play Pearls of Atlantis.
- Improve Your Score: Play puzzles multiple times to earn a Golden Wreath.
- Massive Explosions: Chain together huge combos for screen-clearing effects and high scores.
- Explore Atlantis: Journey through stunning underwater settings at your own pace.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: Play offline and enjoy this match-3 adventure wherever you are.
- No Time Limits: Play at your own pace, with no rush, while enjoying relaxing music.
- Free to Play and Suitable for All Ages – Enjoy these casual and family-friendly underwater match 3 puzzles.
AND THERE’S MORE
DECORATE YOUR COVE
Customize and decorate the Cove of Atlantis to make it gorgeous. The more puzzles you solve and magic pearls you gather, the more of the cove you’ll uncover, explore, and decorate! With your help, the mermaids can rebuild a whole new Atlantis!
BEYOND GAMEPLAY
- Meet a cast of colorful characters and experience a budding mermaid romance.
- Swim through gorgeous graphics and relaxing music while in this underwater paradise.
- Fill your gallery and customize your Cove with magical plants and animals.
WINNING STRATEGIES
- Prioritize Low Matches: Create matches as low on the board as possible. This increases the chances of cascading combos!
- Anticipate Bounces: Use physics-based interactions to "bank" shots or nudge specific pearls toward a color match.
- Wait for Stability: Always wait for the pieces to completely settle before making your next move.
- Manage Obstructive Layers: Plan your pearl drops to clear level obstacles first to open up more room for movement. 
- Targeted Booster Use: Save precision powerups, such as a "Hammer" or "Lightning," for your final moves to clear stubborn single pearls.
- Predict the Landing Spot: Due to the physics, where you drop the pearl is not exactly where it ends up. Practice is key!
- Plan Ahead: Don't just focus on the current drop. Look at the next few pearls you need to drop and anticipate how the board will look after multiple moves.
- Create Large Clusters: Aim to group similar colored pearls together, even if they don't immediately match three.
- Use Power-ups Wisely: If you earn access to special power-ups (like bombs or fireworks), save them for tight situations or to achieve specific goals, rather than using them immediately.
Download now Pearls of Atlantis Magic Gems and start your underwater adventure!

Territories
• View all personal and field service group assignments.
•
bluejetty:00079163:ios.description:
Territory Helper is a companion application to the Territory Helper website, allowing publishers to view their territory, campaign, and field service group assignments.
Territories
• View all personal and field service group assignments.
• Return or request territory assignments.
• Scan QR codes of territories for quick access.
• Automatically open territories in the app when viewing them in a browser.
• Access the entire viewing history for an easy way to switch between assignments.
• Share territories quickly and easily.
• Get directions to a territory assignment.
Territory Annotations
• Draw, highlight, and annotate territory images.
• Share annotations quickly and easily.
• Available regardless of internet connectivity.
Locations
• Create and manage locations (depending on congregation settings).
• Add and create custom tags for locations.
• Record not-at-homes and visits per territory assignment.
• Write notes and comments for locations.
• Share location details and directions to other publishers.
• Easily search and sort locations.
• Manage your own personal list of locations.
Data
• Redundant backups are kept and stored locally.
• Backup and restore functions are available.
Localization
• Available in over 20 languages.
• Translations are dynamically updated.
Offline/Poor connections
• Territories and assignment data are cached for access without an internet connection.
• A snapshot of the territory is taken so access to a map is always available.
• Functionality is clearly marked and disabled where an active internet connection is required.
GDPR Compliance
• Non-compliant features are removed and disabled.
• Non-compliant data is only stored locally.
• Congregation can easily control publisher accounts and their compliance.
Please visit territoryhelper.com/help for support and detailed documentation.

bluejetty:00166949:ios.description:
Your Bible Companion — Read, Study, and Grow in Faith
Discover a powerful and easy-to-use Bible app that brings Scripture closer to your daily life. Whether you’re new to the Bible or a seasoned reader, our app helps you stay connected with God’s Word anytime, anywhere. With a wide selection of translations, helpful tools, and a clean, user-friendly design, it’s never been easier to explore, understand, and apply the Bible in your life.
Access the Bible in Popular Translations
Read the Bible in the way that speaks to you. Our app includes trusted and popular versions such as:
 * New International Version (NIV)
 * King James Version (KJV)
 * English Standard Version (ESV)
 * New Living Translation (NLT)
 * Reina Valera 1909 (Spanish)
 * And many more
Switch between translations with one tap to compare verses and deepen your understanding. It’s the ideal tool for both study and devotion.
Navigate Scripture with Ease
The Bible is a big book, but finding what you need doesn’t have to be hard. Our intuitive navigation system lets you jump to any book, chapter, or verse instantly. Search by keyword, topic, or passage, and save time finding the right Scripture for your moment.
Highlight, Bookmark, and Take Notes
Customize your Bible reading by saving favorite verses, highlighting key passages, and writing personal notes. Whether you’re preparing a sermon, journaling your faith journey, or just keeping track of meaningful verses, our tools help you stay organized and inspired.
Read the Bible Offline
No internet? No problem. Download your favorite Bible versions and read them offline, wherever you are. Whether you’re commuting, traveling, or in a quiet place without signal, the Word is always within reach.
Make It Your Own
Adjust text size, switch between light and dark modes, and personalize your reading experience for comfort. Whether you prefer large print or a softer tone for night reading, the app adapts to your needs.
Build a Daily Bible Habit
Stay on track with your spiritual growth. Set daily reading goals, get reminders, and follow Bible reading plans. Even just a few minutes a day can strengthen your faith and help you draw closer to God.
Perfect for Every Christian
This app is designed for believers of all backgrounds. Whether you’re looking for daily encouragement, in-depth study tools, or simply want to carry the Bible in your pocket, our app supports your walk with God.
Key Features at a Glance:
 • Access to multiple Bible translations
 • Quick and easy navigation
 • Offline mode for reading without Wi-Fi
 • Bookmarks, notes, and highlights
 • Adjustable font size and themes
 • Bible reading plans (coming soon)
 • Clean, distraction-free interface
 • Supports English, Spanish, and more
Why Choose This Bible App?
Because it was created with love and a focus on simplicity, accessibility, and usefulness. Whether you’re studying deeply or reading casually, it’s built to support and enrich your time with Scripture. No ads, no distractions — just the Bible, the way it should be.
Join Thousands of Happy Users
Our Bible app has already helped thousands of people stay connected with God’s Word every day. Join the growing community of believers who use this app to deepen their understanding, find encouragement, and grow spiritually.
Get Started Today
Download now and take the Bible with you wherever you go. Whether you’re reading at home, during your commute, or in quiet reflection at the end of the day, our app helps make Scripture part of your everyday life.
---

bluejetty:00073869:ios.description:
With Device Tracker, locating your lost Bluetooth devices is quick and effortless. In just a few taps, you can find your wireless headphones, watch, or any other Bluetooth-enabled device. Our advanced algorithms keep continuous track of your devices, so you’ll always stay connected and never lose them again!
KEY FEATURES
• Device Radar: Instantly view all nearby devices in real-time.
• Distance Meter: Measure your proximity to a device on a 100-point scale, guiding you directly to your lost item.
• Broad Compatibility: Works with a wide range of Bluetooth devices, including wireless earphones, portable speakers, fitness trackers, and more.
• Live Map Location: Access precise, live location updates to easily pinpoint your lost device.
• Alerts on Proximity: Receive sound and vibration alerts when your device is nearby.
• Favorite Devices: Pin your most-used devices to the top for faster access and improved tracking efficiency.
HOW IT WORKS
• Open Device Tracker to start scanning.
• The app will automatically detect nearby Bluetooth devices.
• Walk around and observe the distance score to locate your device.
• When you’re close, Device Tracker will alert you with a sound, letting you know your device is within reach.
• Success! You’ve found your lost device.

bluejetty:00062032:ios.description:
BravoBravo helps learners from KG to Grade 12 build strong Arabic skills, with Math and Islamic Education practice for younger learners, all in one game-based learning app for school and home.
Parents can see what their child is learning and where they need more practice. Teachers can assign work, create assessments, and follow each learner’s progress.
ARABIC FROM KG TO GRADE 12, FOR NATIVE AND NON-NATIVE SPEAKERS
• Build Arabic reading, writing, listening and speaking skills with leveled books and audio for every grade.
• Follow along as words are read aloud and tap selected words to see their meaning.
• Practice with assessments that show what each learner has mastered.
MATH FROM KG2 TO GRADE 5
• Practice questions, worksheets, videos and interactive explanations.
• Aligned with Common Core, Cambridge, Singapore Math and Houghton Mifflin.
ISLAMIC EDUCATION FOR GRADES 1–5
• Quran, Tawheed, Hadith, Seerah, Fiqh, Islamic figures, and values and good conduct.
• Islamic Education content aligned with UAE and Saudi curricula.
LEARNING THAT FEELS LIKE A GAME
• Learning journeys with stages, challenges, and rewards that keep learners motivated.
• Different question types keep practice varied and engaging.
FOR PARENTS
• See completed activities, skills practiced and progress over time.
• Know which areas your child should practice next.
FOR TEACHERS AND SCHOOLS
• Assign practice and create assessments.
• Review learner performance with dashboards and reports.
• Plan lessons with AI-assisted lesson planning and lesson flow tools.
• Bring BravoBravo to your school:
https://www.bravobravoapp.com/en/
info@bravobravoapp.com
HOW TO GET STARTED
• Does your school use BravoBravo? Sign in with the account your school provided.
• Individual Account, then Create your own account to start learning. A 7-day free trial is available on new subscriptions.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Monthly and yearly plans are available for Arabic learning, Mathematics and the full learning pack. Pricing varies by the number of subjects and learners; see the available plans and current prices in the app before subscribing.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the next billing period. You can cancel your subscription in the app or through your Apple App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.bravobravoapp.com/b2c/terms-and-conditions-en.html

bluejetty:00013925:ios.name: CCal 11 Lite
bluejetty:00013925:ios.summary:
CCal is the perfect app for anyone who needs to efficiently and quickly arrange their busy schedules on your iPhone or iPod Touch.
CCal is an intelligent and elegant calendar application that can upload to Google Calendar.  
=== Features
bluejetty:00013925:ios.description:
CCal is the perfect app for anyone who needs to efficiently and quickly arrange their busy schedules on your iPhone or iPod Touch.
CCal is an intelligent and elegant calendar application that can upload to Google Calendar.  
=== Features ===
- CCal has a sophisticated and intuitive user interface which allows you to create and modify any date or event by "drag & drop"  (simply hold your finger on the screen/event and move it where you want).
- To change the date of any event simply drag that event to the desired destination date.
- With CCal, easily and efficiently manage your plans and create individual events using a choice of colors. 
- CCal supports iPhone's standard "shake to undo" function.  Multiple Undos and Redos are available.
- Copy & paste events.
- Delete events - drag to trash
- With CCal, you can customize background colors based on the day of the week or an individual event's existence.
- CCal supports international time zones ... more than 400 regions.
- With CCal, you can choose to input times using a spinning-wheel or by using an easy & quick ten-key.
- With CCal you can display the current month and the following month continuously in "scroll mode"… Your schedule will not be divided by the month boundary.
== Supported Localizations ===
English, Japanese
Please Note:
• Our CCal 10 and CCal 11 are separate apps.
• In iOS 5, creating and displaying Reminders items is not supported.
■ Google Server resumed normal service early on 15 Feb 2013. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
------------------------

bluejetty:00175544:ios.summary: Join a community of good people discussing great stories on Fable, an app designed to find, discuss, and track books and TV shows. Set reading goals, get personalized reading stats, discover new books and shows, and connect with fellow read
bluejetty:00175544:ios.description:
Join a community of good people discussing great stories on Fable, an app designed to find, discuss, and track books and TV shows. Set reading goals, get personalized reading stats, discover new books and shows, and connect with fellow readers in online book clubs and TV clubs. 
TRACK YOUR READING LIFE: Stay organized with beautiful lists, reading goals, and daily streaks that encourage you to read more.
- Organize the books you’re currently into, what’s on your TBR, what you finished, and DNFed
- Import your book lists from Goodreads and Kindle to keep everything in one place
- Build custom lists for all of your niche reading interests
- Build watch lists for the TV shows you’re interested in, currently watching, finished, and more
- Follow lists from other readers for inspiration, and share your own
VIEW PERSONALIZED STATS: Learn more about yourself as a reader with deep insights, charts, and graphs about your reading history.
- Import your lists from Goodreads or Kindle to power your reading stats
- Visualize your progress to your annual reading goal
- See your most-read authors and genres
- See your longest reading streak
- View your average book rating across all the books you finished 
BUILD A READING HABIT WITH STREAKS: Stay motivated with tools designed to help you tackle your reading goals.
- Create daily reading streaks
- Track your book progress daily based on the page or percentage read
- Edit past streaks if you forget to log a day of reading
- Add our home screen widget for one-tap access to your streaks
- Set annual reading goals to challenge yourself
- Get reminders to keep your reading streak alive
CREATE BETTER BOOK REVIEWS: Share your perspective with customized book ratings and book reviews.
- Import your lists and reviews from Goodreads 
- Rate and review books with half-stars (and update your Goodreads ratings with half-stars)
- Add expressive tags to share exactly how the book made you feel
- Add spice level ratings to your book reviews
- Pair your book review with emoji reactions for further customization
- Leave book reviews in your book club’s reflection room or on the book’s detail page
JOIN BOOK & TV CLUBS: Explore thousands of free book and TV clubs for every niche interest, or start your own club to read or watch with friends or family.
- Join your favorite BookTokkers’ book clubs, or start a buddy read to discuss books with friends
- Find clubs led by TV recappers and reviewers from TikTok, YouTube, and elsewhere
- Spark conversations with your club in organized, spoiler-free chapter rooms and episode rooms
- Leave reviews in the reflection room at the end of the book or show
- Read or watch at your own pace or follow the club’s suggested milestones
DISCOVER NEW BOOKS & SHOWS: Find your next favorite book to read or show to watch.
- Use Scout to get personalized book recommendations
- Ask Scout to randomly select your next read from your TBR
- Import your Goodreads or Kindle lists for even more personalization
- Discover new books and shows from Fable’s editorial team
- Follow friends’ lists in the For You feed for community recommendations
BUY EBOOKS DESIGNED FOR INTERACTIVE READING: Experience an entirely new way to read books inside Fable’s custom ebook reader.
- Join other readers who are “social reading” inside thousands of free book clubs
- Annotate books with highlights, notes, tabs, comments, and reactions right inside the book
- Respond to discussion prompts embedded inside the book
- Discover thousands of free books to read inside the Fable app, or shop from our catalog of over one million interactive ebooks
SHOW OFF WHAT YOU READ
- Customize monthly Reading Wraps to highlight the books you read that month
- Come back at the end of the year for an annual wrapup of your year in reading
Terms of use: https://fable.co/terms

bluejetty:00114582:ios.summary:
PlatyGuard is Now Live. Mix & match 100+ items, master counters and combos!
PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos
bluejetty:00114582:ios.description:
PlatyGuard is Now Live. Mix & match 100+ items, master counters and combos!
PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos, clash with mutant foes, and explore mysterious sites in this indie adventure!
Choose from over a dozen unique Platyguards, each with its own combat style—parry at the perfect moment, execute brutal combos, or unleash charged attacks. Hack and slash through hordes of enemies and build your own playstyle with hundreds of skills and items. Uncover the hidden truth behind the Hive Scourge and survive the apocalypse!
[Parry, Counter, Break with Style]
Spot enemy weaknesses, parry, dodge, and clash with precision. Shatter defenses, chain combos, and finish foes with decisive strikes. Experience the thrill of action-packed platformer combat!
[Unique Platyguards, Unleashed Power]
Over a dozen Platyguards await, each with unique mechanics: sword duels, brutal combos, charged attacks, or dodge-and-shoot styles. Whether you choose a samurai, ninja, or assassin, you'll find your signature hero in this roguelike action RPG!
[Endless Builds, Limitless Freedom]
Experiment with hundreds of skills, items, and synergies—summon armies, cast magic, or rain lightning storms. Forge extreme builds and turn despair into triumph in a dark fantasy wasteland!
[Wasteland Hunt, Truth Rebuilt]
Hive portals, mutant insects, corporate conspiracies—the cataclysm hides a secret born of mankind's survival instincts. Explore, fight, and uncover the dark mysteries and raw horrors that reshaped this post-apocalyptic world.
[Rich Scenes, Dynamic Battlefields]
6 vast stages, over 50 enemy types, elite monsters, and formidable bosses await. The battlefield shifts with every run—no two fights are ever the same in this roguelike action adventure. Love dungeon games? From ruined shelters to plague-ridden zones, uncover relentless challenges in a world brimming with danger and thrill.
Unite, Platyguards! Adventure, survival, and action await in this epic 2D roguelike platformer!
[Community & Service]
Join our official Discord server for discussions: https://discord.gg/QutyVMGeHx
For support or feedback, please contact us via: info@chillyroom.games
[Follow us for more game updates]
Twitter: https://x.com/ChillyRoom 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chillyroominc/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ChillyRoom

bluejetty:00122065:ios.description:
Play the #1 FREE SOLITAIRE Tri Peaks card game on iOS
Your princess is locked up in the last room of an intricate dungeon, guarded by a monster.
The keys to open the doors, are split in 16 parts.
The only way to get these parts is solving a card game with magic cards.
Let the adventure begin!
The card game consists in clearing the board by taking a card that is one above or below than the card on the deck.
Among the 160 levels available to play, you would find several missions such as:
- Have a sequence of X number of cards.
- Obtain X points.
- Find the card-key to open the lock.
- Solve the game in X amount of time.
- Get a golden card by having a sequence of 5 cards.
- Solve 2 rounds of the game.

bluejetty:00027233:ios.description:
2nd Phone is a second phone number app for calling, texting and SMS verification. It provides reliable, non-VoIP number as a sideline to let you verify accounts, call and text completely separate from your private number.
Unlike VoIP numbers that often face stability issues, 2nd Phone gives you a real mobile number to work long-term for texting, calling, validating account and staying connected.
No Hidden Cost & No Ads: Choose a plan to activate a second phone number. Your plan includes massive call and text usage to the US, plus reliable SMS verification capabilities.
1. Real Non-VoIP Numbers 
Instead of VoIP phone numbers, 2nd Phone provides you with real mobile numbers, you can choose a 2nd phone number and use this second number to meet various different needs, such as: 
• Keep privacy safe 
Your privacy stays safe when you have to give out your personal number while using online services or receiving SMS verification codes. 
• Divide work and personal life
Use your 2nd phone number to separate work and personal communications. 
• Sign Up
For websites and platforms that prompt for a real phone number.
• Connections 
Get numbers for your other devices to stay connected on messaging apps like WhatsApp, etc.
And in more situations where you need a 2nd number or don't want to share your private number, use 2nd Phone as your choice.
2. Instant Calling and Texting
2nd Phone provides phone number plan that comes with massive minutes and message usage to the US. You can make calls and send or receive texts using Wi-Fi and cellular. Start calling and texting instantly and stay connected longer without worrying about the bill!
3. Cheap International Calling
2nd Phone provides low-cost international calling services in more than two hundred countries to any landline or mobile number. Talk with friends from different countries anytime, anywhere.
4. NO LIMITS
You can use 2nd Phone regardless of device, platform, or operating system. Stay in touch with anyone on any device, even if the person you want to connect with doesn't have an app installed or isn't even connected to the internet.
5. AD-FREE EXPERIENCE
Enjoy the service without being interrupted by unwanted ads. Just use it as simple and clear as your mobile Phone. All the experience is designed to meet your convenient and safe communication needs.
6. Flexible Credits
2nd Phone offers various pay-as-you-go credit packages and competitive rate for international calls. Don't worry about credits getting expired. It's always there.
7. Various Plans 
2nd Phone provides you with various plans to meet your needs. Subscribe to the plans, and you can unlock the features on 2nd Phone. 
---------------------------------------------------
We're always excited to hear from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please feel free to contact us via:
Email: 2ndphone@justalk.com
Facebook: @justalk2ndphone
If you choose to purchase subscriptions, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your subscription will automatically renew for the same package length at the same price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn auto-renewal off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. 
Privacy: https://2ndphone.justalk.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00150322:ios.description:
Play this relaxing new game for hours of endless fun! This classic dice game known by many names over the years -Yatzy, Yacht, Yahsee, Yatzi- is re-explored in Dice Town Yatzy with a fun, new twist 
Do you love games like Farkle, Bingo, Monopoly, Poker Dice, Puzzle, Cards, Scrabble? Then you will love this new two player dice game! No idea what Yatzy is? Download now and we’ll find out together in the most popular, simple, fast, and endlessly fun dice board game
About Dice town 
Welcome to DiceTown, the town Heather grew up in. It’s a picturesque, warm, quaint beach town right out of 90s America. Everyone knows everyone and is ready to lend a helping hand. And boy is Heather glad to return home with you! Aunt Betsy, Sailor and all the other charming folks could surely use your and Heather’s help in getting some of the most loved hotspots of DiceTown up and running.
 Download it now to know more 
*It keeps your brain Active & Sharp
*With multiple game modes there’s always a fresh puzzle
*Play against and meet people from all over the world
*Friends & family have been enjoying it for decades
*The classic way to relax with a new charming look
What makes DiceTown Yatzy so interesting & fun 
 Journey Through Dicetown 
Track your journey through Journey Map. Unlock multiple zones. There is no getting bored when you have a variety of game modes to choose from.
Engaging Stories
Give new life to an old town & help charming town folks by fixing & rebuilding their places.
Power Up
Use Bonus Rolls to get extra shots at Yatzy or “The Mega Roll” as we call it
Play With Opponents
Match with people from all over the world to test your game skills. Ask for a rematch if you want; we have it all covered.
Beat the bot 
We always try to get you fast games from real players.. But it never gets lonely in DiceTown, we have bots that can help you play and progress on your journey.
Profile View 
Track your achievements, rank, & progress. Keep improving
Thank you for playing DiceTown Yatzy
We regularly bring updates with improvements and bug-fixes
To further improve the game, there is no one better than you to share what you love & what can be improved. So, we request you to write a review on the App Store. We’d greatly appreciate it
Let’s build the best dice board game together
Like DiceTown Yatzy on Facebook! https://www.facebook.com/DiceTownDiaries/

bluejetty:00175632:ios.name: Episode XOXO
bluejetty:00175632:ios.summary:
Episode XOXO lets you live your stories with love, romance, adventure, and drama. Wouldn’t it be amazing if you were a character in your favorite story? Episode XOXO lets you do just that with stories where you make choices that matter.
E
bluejetty:00175632:ios.description:
Episode XOXO lets you live your stories with love, romance, adventure, and drama. Wouldn’t it be amazing if you were a character in your favorite story? Episode XOXO lets you do just that with stories where you make choices that matter.
Episode XOXO is a collection of interactive stories where you choose your destiny. 
How does it work?
Customize your avatar and design your outfit
Develop relationships with your favorite characters - will they be rivals or romantic?
Change fate through your choices
Immerse yourself in diverse worlds, the options are endless!
Some of our favorite reads:
THE NEIGHBOR: You and Cameron have been friends since you were kids, but as you’ve grown up and taken different paths you’ve lost touch. Now after your father passes away, you must move back home. After so much time away, will home be different this time around?
LITTLE STAR: It’s always been assumed you’d follow in your parents footsteps and become a surgeon, but you’ve always dreamed of being a singer. Then you get the opportunity to secretly join the most famous band in town, and you start to really connect with the star. How will you balance a family that’s willing to manipulate your world to get you back, a band full of drama of its own, and a dream that’s never felt more possible? Time to find out!
NO TIME FOR LOVE: A chance encounter with a celebrity gets you roped into a scheme to be their fake girlfriend for the summer. They’re trying to strengthen their image and not get dropped by their record label; you’re trying to get your college tuition paid for. It seems like an easy win-win, and it’s all fake anyway, or so you tell yourself. Even as your feelings start to become real, you know that everything will all go back to normal soon. You won’t have time for love… right?
THE ROYAL BACHELOR: You’re a PA on the new, hot reality TV show, where the hottest prince is trying to find love. It’s a huge opportunity for you, and a dream come true to even be working on the show. And then you become a contestant. You’re the clear fan favorite, which means everyone is out to get you. Will you be able to rise above the fray and prove that you’re princess material?
BODYGUARD BOYFRIEND: After a dangerous event, your father hires you a bodyguard, changing your daily life completely. But how can he keep you safe when he's clearly falling for you?

bluejetty:00132280:ios.name: iCollect Video Games: Tracker
bluejetty:00132280:ios.summary: iCollect Video Games is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your video game collections and inventory. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms.
bluejetty:00132280:ios.description:
iCollect Video Games is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your video game collections and inventory. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms. Scan in or search our database for any video game you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features!
• Manage and inventory any video game for systems and consoles such as Switch, Playstation, Xbox, Windows PC's, and many more, including old legacy systems! Supports the latest consoles.
• Loaded with millions of video games from around the world in our database.
• Full barcode scanning and database search.
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad, iPhone, Mac, and more.
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency.
• Filters, sorting, and importing.
• Three different custom layouts.
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Share your video game collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter.
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed.
• Extra features like colored Themes, Dark Mode support, and more.
• Every field is editable.
• Store up to four pictures per video game, including front, back, and inside images of games.
• Personal details per game including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Last Played, Storage Location, Opened, Notes, Estimated Value, and more.
• Index bars and search for quick access in large game collections.
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 18, the latest devices like iPhone 16, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, SE 2, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your game collection from nearly anywhere: CLZ Games, Delicious Library, Gameye, Price Charting, and much more. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
This app is for anyone who reads IGN, uses CLZ Games, likes video game reviews from IGN, uses UPC barcode scanners, buys video games at Gamestop, or likes to catalog & collect video games. Great for the latest video game releases.
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
Data provided by Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
-------
PRIVACY INFO
-------
All of these are OPTIONAL when using our app.
Email Address: We only collect this if you enable Cloud Sync as a login user ID.
Contacts: We only use your contacts if you want us to for "Loaned To" fields.
Photos or Videos: We only use photos that you choose for your item details.
Camera: We only use this for barcode scanning.
None of your data is sold. See our Privacy Policy URL for details.
We do use Google Firebase and Facebook SDK's for analytics and crash data. See their policies for additional details on what they may track about your device.
-------
TERMS OF USE: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/

When the world needs to survive from the hell called war, stickman commando will rise as a hero in ww2 first-person shooter world war game!
This top upcoming game will take you to the best battleground where heroes will stand against troops of evil and defeat them in most intense battle royale war!
Action packed Stickman WW2 game allows you to unleash your fury in the clash with enemy soldiers to be a hero how saves the day! Best upcoming top action game of 2020!

Enjoy more great survival battles, tons of missions of fun shooting enemy stickman and great missions in historic war.
Free to download with same fun fps mission modes offline as in online fps missions. Play this best shooting game on-the-go anywhere. It is your duty to answer to this call from battle.

Play as single world war 2 fps player 
Easy and intuitive controls
Realistic wwii story of heroes

Face danger and defeat enemy in fight
Realistic historic environment and 3d graphics
Variety of weapons like sniper rifles, assault rifles, SMGs or shotguns and other gears like vests and helmets
New offline action game set in ww2 ... but with stickman!

bluejetty:00159368:ios.summary:
Fanera is the ultimate Web 3.0 social network for football fans, where you can share, engage, and win prizes. Connect with a global community, follow your favorite teams, and monetize your content.
With Fanera's innovative NFT feature,
bluejetty:00159368:ios.description:
Fanera is the ultimate Web 3.0 social network for football fans, where you can share, engage, and win prizes. Connect with a global community, follow your favorite teams, and monetize your content.
With Fanera's innovative NFT feature, football fans can now trade their content as NFTs, turning their passion into profit. Share your unique football moments, mint them as NFTs, and sell them on our secure blockchain marketplace. Experience the future of fan engagement by monetizing your creativity and connecting with a global community of football enthusiasts.
Well the app you need is Fanera, the football fans social platform. Our innovative platform is the best way to capture, share and experience the best world’s football moments. Follow your friends, family, your favorite team, players & influencers. Join a football community that is all football just like you and express yourself by sharing all your favorite football content.
FAN TO FAN
As images & video football social app, Fanera is designed as an F-2-F (fan to fan) social app where football fanatics can engage and express themselves. From sharing football news, football videos made by fans, and soccer highlights videos, to following soccer live scores and upcoming football fixtures, it’s the best app for football sports fanatics, Tifosi, groundhoppers, i.e anyone who loves football.
SHOW YOUR PASSION
As a football fan, you can use our "Snap It" feature to express your passion for football. Share stories and snaps while enjoying football stories by other football fans.
Just select your favorite team, find trending matches and start snapping. Whether you want to view soccer highlights videos of past games, or fan-made soccer videos for some epic moments or players, Fanera is the place to discover them.
Earn points and win prizes
Rack up your stats with Fanera points! By simply watching your favorite football content, hilarious memes over your rivals or amazing skills and showboats, Fanera rewards you with points towards merchandise, jerseys, Gift cards and more! Up your game and get more by commenting, sharing or posting your very own content for your fellow Ultra's to see!
Build Your Dream Team
When they score, you score! Build your matchday squad and collect the world's greatest players by spending your Fanera points. Become a tactical mastermind and transfer your players with other users to field a team with Golds, Silvers or Bronzes. Show your GOAT status on the global leaderboard and earn bragging rights with your own team!
- Share: Upload videos, take snaps, post comments, debate, banter for injustice made by referees, and more! Or post videos and photos of your adventures as a groundhopper / tifosi and get likes and comments from other football fans.
Football is more fun when we share these unique moments on a football social network where socializing is not defined by geographic location but rather by the love of the sport and the team - regardless of language, nationality, or religion.
FOLLOW THE MOST POPULAR LEAGUES
Get stories of fans of the top soccer competitions: World Cup, Champions League, European Champions League, English Premier League, Spanish La Liga, German Bundesliga, Italian Serie A, French Ligue 1, Mexican Liga MX and more!
GLOBALLY POPULAR TEAMS
FC Barcelona, Real Madrid, Manchester United, Liverpool, Arsenal, Tottenham Hotspur, Chelsea, Manchester City, Juventus, AC Milan, Inter Milan, PSG, Bayern Munich, Dortmund, Al Hilal, Nasser, Al-Ahly, Zamalek, Al-Ain FC, Al-Jazira, Wydad Casablanca, RCA Raja and more teams are in one soccer app
Now it’s time to redefine the way you enjoy and experience the great game of football daily.
Get Fanera, and football will never be the same again for you!
Download the #1 all football social fan app for FREE!
CONTACT
Email : info@Fanera.co
Social media:
* https://www.facebook.com/FaneraApp
* https://twitter.com/FaneraApp
* https://www.instagram.com/faneraapp/

bluejetty:00176107:ios.name: Artify: Art History, Paintings
bluejetty:00176107:ios.summary: Discover the stories behind paintings, meet the artists who made them and build your understanding of art history. Artify brings artwork discovery, guided learning and daily art games together, so you can follow your curiosity from one pict
bluejetty:00176107:ios.description:
Discover the stories behind paintings, meet the artists who made them and build your understanding of art history. Artify brings artwork discovery, guided learning and daily art games together, so you can follow your curiosity from one picture to a wider world of ideas.
MAKE ART PART OF YOUR DAY
Start with the daily artwork or explore a story that catches your eye. Read about the people, ideas and details behind the image, then follow your interest to an artist, collection or art movement. A familiar painting can become the beginning of a new discovery; an unfamiliar work can introduce a different way of seeing.
LEARN ART HISTORY STEP BY STEP
Art Journeys give your exploration a direction. Follow a sequence of lessons, read the material, answer questions and return to your progress. Connect individual works with the periods and movements around them. You can approach a subject through a guided route or explore the catalog at your own pace, without needing to begin with specialist knowledge.
LOOK CLOSER AT ARTWORKS AND ARTISTS
Browse paintings and other artworks, read artist biographies and explore collections. Discover how a work relates to its creator and the ideas of its time. Search for a subject you already know or let a new name lead you somewhere unexpected. Explore by artist, movement or color and use the details on each page to decide what to read next.
PUT YOUR EYE FOR ART TO THE TEST
Turn discovery into a challenge with daily art games. Try the daily questions, guess an artist in Artdle, match paintings with their creators or identify an artwork from a blurred image. Each format gives you a different reason to look carefully. Play for the pleasure of recognizing a work and revisit the artists and stories that interest you afterwards.
EXPLORE MUSEUMS AND COLLECTIONS
Browse museum information and discover artworks connected with collections. Use Artify to explore an artistic interest before a visit or to keep that interest alive afterwards. Move between an artwork, its artist and the wider context, building connections that are easy to miss when you see a painting on its own.
BUILD A LIBRARY THAT REFLECTS YOUR TASTE
Keep favorite artworks and artists close at hand. Create named lists around a movement, an artist or a theme of your own. Keep a list private or make it public to share your discoveries. Browse public lists from other art lovers and find new ideas for what to explore. Your saved favorites make it easier to return to an image or story that stayed with you.
LISTEN WITH ARTIFY PREMIUM
Prefer to listen? Premium offers narration for supported artwork and artist content, giving you another way to explore the stories. Premium is also required for image downloads and for content marked as Premium. On iOS, add the small Artify Home Screen widget to keep art nearby. Available content, languages and offers are shown in the app.
FOLLOW YOUR OWN CURIOSITY
Artify is for curious beginners, art lovers and anyone who enjoys understanding what they see. Open a guided lesson when you want a little structure, try a quiz when you want a challenge, or return to your lists when you want inspiration. There is no single right place to start: choose the work, artist or question that interests you today.
ACCESS AND LANGUAGES
An internet connection is required. Some content and features require Premium; check the offer in the app before subscribing. Translations and narration availability vary by content. Explore, read, play and save the discoveries that make art history meaningful to you.
PRIVACY & TERMS
Privacy Policy: https://www.getartify.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.getartify.app/terms-of-service
Questions, feedback, or museum partnership inquiries? Email us at support@getartify.app — we'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00073880:ios.summary:

Shadow hunter is an action-packed dark fantasy hack and slash game with an i
bluejetty:00073880:ios.description:
Hardcore Hack’n Slash Action-RPG.
The must try game for any real hack and slash fan who already got bored with just mindlessly smashing buttons on the screen.
Shadow hunter is an action-packed dark fantasy hack and slash game with an incredible combat system and awesome boss fights, assisted by a one of a kind character control mechanism and a perfect mix of RPG elements to make your adventure super immersive.
A DARKENED, RUINED AND FULL OF SUFFERING SHADOW WORLD
As the mortal world got invaded and destroyed by the horde of dark demons and shadow monsters, everything was covered in the darkness of hell and the constant insufferable noises that were the combination of the endless scream from those evils and the crying and mourning of the lucky few that manage to survive through this nightmare.
The player will be a Shadow Hunter in this world, which is someone who got blessed by the Ancient One with a special power to fight off those dark demons. 
Through countless battles and obstacles, shadow hunters are destined to bring the light back to this mortal world.
EPIC BOSS FIGHT
Shadow Hunter's most exciting moments must be it's epic boss battle, in which the Hunters must defeat dark giant demons to collect their souls and advance to the darkest dungeon and the highest floor of the evil tower. 
Without a decent set of equipment and highly trained techniques, any player could easily get wrecked by those big bosses. 
However, the incredible feelings that players get from successfully overcoming those challenges will make it all worth it. 
Furthermore, those dark demon souls are the key to upgrade hundreds of shadow equipment and weapons, turning them from just a common warrior sword to a legendary hero's blade that would be worshiped by the generations to come.
ENDLESS CHALLENGES
Shadow Hunter will have 4+ different PVE sections with multiple difficulty modes and a PVP arena for players to explore and conquer.
“Adventure” is where players start the game with. It may not be the most challenging part, but it is the most essential section in the game since you need to keep advancing through it to unlock further sections of the game.
Once you have passed a certain dungeon level, you can unlock “Altar of the Darkness” , “Boss Mode” and “Clock Tower of Challenges”. Those are where the true test of skill and power happens. For our shadow hunters to overcome those challenges, mastering the fighting technique is a must, understanding the characteristics of each demon and preparing a suitable strategy is needed and strengthening the shadow equipment is a huge plus. 
At the end of the day, shadow hunters can not only liberate the mortal world from those dark demons but also can test their skills and mastery against other fellows of the shadow. 
MULTIPLE CHARACTERS TO PLAY AND ROLL
Players will get to play as multiple different characters, each has its own unique skills, gameplay and assets. Each character is going to be a distinct way to play the game, a distinct approach to the strategy and the combat.
KEY FEATURES
Intense hack and slash combat.
Epic Boss Fights.
Multiple characters to play.
Hundreds of equipment and weapons to loot and upgrade.
4+ PVE modes and PVP.
Play anytime, anywhere even when offline.
Visit Here to Learn More About Shadow Hunter:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SHLostWorld
Twitter: https://twitter.com/shlostworld

bluejetty:00030649:ios.description:
Step into a magical world of matching games and puzzles, where casual match-3 mechanics, rich story progression, and relaxing tile matching come together! Experience the perfect blend of classic puzzles, immersive storylines, and creative merge gameplay in one addictive adventure.
Enjoy one of the best puzzle games for adults designed for casual players. Whether you enjoy matching games, puzzle solving, or fun decoration games, this adventure delivers everything you love—classic match-3 fun, a heartwarming story, and relaxing garden renovation in one place.
FEATURES
- Classic Match-3 Gameplay
Experience the timeless fun of puzzle games and tile matching. Swap, match, and clear levels with satisfying effects and cleverly designed puzzle layouts. 
- Powerful Boosters & Tools
Unlock a wide variety of exciting boosters. Use rockets, bombs, and special power-ups to clear difficult levels and create amazing combos. Strategic gameplay makes every match more rewarding.
- Rich Storyline Adventure
Follow an engaging story filled with drama, mystery, and heartwarming moments. Each puzzle level you complete unlocks more chapters and deepens your journey.
- Merge & Renovate
Enjoy relaxing merge gameplay. Combine items, upgrade tools, and unlock new resources to expand your world and restore a beautiful garden.
- Decorate Your Dream Space
Use rewards from puzzle levels to decorate and transform your garden into a blooming paradise with customized designs.
- Fun & Relaxing for Everyone
Perfect for casual players and fans of relaxing puzzle games for adults. Relax your mind, think strategically, and enjoy stress-free gameplay.
- Daily Rewards & Events
Get bonuses, special rewards, and participate in fun limited-time challenges every day. Frequent seasonal events keep the casual experience fresh and exciting.
HOW TO PLAY
- Swap and match 3 or more items to clear the puzzle board.
- Complete level objectives to advance the narrative in this engaging story game.
- Use powerful boosters and props to solve tricky puzzle levels.
- Merge items on the board to unlock garden upgrades and tools.
- Collect resources to decorate your dream garden your way.
- Unlock new chapters and dive deeper into the grand adventure.
Looking for a relaxing, immersive story and puzzle adventure? This game combines everything into one perfect experience. Start your adventure today to match, merge, and explore while building your dream garden.

bluejetty:00170103:ios.description:
Join 250,000 confident home cooks. Recipes you'll actually make, with what you've already got. Start your free 7-day trial.
Two Raw Sisters is the food confidence app for people who want to eat well without the stress, the overthinking, or the guilt. No diets. No rules. Just delicious food that works with your life and your fridge.
Created by 5x bestselling cookbook authors Margo and Rosa. Two women who've been through it - one with chronic fatigue healed by food and the other a difficult relationship with eating rebuilt from the inside out. They came out the other side with one mission: to prove that eating well is simpler than the world is making it.
RECIPES THAT WORK WITH WHAT YOU'VE GOT 
900+ nutritionist-approved recipes, with 3 new ones added every week. Every recipe is a guideline, not a rulebook. Search by ingredient to use what's already in your kitchen, swap anything you don't have, add your protein of choice, and adapt instantly for gluten-free or dairy-free. Save your tweaks as recipe notes so every recipe becomes yours. You should never have to adapt to our recipes. They should adapt to you.
EAT IN SEASON, WHEREVER YOU ARE 
Ingredient swaps and seasonal suggestions are localised to your region so you're always cooking with what's fresh and available near you.
THE INTELLIGENTLY LAZY SYSTEM 
Batch breakfast on Sunday. Make a snack once a fortnight. Save tonight's leftovers for tomorrow's lunch. With three meals sorted in advance, dinner becomes the only decision you need to make each day. Members call it "feeling like I'm nailing life."
SHOP SMARTER 
Turn any recipe into a shopping list, automatically organised by fridge, pantry, and fresh produce. Swap any ingredient for what's already in your kitchen so you're only buying what you actually need. Add custom items like toothpaste. Tick things off as you shop. 
COOK WITH CONFIDENCE 
Cook mode keeps your screen on so the recipe stays visible the whole time - no more tapping to wake your phone with floury hands. Adjust serving sizes, filter by dietary needs, and save personalised folders for your weekly plan, go-to snacks, and favourite breakfasts.
WHAT YOU GET 
- Search by ingredient to cook to find a recipe that uses what you have
- Swap ingredients for what's already in your kitchen 
- Optional add-on proteins for every savoury dish 
- Recipe notes to capture your tweaks and make it your own 
- Cook mode ensures your screen stays on while you cook 
- Automated shopping lists sorted by supermarket section 
- Personalised folders for weekly planning 
- Localised seasonal swap suggestions 
- Filter by meal, time, season, dietary need including gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free and low FODMAP
- 3 new recipes added every week
- Margo and Rosa’s weekly meal plans
Rated 4.9 stars. 1,300+ reviews.
Try the Two Raw Sisters App free for 7 days. No commitment. Cancel anytime. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled.
Privacy Policy: https://tworawsisters.com/privacy-policy/ 
Terms of Use: https://tworawsisters.com/termsandconditions/

bluejetty:00142050:ios.description:
IMPORTANT: Full telephony functionality is only available as directed by your telephone service provider. 
With MaX UC, you can take control of your home or office telephony services on any device, wherever you are.
For the past year we have focused on making our MaX UC apps more accessible. Important enhancements like supporting landscape mode, large font size and full screen reader support means that MaX UC meets the WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines. This is an important milestone that helps us to support all our users, no matter their access needs.
Key features:
- High quality audio optimized for both Wi-Fi, and 3G/4G connections.
- Chat on any device to others in your business, with messages synced across your devices so you can pick up the conversation any time.
- Powerful voicemail control with alerts, transcriptions of your received messages, and visual voicemail management.
- Realtime presence from your business contacts to help you get in touch at the right time, and custom presence to help others reach you.
NOTE: Your service provider may not offer all features listed or may require you to pay additional subscription charges to access certain features. Contact your service provider for information. MaX UC also requires data or Wi-Fi access. Use of these services may incur additional charges.

Choose from predefined themes or create your own keyboard by customizing background colors, text size, and more. With the ability to save multiple custom themes, you have endless options to personalize your setup. It works seamlessly across all apps that require a keyboard, ensuring a consistent, personalized experience.

Prioritizing privacy, no Full Access is required, ensuring your personal data remains safe. Bigger Keyboard never stores or accesses what you type.
This is a one-time purchase app, with no subscriptions, ads, or additional purchases.

bluejetty:00061566:ios.description:
Priority Matrix uses the 4-quadrants method to help you focus on top priorities and projects. When you use Priority Matrix, you become more accountable to yourself, and ensure that you are spending time where it matters most.
Priority Matrix helps you and your team work on the right thing at the right time. With everybody rowing in the same direction, you will reach your goals on time.
PRIORITIZE
Each of your projects or initiatives can be organized as a priority matrix, which is a powerful methodology to prioritize your tasks. Focus always on the right things.
MANAGE PROJECTS
Keep projects private or collaborate with your team.
Visualize each project as a matrix and in your calendar.
COLLABORATE 
You can create projects and tasks, set deadlines, share notes, upload files, add comments, assign tasks to other team members, complete tasks and more from the app. 
EXPLORE YOUR DATA
With advanced filtering and search, managers sort tasks by owner, status, date, etc.
Daily, weekly, and monthly reports provide deep team productivity insights. 
INTEGRATE WITH TOOLS YOU LOVE
Email: Apple Mail, Outlook, Gmail, etc.
Calendar: iCal, iOS reminders, Outlook, Google Calendar, etc.
Chat Bots for Slack and Skype
Everything else: Google Docs, Siri, etc.
MORE FEATURES? 
Upgrade to Priority Matrix Pro for premium features, including:
Desktop apps for macOS and Windows
Larger teams
Extra storage space
Advanced reporting
Gantt visualization mode
Version control for your changes
Read-only data sharing with clients
Productivity coaching and webinars
-------------------------------------------------
If you choose to purchase Priority Matrix Pro, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. The current Priority Matrix Pro starts at $149 USD/year. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. If you don't choose to purchase Priority Matrix Pro, you can simply continue using Priority Matrix for free.

bluejetty:00147129:ios.description:
Welcome to Fun Widgets!We are a fantastic mobile home screen customization app, packed with a huge collection of widgets, icons, wallpapers, and themes—plus a wealth of DIY tools! We can’t wait to dive into personalized home screen makeovers with you. Let's have FUN together!
---Featured Functions---
● 【OS26】Fun Pomodoro Timer
Enjoy creative Pomodoro timer modes: whether you want a "companionship" style, a productivity-focused one, or even a video call with your idol—this timer maximizes that sense of companionship!
● 【Home Screen Pet】Widget: Adorable Pets Take Over Your Phone
Our exclusive home screen pet feature lets you pick your favorite character or create a custom one, bringing them to life right on your phone.
● 【Custom Transparent Icons】
Want to change icon shapes? Or need icons with transparent backgrounds? Head here to mix and match for DIY—every small icon can be totally unique!
---Popular Functions---
● 【OS18】Control Center Widget
● Creator Center Fully Upgraded: Become a Home Screen Styling Pro Too
● 【OS17】Interactive Widgets / Standby Widgets
● Interactive options: 8-Glass Water Tracker, To-Do List, Electronic Wooden Fish, Multi-Voice Photo Wall, etc.—just tap to interact directly.
● Standby widgets: Fully launched for use while charging, letting you enjoy widget fun even when your phone is on standby.
● 【OS16】Lock Screen Widgets: Convenient, Fast & Stylish
● Dynamic Island Live Activities
● Rich Home Screen Widgets: Make Your Phone Come Alive
● Productivity Widgets: X Panel, Countdown, Weather, Clock, Calendar, Quick Launch, Battery Level, News Rankings, Health Steps & Sleep Dashboard.
● Beauty Widgets: Scrolling Photo Wall, Sliding Photos, Ambient Voice, Daily Quote, Dynamic Photos, Smart Panel, Avatar Badges—both introverts (i-people) and extroverts (e-people) have their own unique touches!
● Fun Widgets: Electronic Badge Collection, Worker’s Calendar, Lunar New Year God of Wealth, Auspicious Message Bulletins—balance productivity and stress relief.
● Wallpapers with Endless Styles: Get Any Look You Want
● DIY Wallpaper Wall: Create your own wallpaper by replacing exclusive backgrounds and album photos—every wallpaper is unique and cute, making you your own designer.
● Dynamic Wallpapers: Cool launch effects in styles like trendy, Chinese style, and anime—light up your phone for an immersive experience.
● Static Wallpapers: Crafted by professional illustrators and designers, covering popular trends, cute, summer, fresh, scenery, animals, food, ins, and anime—choose from countless styles!
● Custom Editing: Why Be Like Everyone Else?
【HealthKit and CareKit Permissions】
Fun Widgets optionally integrates with apple Health App. It's used to display your data if you use widgets such as health-steps or sleep widgets, please allow APP to obtain health-related data when adding.
【Subscription Description】
Your free trial will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period.
You can cancel anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account-settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. Cancellation will come into effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.

User Agreement：https://cdn.fun-widget.haoqimiao.net/static/html/web-main/user-policy-en.html

bluejetty:00129079:ios.description:
A pro Tabla player in your pocket, will jam and improvise as a real player.
- HUGE RHYTHM LIBRARY: +800 rhythms, including Traditional Hindustani Taals and Modern adaptations, funkyfied Taals, Fusion, Pop, Shuffle... 
Rhythms adapted for only Tabla ( Mridangam or Pakhawaj ... ) and full Indian Percussion Ensemble, adding Kanjira and Ghatam. 
- Tanpura with Tone selector.
- Advanced AI for musical jam - improvisation. YOu will never get bored of playinf the same rhythm. No more boring Loops.
- All Traditional Hindustani Taals: Teentaal, Tilwada, Keherwa, Jhaptal, Dhamar, Ada Chau, Shiva Taal, Dadra, Rupak, Jhampak, Yamuna, Mogholi, Pauri, Tivra, Ektaal and many more ...
- Tabla, Kanjira, Ghatam, Mridangam, Khol, Pakhawaj, Dhol and much more. Multilayer Round Robin Sampled sounds providing extremely warm and realistic sounds.
- Live Pads lets to play live sessions on the way with 8 assignable pads and buttons for fills, intro, end with customizable midi controls.
- 4 Board Mode to control Live Pads with any Midi Controller with just 4 buttons, like iRig Blueboard.
- Synchronize with any music app easily with Ableton Link.
- Mixer allowing to Tune any individual instrument.
- 4 Effects: Compressor, Equalizer, Delay, Reverb.
- Song Mode. Extra fast tool to create rhythmic structures for your song in seconds.
- Export Audio & Midi

bluejetty:00018193:ios.description:
NueSynergy Mobile provides a single access point for participants to manage their consumer driven healthcare and other tax-favored benefit accounts. NueSynergy Mobile shares user authentication with the NueSynergy Online Participant Portal, meaning that registered users can merely download the application and log in to immediately gain mobile access to their benefit accounts, with no need to register their mobile phone. NueSynergy Mobile provides the following functionality with its initial release:
• Detailed Account Information
• Account balances and details
• Recent Transactions and Details
• Ability to fund HSA account from checking/savings account
• View all email and SMS alerts
• Contact administrator from mobile application via email or mobile phone
• Same username /password as NueSynergy Online Participant Portal (no need to register your mobile device, just download, login, and go!)
• Stronger Authentication support (Picture/Passphrase, device identification and Challenge)

bluejetty:00151862:ios.summary:

Open the app and see a
bluejetty:00151862:ios.description:
Motherhood is beautiful, but at 2AM when you're the only one awake, it can feel impossibly lonely. Beacon shows you that you're not alone and lets you connect with other moms in your neighborhood or across the globe.
Open the app and see a live map of mothers who are awake right now, near you. Light your own beacon so another mom knows she's not the only one up. Track your mood, log your baby's feeds, sleep, and diaper changes and connect with a community of women who truly get it.
LIGHT YOUR BEACON
Share your light anonymously and see thousands of other moms' beacons glowing across the map. Locations are randomized within 10 miles of your true location to keep you safe while helping you feel connected. Knowing other mothers are awake and showing up is a powerful reminder: you are not alone in this.
CIRCLES: YOUR SMALL GROUP OF MOMS
Get matched into a private Circle of a few moms like you, based on where you are in your motherhood journey. Circles are small on purpose, so it feels like real friendship.
BABY TRACKER
Log your baby's feedings, sleep, and diaper changes in seconds. See patterns over time and simplify those conversations with your pediatrician or partner. Whether you're breastfeeding, pumping, or formula feeding, Beacon makes tracking effortless.
MOOD & WELLNESS TRACKING
Log your mood, sleep, energy, and emotions each day. Watch patterns unfold over time and gain real insight into your mental health during postpartum recovery. Use your mood data to start honest conversations with your partner, provider, or therapist.
POSTPARTUM JOURNAL
Capture your thoughts, milestones, and feelings as you navigate early motherhood. Write when you need to process, celebrate, or simply vent. Your journal is private and always there when you need it.
COMMUNITY FORUM
Connect with other moms in a private, supportive space. Ask questions, share your story, offer encouragement, or just vent without judgment. No highlight reels — just real mothers supporting each other through the ups and downs.
TRUSTED GUIDES & RESOURCES
Access expert-backed information written specifically for postpartum life — from healing tips and nutrition guidance to relationship advice, mental health tools, and newborn care essentials.
HELPFUL TOOLS & CALCULATORS
Simplify your day with breastfeeding and pumping calculators, postpartum exercise guidance, recovery checklists, and daily self-care reminders including mindfulness exercises and gentle movement ideas.
SAFE & PRIVATE
Your location, data, and personal information are always protected. Beacons appear only as randomized points within 10 miles of your true location.
WHY MOMS LOVE BEACON
Real, honest, and supportive — not another highlight reel. Beacon helps you see that you're part of something bigger: a network of mothers lighting up the world together. Whether you're a first-time mom navigating sleepless nights, a seasoned parent balancing it all, or someone healing from postpartum anxiety or depression, Beacon is a gentle reminder that your light matters.
Download Beacon today. Even in your darkest nights, there are lights shining with you.

Beacon offers optional premium subscriptions with auto-renewable billing:
Monthly: $9.99/month
Annual: $59.99/year (save 50%)
Premium features include detailed mood tracking, baby tracker, AI-powered insights, advanced analytics, community forum access, postpartum journal, and premium guides.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00015429:ios.description:
***************************
Use Telugu Everywhere
***************************
◉ Best Telugu Keyboard Ever
◉ Type the English word, Get the Telugu Meaning Instantly Offline
◉ Easy Letter Suggestions - Offline
◉ 50% More Faster than normal keyboards 
◉ Easily differentiate the Letters
◉ Get suggestions for the letters 
◉ Help Grow Our Telugu Community
◉ Please Support Development By sharing with others
-------------------------------------
HOW TO INSTALL MANA TELUGU KEYBOARD
-------------------------------------
Once you downloaded the app from Appstore.
Step 1: Go to iPhone settings.
Step 2: Find General And Click on it.
Step 3:Scroll Down to bottom and see Keyboard option, Click on it.
Step 4: Click on the Keyboards Row.
Step 5: Scroll Down bottom of the screen and find "Add New Keyboard" Option and tap on it.
Step 6: Scroll down and find the Mana Telugu Keyboard Option And tap on it, Thats it you are done.
Now finally open any of the WhatsApp,Facebook,Email,Notes,Twitter, sms app, and long press the Globe icon from the default keyboard, now choose the Mana Telugu Keyboard Option.
**************************
The smartest Telugu keyboard for iPhone — type in English, 
get Telugu script instantly.
◉ TRANSLITERATION
Type "nenu" → నేను. Type "ela unnav" → ఎలా ఉన్నావ్. 
No need to learn complex key layouts — just type naturally 
in English (Tenglish) and the keyboard converts it to perfect 
Telugu script in real time.
◉ SMART WORD SUGGESTIONS
As you type, the top bar shows Telugu word predictions pulled 
from a database of 600,000+ Telugu words. The more you type, 
the smarter it gets with next-word prediction.
◉ WORKS EVERYWHERE
Works in WhatsApp, Instagram, Messages, Gmail — any app on 
your iPhone. Switch between Telugu and English with one tap.
◉ EMOJI & SYMBOL FRIENDLY
Add emojis or symbols after your word — they stay attached 
when you select a suggestion. Nothing gets lost.
◉ BUILT FOR TELUGU SPEAKERS
• 600,000+ Telugu word database
• Tenglish → Telugu live transliteration
• Next-word prediction (bigram model)
• Supports Andhra & Telangana vocabulary
• Clean, fast, no internet needed

bluejetty:00097142:ios.description:
Powerful Clean helps turn a crowded iPhone gallery into an easier, faster space to manage. Use AI-powered cleanup tools to find duplicate photos, blurry shots, similar images, short videos, and other media that may be taking up room.
Instead of scrolling through thousands of photos by hand, ask the built-in AI assistant for what you need. Search for large videos, locate screenshots, organize albums, or review cleanup suggestions in a simple guided flow.
KEY FEATURES
- Detect duplicate and similar photos
- Find blurry, low-quality, and repeated images
- Review large or unnecessary videos before deleting
- Use AI assistant prompts for faster gallery cleanup
- Sort media by themes, objects, moments, and locations
- Free up storage without losing control of your memories
PHOTO AND VIDEO CLEANER
Powerful Clean is built for users who want a cleaner camera roll without the stress of manual sorting. Preview suggested items, choose what to keep, and remove only the files you approve.
AI ASSISTANT FOR CLEANUP
Type simple requests such as ""find large videos"" or ""show similar selfies"" and let the assistant help narrow down your clutter. It is a faster way to organize old media, screenshots, and repeated photos.
PRIVACY-FIRST EXPERIENCE
Your photos, videos, and personal media stay on your device. Cleanup suggestions are designed to help you make decisions, not delete content automatically.
If your iPhone storage feels full or your gallery is hard to browse, Powerful Clean gives you a smarter way to organize, review, and clean up your media.
Download Powerful Clean and start making space today.

It's fast, without queues and long waits. No more paperwork, lon
bluejetty:00162019:ios.description:
Try Between us service! The easiest way how to send a parcel to another person in Czech, Slovak, Hungary and Romania. You can use our pick-up points or home delivery service. 
It's fast, without queues and long waits. No more paperwork, long forms or printing labels. All of that from 3,40 €.
What's in the app?
Send a shipment - Between us
No more paperwork, forms or printing labels. With our mobile application, in which you can find the Between us service, you can send a shipment in a moment. All you need is a phone and an online payment. You can pay online with card or via Apple Pay.
Returning the shipment
Do you need to return a shipment to the e-shop? No problem. The application enables a simple return of the shipment, you only need to enter the code that you received from the e-shop. You don't need to fill in anything else.
Tracking
Thanks to the detailed tracking of the shipment and the connection with our system, you will know exactly where the shipment is located.
Push Notifications
Be informed. The app will notify you immediately when the shipment is ready for pickup.
Delivery points
Thanks to the interactive map, you can search for the nearest delivery points in the area. At the same time, the built-in filter allows you to select those places where you can pay by card, for example. You will then find a description of how to get there, including photos or opening hours, in the details of the delivery point.
Shipment archive
In the shipment archive, you can view all your shipments that have ever been paired with your account.

bluejetty:00072507:ios.description:
In this vibrant and cartoonish universe, your child will be delighted to meet a variety of adorable bugs, from bees and ants to caterpillars, butterflies, dragonflies, and beetles! But beware the spiky fluff monster! This game is the perfect fun-filled adventure that engages your little ones and provides a chance for parents to get those small moments back in their day.
With its unique and simple gameplay, Squishy Squash brings endless fun with its power-ups, fun sounds and bug varieties. Your child will be absorbed in this colorful and entertaining world, tapping and squishing with their new bug friends. Spark curiosity and master your tapping skills with a game that’s designed for toddlers with parents also in mind. Squishy Squash delivers a gaming experience that parents can trust and children can embrace.
Squishy Squash is a game that can keep your toddler entertained in any situation! Perfect for those moments when you need to wait at a doctor's office, or catch a break. 
With NO ads, you can rest assured that this child friendly game is safe for kids of any age. We've poured hours into this vibrant and engaging game, where colour, shapes, fun and learning all come together for one fun Squishy Squash adventure! Will you master Squishy Squash and smash your high score?
The team behind Squishy Squash recognize the challenges faced by parents in balancing work, life, and parenting responsibilities. Our mission is to give you those small moments back in your day by providing a safe and engaging experience for kids.
Trusted by parents from around the world, Squishy Squash stands out in the market with its safe, engaging gameplay and colourful characters. 
Join the Squishy Squash family now! 
Please note that we are constantly striving to improve and evolve the game, and your feedback is greatly appreciated! In fact, we encourage you to send us videos of your Squishing and Squashing action for us to share on social media. 
For any issues or suggestions, email hello@squishysquash.co.nz . We're always happy to help our Squishy Squash community grow and thrive! 
It's time to squish, squash, learn, and have a blast with Squishy Squash!

bluejetty:00074286:ios.description:
Before you start: To use all features of the app, you’ll need a real piano or a musical keyboard.
Simpia is the fun, easy, and effective way to learn piano—from absolute beginner to confident pianist. Whether you're just starting or looking to enhance your skills, Simpia adapts to your level and helps you improve rapidly.
Play Your First Song Today
Simpia works perfectly with any piano or keyboard, whether acoustic, digital, or MIDI controller. Simply place your device nearby, play along, and receive instant, precise feedback on your notes and rhythm.
Why Choose Simpia?
- A step-by-step courses from beginner to advanced, crafted by professional educators and suitable for every level.
- Instant AI feedback that tells you right away whether each note you play is correct.
- Experience a variety of music genres, from classical to popular songs.
- Personalized Learning: Customized daily workouts tailored specifically to your skill level and musical goals.
- Advanced Tools: Comprehensive AI, MIDI and Bluetooth MIDI support for enhanced practice sessions.
Get Started Free! 
Enjoy daily limited time free for all lessons and songs. 
Or Start your free trial today and experience all we have to offer!
Upgrade to Premium for
- Full access to all courses & advanced lesson features.
- Complete song library and exclusive lessons
- Personalized daily learning content with daily workout and tutor
- Advanced AI feedback with MIDI and Bluetooth MIDI integration.
- Unlimited, unrestricted daily practice sessions.
Simpia Subscription:
Enjoy unlimited access to all courses and features with flexible Monthly, 3-Month or Annual plans (prices displayed in-app).The subscription is linked to your Apple ID and works on any iOS device using that account. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase, and the plan renews automatically at the current price within 24 hours before each term ends unless you disable auto-renew at least 24 hours in advance in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions. You can manage or cancel your plan there at any time. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you subscribe. Subscriptions stay active until the end of the paid period and can’t be cancelled mid-cycle.
Questions or feedback? We're always happy to hear from you directly via our in-app "Have a Question" support chat.
Download now and play your first song today!
*** HAVE FUN! ***

Welcome to Shack Bucks® Rewards!
The Shack Bucks® Rewards program gives you, our customer, the easiest way to order delicious Chicken Shack food, save you time, and save you money while you stack up Shack Bucks® and earn free food and rewards at the same time!
We offer some great features:

Order your favorite items from The Chicken Shack with just a couple clicks. Choose from dine-in, takeout, or delivery.

Link as many payment options as you like in the app and every time you order, YOU'RE EARNING! No phone numbers, no emails, just use your card and the points magically appear for you to see and redeem!

The Chicken Shack was born in Henderson, Nevada, in 2005, just a few miles from the Entertainment Capital of the World........the Las Vegas Strip! Start with our Honey BBQ and dare yourself to make it to the top of the heat list and toss 'em in Damn Hot!
Find out more about us at mychickenshack.com or chickenshackinfo.com. Follow us on Facebook and Instagram @thechickenshackusa or on TikTok @thechickenshackus!!

bluejetty:00119653:ios.name: TAXA 4x35 - Easy taxi booking
bluejetty:00119653:ios.summary:
