With approx. 1,000 cars the average waiting time is 5 minutes in Copenhagen. More than 50% of our fleet
bluejetty:00119653:ios.description:
Easy taxi booking in the greater capital area - including Copenhagen City, Copenhagen Airport (CPH), Roskilde, Hillerød and Fredensborg.
With approx. 1,000 cars the average waiting time is 5 minutes in Copenhagen. More than 50% of our fleet are zero-emission electric cars.
>> HOW TO USE THE APP
1) See the expected waiting time:
Open the app – the first thing you will see is the expected waiting time based on your current location.
2) Calculate your price:
Insert a pickup and a destination address to get a fixed price offer instantly. You may then choose whether to book at a fixed price or to drive on meter rates.
3) Choose fixed price or meter rates:
When booking at a fixed price you avoid worrying about unexpected traffic changes, traffic congestion etc. that prolong your ride and thus increase the price. With a fixed price you know the price in advance, no matter the unexpected delays in traffic that may occur.
4) Payment:
We recommend payment from inside the app using a credit card or MobilePay. This enables you to get straight on with your everyday when arriving to your destination, instead of waiting for credit card terminals inside the car. As an alternative, you may also choose to pay inside the car by Apple Pay, Google Pay or with cash.
5) Rate your ride:
Completing your ride, we encourage you to rate your experience with us. Thank you.
>> OTHER BENEFITS WHEN USING THE TAXI APP
- Follow your taxi approaching while you wait
- Wish for a Zero Emission car
- Get receipts by e-mail
- Earn loyalty discount on 9 trips and use your discount on your trip number 10
- Access your history of taxi rides
- Get a company account and avoid payment in the car
>> HIGHEST SERVICE STANDARD
All chauffeurs at TAXA 4x35 needs to comply with the corporate service quality standards. That include mandatory day courses with a final exam – a unique requirement among the taxi suppliers in Denmark. Furthermore, all working chauffeurs has to meet the minimum required average customer rating of 4.7 out of 5 stars. By means of mystery-shopping we are continuously doing sample controls throughout each year.
We acknowledge that our service quality standards are the essential reason we are able to serve our customers the best service. That is why TAXA only receives 0.05% complaints on 10,000 daily rides!
>> GOT A QUESTION OR FEEDBACK FOR US?
We would love to hear from you. Please contact us at taxa.dk/en/customer-service/contact/

bluejetty:00066109:ios.description:
Mahjong Deluxe is a solitaire game based on the classic Chinese game where you are challenged to eliminate all the tiles from the board. It includes 13 lovely backgrounds and 3,780 different puzzle layouts along with relaxing background music. Besides the classic Chinese theme, it also has a bonus down on the farm theme and lots of fun animal sounds. You will find hours of fun as you eliminate all the tiles from the board. 
Mahjong is played with a set of tiles based on Chinese characters and symbols and made for us in China. Find matching pairs of images at the left and right ends of the lines in the various puzzles to remove the tiles from the board. Each puzzle layout randomizes tile orders so you can play the same puzzle many times with it never being the same.
Features:
* 3,780 different mahjong puzzle layouts with a different tile order each time.
* 8 different backgrounds to choose from.
* Plus 4 Christmas backgrounds that also play holiday spirit songs in the background when chosen.
* Bonus barnyard theme with tiles, farm backgrounds, music and fun animal sounds.
* Great background music and sounds.
Relax and enjoy this beautiful game today!

bluejetty:00184985:ios.name: Pixel Starships™
bluejetty:00184985:ios.summary:
Featured by Apple in Best New Games! From one of the most successful Mobile Game Kickstarter campaigns of the year comes Pixel Starships!
Pixel Starships is the world’s first total spaceship management game in an 8bit massive online unive
bluejetty:00184985:ios.description:
Featured by Apple in Best New Games! From one of the most successful Mobile Game Kickstarter campaigns of the year comes Pixel Starships!
Pixel Starships is the world’s first total spaceship management game in an 8bit massive online universe. In Pixel Starships, you command every aspect of your ship from construction to battles in a single persistent world.
Featured Reviews -
Touch Arcade - Pixel Starships tasks you with outfitting your very own ship with resource rooms, staff, and weapons. This looks Awesome!
MMGN - The graphics in this 8Bit indie game is the best we've seen in a retro style game for a long time
PocketTactics - I’m intrigued by the cutaway side-view of the starship with turbolifts and transporters at the ready 
TechTimes - The World’s First 8-Bit Total Starship Management Game Hits The Online Universe
The Discovery Channel - A fully immersive starship captain experience.
Key Features -
● Build Epic Starships of your own design.
● Many races, aliens, factions to command and conquer.
● Battle it out with other real players in a single massive online universe.
● Manage diplomacy, recruitment, research, exploration!
● Control ship's power and limited resources. Discover epic weapons.
● Build and deploy support ships to support your Starfleet.
● Cross section full ship control and battles.
● Explore planets, discover secrets of space.
● Form alliances and battle with your friends to achieve victory!
● Program situational AI commands to systems and crew allowing automatic combats and offline play.
If you're a fan of Star Wars and Star Trek; if you enjoy games like EVE, Clash of Clans, FTL, or Homeworld, you'll love Pixel Starships!
Note -
Pixel Starships is totally free to play and is designed for perfect balance for all players. However, there are in-app items that can be purchased for real money to help speed up progress or offer cosmetic improvements. If you don't want this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. 
Note on Auto-Renewing Subscription - 
Pixel Starships contains a optional Subscription Membership. Members receive extra missions, bonuses, and daily rewards. Membership content is regularly updated. 
The Monthly Membership Subscription cost is USD $3.99 per month or a similarly adjusted currency price in your local region. Please refer to IAP menu or in app display for localised pricing. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
The subscription is auto renewable and will renew monthly unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscription can be cancelled via iTunes subscription manager. There is also a 7 day free trial for the membership; the free trial period is not transferrable and any remaining free time is cancelled if a paying subscription starts.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
EULA: http://www.pixelstarships.com/eula
Privacy Policy: http://www.pixelstarships.com/privacypolicy
As per Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, you must be at least 13 years of age to play or download Pixel Starships.

Finally — an app that shows you all the tasty drinks you can make from the stuff you've got.
Cocktail Party is beautiful, easy to use, and chock-full of balanced, delicious cocktails anyone can make at home.
Check off ingredients you have, and Cocktail Party will show you all the drinks you can make right now. It’s that easy - no shopping trip required!
Cocktail Party is jam-packed with the best recipes – everything from hundred-year-old classics to modern masterpieces from up-and-coming new mixologists.
Have brandy but not cognac? Rye, but no bourbon? Cocktail Party is smart enough to use appropriate substitutions from the ingredients you already have.
Cocktail Party works wherever you are. Choose from imperial or metric measurements, and search for ingredients by their regional names. We’re constantly adding new drinks and ingredients from all over the world.
What you won’t find in Cocktail Party:
* No sour mix!
* No obnoxiously specific B®and-name™ re©ipes
* Did we mention no ads? No pushy popups, either.
* No in-app purchases - you buy it once, you get updates and new drinks forever.

Finally — an app that shows you all the tasty drinks you can make from the stuff you've got.

Cocktail Party is beautiful, easy to use, and chock-full of balanced, delicious cocktails anyone can make at home.

Check off ingredients you have, and Cocktail Party will show you all the drinks you can make right now. It’s that easy - no shopping trip required!

Cocktail Party is jam-packed with the best recipes – everything from hundred-year-old classics to modern masterpieces from up-and-coming new mixologists.

Have brandy but not cognac? Rye, but no bourbon? Cocktail Party is smart enough to use appropriate substitutions from the ingredients you already have.

Cocktail Party works wherever you are. Choose from imperial or metric measurements, and search for ingredients by their regional names. We’re constantly adding new drinks and ingredients from all over the world.

What you won’t find in Cocktail Party:
* No sour mix!
* No obnoxiously specific B®and-name™ re©ipes
* Did we mention no ads? No pushy popups, either.
* No in-app purchases - you buy it once, you get updates and new drinks forever.

bluejetty:00187407:ios.description:
Plain Note is a simple, text-only notes app that makes it easy to capture ideas, jot down everyday notes, and draft social media posts and emails.
No ads. No sign-up required. Notes are stored on your device and, if you use iCloud sync, in your own iCloud account as well. The developer does not collect the contents of your notes.
It's a good fit for people who want to jot things down and quickly refer back to them, rather than use a notes app with lots of features. You can organize your notes by adding tags, and it supports lock screen and home screen widgets. It can be used on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Features
• You can categorize your notes with tags.
• Customize tag icons and colors.
• You can count the number of characters and lines.
• Archive and organize your notes.
• Widgets can be added to the lock screen and home screen.
• Customize themes, app icons, and fonts. (Some features are available for a fee.)
Premium (in-app purchase)
• Sync data across iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud.
• All themes and app icons are available.
• All tag icons are available.
• All font customizations are available.
*Prices may vary by country or region. Please check in the app.
*Some features may not be available in all languages or regions.
Terms of Use: https://monelyze.app/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://monelyze.app/en/privacy

bluejetty:00182555:ios.description:
Super Pads is a free easy-to-use DJ app. You can play famous songs, create your own music and feel like a real beat maker. 
It's super SIMPLE AND FUN!
The app has more than 1000 DJ kits available, each one inspired by a famous song. Every week you can get new tracks, beats and loops in many music styles:
- EDM
- Trap
- Dubstep
- Rap
- Hip Hop
- Pop
- K-pop
- Reggaeton 
- Remixes of games themes, memes and much more, to please any beat maker!
FEATURES:
- Hundreds of drum pad kits inspired by known music
- Always a new song for you
- In-app tutorial and YouTube videos
- Create music tool (you can create and share sounds with others)
- Audio recorder
- High quality sounds
- Beat maker kits with 12 or 24 pads
- Predefined beats and loops 
- Edit kit tool
- Multitouch
- No need to update to get new tracks 
Super Pads Pro
The app contains the following subscription option to remove ads and unlock all skins:
- Monthly ($17.49) with a 3-day free trial period (only at the first month)
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal
- The effective monthly subscription will start right after the 3-day free trial period
- The first monthly subscription can be cancelled 24 hours before the end of the 3-day free trial period
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription)
- Unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when a user decides to subscribe
Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to iTunes Account Settings. For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy : http://www.superstar-labs.com/PrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of use : http://www.superstar-labs.com/TermsOfUse.html

bluejetty:00022369:ios.summary:
AirDisk Pro: The Easiest Way to Transfer & Manage Files Wirelessly
AirDisk Pro transforms your iPhone or iPad into a powerful wireless flash drive. Seamlessly transfer files between your computer and iOS device using just a web browser—no
bluejetty:00022369:ios.description:
AirDisk Pro: The Easiest Way to Transfer & Manage Files Wirelessly
AirDisk Pro transforms your iPhone or iPad into a powerful wireless flash drive. Seamlessly transfer files between your computer and iOS device using just a web browser—no cables and no complex setup required. Simply connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network and start transferring.
NEW FEATURE: WIRELESS PHOTO TRANSFER Now you can directly transfer photos from your iOS Photos app to your computer via the web interface, making it easier than ever to back up and organize your library.
WHY CHOOSE AIRDISK PRO?
• FAST WIRELESS TRANSFERS: Drag and drop files from Mac Finder or Windows Explorer into your web browser for instant results.
• NO CABLES REQUIRED: Works over your local Wi-Fi network for hassle-free file sharing.
• ALL-IN-ONE FILE MANAGER: Store, organize, and access documents, music, photos, and videos in one place.
• BUILT-IN MEDIA SUPPORT: View PDFs, play music, browse images, and open Office/iWork files directly within the app.
KEY FEATURES:
• Transfer photos directly from your iOS library to your computer.
• Download files from the Files app to your computer via the web interface.
• Manage files through your web browser—no additional desktop software required.
• Supports Mac and PC with intuitive drag-and-drop functionality.
• Password protection for Wi-Fi and HTTP/FTP transfers.
• Touch ID and Face ID support for enhanced security.
• Create and play custom music playlists with background audio support.
• Move, copy, rename, delete, zip/unzip, and organize files into folders.
• Seamlessly access iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive.
SUPPORTED FORMATS:
• Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote.
• Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, AIF, CAF.
• Images: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO.
• Videos: MP4, MOV, MPV, M4V.
Discover how AirDisk Pro simplifies file management and boosts productivity.
• For details, visit: https://airdisk.app
• Terms of Service: https://airdisk.app/terms-of-service
• Privacy Policy: https://airdisk.app/privacy-policy

 · 日记本：用精美的图文记录生活，丰盈自我。你的图文永不丢失。
 · 闲时读物：或许你更喜欢作为读者，邂逅「一言」首页每日推荐的内容。

bluejetty:00044341:ios.name: Army Leader's Book
bluejetty:00044341:ios.summary: Army Leader's Book (LB) is designed to keep track of your Soldiers' important, but non-sensitive, information in order to better lead them and maintain their readiness. LB can track your Soldiers' APFT/ACFT, Weapons, Body Composition, Trai
bluejetty:00044341:ios.description:
Army Leader's Book (LB) is designed to keep track of your Soldiers' important, but non-sensitive, information in order to better lead them and maintain their readiness. LB can track your Soldiers' APFT/ACFT, Weapons, Body Composition, Training and MedPros dates and data. You can track absences and LB automatically calculates your daily PERSTAT. 
Other sections include:
 - PERSTAT to track leave, TDY, and other absences
 - Appointments
 - APFT Stats
 - ACFT Stats
 - Profiles
 - Body Composition
 - Weapon Stats
 - Flags
 - Rating Scheme
 - MedPros
 - Training (AR 350-1 and more)
 - Equipment (weapons, optics, masks, assigned vehicles)
 - Military License info and qualifications
 - Duty Roster
 - Taskings
 - HR Actions
 - Counselings
 - Working Awards
 - Working Evaluations
 - An Alert Roster
 - Post Directory and other important phone numbers
 - Notes
 - Creeds, NCO Charge, NCO Vision, Army Song, Army Values, Code of Conduct, Oath of Enlistment, and Promotion Verbiage
With all this information, security is certainly a concern. LB uses a Google cloud database service called Firestore to store the data. Firestore has an impeccable record for data security and encrypts data en route to the server and on the server as well. LB also has additional security rules so only you can see your data. That being said, it is important that you get permission from your Soldiers (and have them sign a Privacy Act Statement) to input their information in LB and don't put any more information than they are comfortable with. The only required fields in all of LB are Rank and Last Name.
A premium subscription is available for $1.99 per year that allows you to upload information via Excel files, download data to PDF to help build a hard-copy leader's book, and removes ads.

bluejetty:00038900:ios.description:
"Get More Out of Less Sleep"
Feeling sleep-deprived? Tune into our Monaural Beats, tailored to your unique sleep needs. Experience deep, rejuvenating rest and unlock your full potential for improved sleep and overall well-being.
Renight(formerly Nightly) is a powerful sleep app backed by neuroscience. Optimize your limited sleep with personalized, AI-generated sleep sounds, catered to your unique sleep environment. Wake up to brain activating sounds that leave you feeling refreshed and ready to tackle your day.
Our app offers more than just sleep-inducing sounds; it provides a personalized approach to achieving restful sleep. With Monaural Beats, Renight makes it easier to fall asleep and enjoy high-quality sleep, ensuring you wake up refreshed and energized. Through personalized monaural beats tailored to your pre-sleep state and mood, you can fall asleep 16% faster and stay in deep sleep 51% longer.
Seeking quality sleep? Nightly utilizes neuroscience-based, AI-assisted frequencies to align your brainwaves with optimal patterns for deep rest. Simply listen to the Monaural Beats to enhance your sleep experience.Renight is perfect for those with limited sleep. Settle into bed with Renight and elevate your sleep quality today.
RENIGHT FEATURES
• Personalized Monaural Beats to enhanced sleep
• Various white noise choices
• Track your sleep on a sleep calendar
• Choose from a variety of sleep mediation guides
• Wake up to brain-activating sounds that refresh your morning
• Enhances your sleep routine with unique, energizing sounds
HOW IT WORKS
• Monaural Beats for Enhanced Sleep - Experience the power of Monaural Beats, scientifically supported technique that uses brainwave entrainment to align your brainwaves with frequencies that enhance sleep quality. Highlighted in Scientific American and endorsed by the National Institutes of Health, this method can boost your rest.
• Personalized Sleep Solutions - Our AI algorithm to find the perfect combination of Monaural Beats tailored to your current condition, ensuring optimal effectiveness for promoting restful sleep.
• Customizable Environment Settings - Tailor the volume of Monaural Beats to match your surrounding noise levels for an optimal sleep experience.
• Patented Layered Monaural Beats – Our technology goes beyond traditional Monaural Beats, helping users to fall asleep 16% faster and stay in deep sleep 51% longer. In fact, 81.5% of users report feeling more refreshed after using Nightly.
Backed by Trusted Institutions:
Renight is endorsed by prestigious institutions such as Stanford Medicine, Google for Startups, and Samsung C-Lab, ensuring reliability and efficacy in enhancing sleep quality.
Additionally, it is supported by studies from Yonsei University, and the Korea Research Institute of Standards and Science.
Contact Us:
Have questions or need assistance? Contact our dedicated support team at support@renight.com.
We're here to help you achieve better sleep and unlock your full potential.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of Service: https://munice.notion.site/terms-en
Privacy Policy: https://munice.notion.site/privacy-en

bluejetty:00173672:android.description:
Escape Parents House: Runaway is a thrilling first-person escape adventure where you play as a rebellious teenager trying to break free from your overprotective parents. Stuck in a house where every door is locked, you must sneak, hide, and solve puzzles to escape without getting caught. Will you outsmart your strict parents and make it to freedom?
Navigate through a dark, eerie house filled with obstacles, locked doors, and hidden clues. You’ll need to find keys, distract your parents, and avoid traps set to keep you inside. Hide under beds, inside closets, or behind furniture as you make your way toward the exit. But be careful—one wrong move, and they’ll catch you!
With realistic graphics and suspenseful sound effects, every creaking floor and distant footstep will keep you on edge. As you explore, you’ll uncover mysteries about your family—what are they hiding, and why won’t they let you leave?
Can you outsmart your parents, unlock the doors, and escape the house without getting caught? Test your stealth, strategy, and problem-solving skills in this intense survival escape game

bluejetty:00085937:ios.description:
원하는 티타임이 무엇이든,
카카오골프예약 한 곳에서 만나보세요!
1. 더욱 간편해진 ‘홈’
- 원하는 티타임을 빠르게 검색할 수 있도록, ‘검색바’를 홈 상단으로 이사했어요.
- 티타임 탐색에 방해되지 않도록 가독성을 높였어요.
2. [예약+] 갑자기 라운드 약속이 잡혀도 걱정 없도록, ‘예약매니저’
- 임박 티타임부터 조인 신청까지! 예약매니저를 통해 예약할 수 있어요.
- 직접 찾을 필요 없이 원하는 라운드 조건을 계획으로 등록해두면, 예약매니저가 제안한 티타임을 자동으로 매칭해드려요. 그 중 마음에 드는 티타임을 발견했다면 예약매니저에게 예약을 요청할 수 있어요.
- 당장 원하는 티타임이 없더라도 새로운 예약매니저 티타임이 올라오면 자동으로 매칭되고, 푸시 알림으로 알려드려요.
3. [예약+] 다른 곳에선 볼 수 없는 최저가 티타임부터 특급 혜택을 모은, ‘단독혜택’
- 최저가 티타임을 찾아 헤매던 유목민은 그만! 카카오골프예약만의 ‘단독혜택’ 상품을 만나보세요.
- 일자를 하나씩 선택해보면서 더 좋은 혜택을 일일이 찾을 필요 없이, 모든 혜택 상품을 한 눈에 탐색할 수 있어서 편리해졌어요.
- 그린피 할인 혜택뿐만 아니라 카트비 지원, 식음료 제공, 선물 지급까지 더욱 풍성해진 혜택을 누릴 수 있어요.
- 새로운 단독혜택 상품이 나오면 알림을 보내 드려요. 누구보다 빠르게 단독혜택 상품 소식을 받아보세요.
4. 새로워진 ‘나의 예약’
- 언제든지 예약 내역을 편리하게 확인할 수 있도록, 하단 네비게이션바의 두번째 공간으로 이사했어요.
- 기존 예약 내역들은 ‘나의 예약’에서 그대로 확인할 수 있어요. 라운드 일정을 확인하고 동반자를 초대해보세요.
- 예약매니저를 통해 예약을 요청한 내역도 여기서 한 번에 관리할 수 있어요.
5. 알림 리스트로 한 눈에 확인하는, 새로워진 ‘알림 화면’
- 라운드 계획에 딱 맞는 티타임이 매칭되면 알림을 받을 수 있어요.
- 새로운 단독혜택 상품이 나오면 알림을 보내드려요.
6. 티타임 청약/오픈 알림
- 찾던 티타임이 오픈하면 자동으로 예약할 수 있어요.
- 원하는 티타임이 오픈할 때 바로 알림을 받을 수 있어요.
7. 라운드 당일도, ‘카카오골프예약’ 한 곳에서
- 프론트 방문 없이도 ‘셀프체크인’으로 편하게 락카키를 발급 받을 수 있어요.
- 코스 공략을 할 수 있는 ‘모바일 야디지’와 함께 라운드를 즐겨 보세요.
- 라운드가 끝난 아쉬움을 ‘스코어카드’로 달래 보세요. 내 스코어를 기록하는 건 물론, 직접 스티커로 개성있게 꾸민 나만의 스코어카드를 친구에게 공유할 수도 있어요.
* 제휴된 스마트골프장에서 이용할 수 있는 서비스에요. 다른 골프장에서도 이용할 수 있도록 열심히 제휴를 늘려가고 있어요.

- 저장 공간 : 고객센터에 문의 시 관련 파일 등록
- 카메라 : 고객센터에 문의 시 관련 화면 촬영
- 위치 : 내 주변 골프장 검색 등 위치 기반 서비스에서 사용

- 캘린더 : 예약내역(라운드 일정) 저장을 위해 사용

bluejetty:00132357:ios.description:
FamilyAlbum: Share all your baby photos in one private family album.
From everyday smiles to unforgettable milestones, FamilyAlbum makes it easy to save and share your baby’s precious moments with the whole family. Create a secure album where parents, grandparents, and loved ones can stay connected and watch your baby grow.
Every baby moment becomes a treasured family memory. First smiles, first steps, birthdays, and quiet moments at home—all beautifully organized with FamilyAlbum.
Babies grow up quickly. One day, you are holding a newborn; before you know it, they are an active toddler exploring the world. FamilyAlbum gives your family a private place to share, relive, and preserve every stage of your child’s journey.
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE FAMILYALBUM
A Private Album for Your Family
• Create a secure family album for parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles, and other loved ones.
• Share baby photos and videos privately, without the distractions of social media.
• Keep every special family memory together in one dedicated album.
Share Baby Moments with Family Wherever They Are
• Share a new baby photo or video with your family in seconds.
• Help grandparents and relatives feel close, even when they live far away.
• Share daily updates, family celebrations, and important milestones through your album so no one misses a moment.
Celebrate Every Baby Milestone
• Save and share first smiles, tiny toes, and sweet baby giggles.
• Capture first steps, first words, birthdays, and school memories, and keep them together in your album.
• Preserve the everyday family moments that make growing up so special.
Effortless Photo Organization
• Photos and videos are automatically organized by date in FamilyAlbum.
• Watch your album turn into a beautiful timeline of your baby’s life.
• Look back anytime and relive your child’s journey from the newborn stage through the toddler years and beyond.
Bring the Whole Family Closer
• Leave loving comments and reactions on every photo and video you share.
• Celebrate new memories with family members near and far.
• Bring loved ones closer through a shared album.
Designed for Everyday Sharing
• Upload photos and videos quickly, so sharing always feels simple.
• Invite the people you choose to enjoy updates in your album.
• Keep the focus on your child, with no public feed or pressure to post.
Made for Every Generation
FamilyAlbum is easy for every generation to use. Grandparents can open the album, see the latest photos, and leave a comment whenever it suits them. Instead of sending the same pictures through multiple chats, parents can share each update once and let the entire family enjoy it together. It's an easy way to stay present in your baby’s life across cities, schedules, and time zones.
From ordinary afternoons to special celebrations, your family can return to the moments that tell your child’s story.
FAMILY MEMORIES MADE TO LAST
Unlimited Photo and Video Storage
• Save and share every baby photo and family video without worrying about storage limits.
Free Monthly Photo Prints
• Turn your favorite photos in FamilyAlbum into physical keepsakes to enjoy and share with family.
Automatically Created Photobooks
• Transform your photos in FamilyAlbum into beautifully designed photobooks for your home or meaningful gifts for grandparents and loved ones.
Start sharing your family’s story with FamilyAlbum today.
Save every baby moment, preserve every milestone, and bring the people you love closer—one photo at a time.

Privacy Policy - https://family-album.com/privacy

bluejetty:00178105:ios.description:
FREE Try Before You Buy trial, your App Store account is not charged by Apple during the free trial.
Welcome to Pipe Trades Pro for iPhone, a game-changing tool for professionals in the pipe trades industry. This application is expertly designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of pipefitters, steamfitters, sprinklerfitters, and welders. From complex calculations to extensive pipe data, Pipe Trades Pro is your go-to solution for a streamlined work process.
-----
ADVANCED CALCULATION CAPABILITIES
-----
• Tackle complex measurements like cut lengths, take-outs, and odd-degree fittings easily
• Navigate through right angles, offsets, and intricate rolling offsets confidently
• Utilize tools for determining pipe areas, fill weights, and unit conversions
• Efficiently manage parallel pipe cutbacks with accurate alignment and spacing
• Incorporate feet-inch-fractions and trigonometry for precise measurement adjustments
-----
FLUID DYNAMICS AND PRESSURE ANALYSIS
-----
• Accurately compute flow rates, velocity, force, and volumes for diverse fluid types
• Assess pressure loss effectively across any pipe size, type, or distance
• Make informed decisions based on dynamic fluid properties and behaviors
• Optimize piping systems for maximum flow efficiency and safety
-----
COMPREHENSIVE PIPE DATA ACCESS
-----
• Access vital information for pipes up to 42 inches, including diameters and wall thickness
• Select from materials like steel, stainless steel, brass, aluminum, etc.
• Quickly reference internal area and filled weight per foot for different pipe types
• Make informed choices with extensive material and dimension options
-----
USER-CENTRIC INTERFACE DESIGN
-----
• Experience a streamlined, intuitive interface designed for quick and easy navigation
• Access key features with minimal taps, saving time and enhancing user experience
• Benefit from an interface that optimizes the iPhone’s screen space and usability
• Enjoy a clutter-free, visually appealing layout for stress-free operation
• Adapt quickly with an interface designed for both new and experienced users
-----
OFFLINE FUNCTIONALITY AND SUPPORT
-----
• Utilize full app capabilities without an internet connection, perfect for on-site tasks
• Access all data and features offline, ensuring uninterrupted productivity
• Rely on consistent app performance in remote or internet-challenged locations
• Receive dedicated customer support for any queries or technical issues
Pipe Trades Pro for iPhone is not just an application; it's a comprehensive tool transforming how pipe trade professionals work. It combines advanced technology, user-friendly design, and practical features to create a smoother, more efficient workflow. Embrace the future of pipe layout and design with Pipe Trades Pro, where accuracy meets efficiency.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Your Free Trial period is free of charge. Subscriptions offered will automatically renew at the end of the chosen period. Payment will be charged to your Apple account upon purchase confirmation. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off or the subscription is canceled in settings at least one day (24 hours) before the subscription period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple account Settings > Subscriptions.
LEGAL
Pipe Trades Pro is a trademark of Calculated Industries, Inc.
Copyright 2025

bluejetty:00030643:ios.summary:
X Survive is an open world survival sandbox where you can explore, build, craft, drive, farm, and shape the world your way — now alone or together with friends.
PLAY TOGETHER WITH LAN MULTIPLAYER
Team up with up to 4 players on the same l
bluejetty:00030643:ios.description:
X Survive is an open world survival sandbox where you can explore, build, craft, drive, farm, and shape the world your way — now alone or together with friends.
PLAY TOGETHER WITH LAN MULTIPLAYER
Team up with up to 4 players on the same local network. Explore the island, gather resources, build a home, drive vehicles, farm, survive, and create together with the same freedom you have in single-player. X Survive supports local LAN multiplayer and co-op play without requiring an internet connection.
BUILD YOUR OWN WORLD
Unleash your creativity with simple but powerful building and crafting mechanics. Build a small shelter, a futuristic home, a garage, a rooftop garden, or an entire city. With 500+ building blocks and large-scale construction, you decide what your world becomes.
EXPLORE A MASSIVE OPEN WORLD
Travel across a mysterious island, discover new places, scavenge scrap, mine minerals, and search underground for valuable resources. Drive vehicles across the landscape or dig directly into the terrain and create your own paths, caves, and structures.
SURVIVE AND THRIVE
Take care of your survivor by sleeping, farming, cooking, eating, drinking, and resting. Craft useful equipment, gather materials, defend yourself from danger, and turn a simple shelter into a high-tech base.
A WORLD YOU CAN INTERACT WITH
Your creations are more than decoration. Use furniture and objects inside the homes you build, interact with the environment, play mini-games on your in-game computer, and experiment with the systems around you.
SHAPE THE TERRAIN
Terraform the land with powerful tools. Dig caves, flatten areas for construction, uncover hidden resources, and transform the landscape to fit your ideas.
PLAY SOLO OFFLINE OR TOGETHER ON LAN
Prefer to play alone? Single-player remains fully playable offline. Want company? Connect with friends on the same local Wi-Fi or LAN network and play together. LAN multiplayer does not require an internet connection.
KEY FEATURES
• 4-player LAN multiplayer and local co-op
• Open world survival sandbox gameplay
• Powerful building and crafting systems
• 500+ building blocks
• Large-scale base and city construction
• Terrain digging, mining, and terraforming
• Vehicles with physics-based driving
• Farming, cooking, survival, and exploration
• Interactive furniture and world objects
• Dynamic weather and time systems
• Solo offline play
• Ultra graphics mode for high-performance devices
Build from scrap, craft from carbon, survive the unknown, or simply create the place you want to live. Play alone or invite friends into your world — in X Survive, the world is yours to shape.

This feature is similar to a masquerade ball in the real life. When you start using this feature, you are in a masquerade ball. All users wear a mask and you can take off a mask to see the face of the user behind the mask. 
3, Magic encounter
Magic encounter is a feature that you can use to find other users randomly. This feature recommends users to you in 4 different rules. You can select a rule, choose two cards randomly and open those two cards to see the profile photos hidden in those two cards.

bluejetty:00015377:ios.name: Learn English Listening Master
bluejetty:00015377:ios.summary:
English Listening Master will help you understand English better, improve your English language skills and help you learn real English spoken in everyday situations. 
English Listening Master is the first application of its kind to make a
bluejetty:00015377:ios.description:
English Listening Master will help you understand English better, improve your English language skills and help you learn real English spoken in everyday situations. 
English Listening Master is the first application of its kind to make a game out of improving your English listening skills through dictation using real English conversations in a fun, enjoyable and educational way.
Learn real English and practice your English listening skills by typing the letters of the words you hear or tapping the words of the audio to form the sentences. 
English Listening Master is a fun and educational game for kids, seniors and English language students of all ages who want to learn English and improve their listening skills in a more entertaining way.
Perfect classroom audio listening recordings don't prepare you for listening in the real world. English Listening Master uses audio from thousands of different native speakers in real settings complete with background noise to make the task more realistic, more practical, and more effective.
How do you play?
It’s easy. Listen to the audio, and tap or type the words you hear to form the correct sentence.
With this entertaining dictation game, you will learn English and practice listening in a fun way. 
With three modes of difficulty to write the sentences and four levels of sentence difficulty, Listening Master is great for everyone from the elementary level right up to the most seasoned and skilled English ears.
What options are there to write what you hear?
Don’t worry, you can choose between three options depending on how much help you need. In Easy mode, you have the words written for you on the screen and you just have to tap the words you hear in the correct order.
In Competent mode, you will only have the letters of the words, and you have to spell out each word you hear by typing the letters in the correct order.
In Expert mode, you won’t have any help, and you will have to put your listening skills to the maximum test.
Which one will you choose?
The Levels:
English Listening Master has four levels: Beginner, Competent, Professional, and Expert
Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest words to tap or spell.
Competent: This is where things start to get harder. This level is great for students who are beginning their English language learning adventure.
Professional: Great for students with a solid base in English who want to keep their skills up to date.
Expert: Only for those with the most proficient English skills. Are you one of them?
Do you have what it takes to become the next Listening Master?
With Listening Master you'll improve your real English listening and conversation skills while you play and have fun testing your English. 
With single player and multiplayer mode, you can practice alone, challenge your friends or classmates as well as challenge other players from around the globe.
Who's got the best ear for English in the class, family or among your friends? Learn English with a smile on your face with English Listening Master

bluejetty:00076098:ios.name: DTBA
bluejetty:00076098:ios.summary: Dare To Be Active is the #1 fitness + rehab app founded by physical therapist Dr. LA Thoma Gustin designed to build (and rehab) strong and resilient bodies through intentional movement. The DTBA method fosters consistency and independence,
bluejetty:00076098:ios.description:
Dare To Be Active is the #1 fitness + rehab app founded by physical therapist Dr. LA Thoma Gustin designed to build (and rehab) strong and resilient bodies through intentional movement. The DTBA method fosters consistency and independence, with guidance from highly trained physical therapists to help you reach your fitness goals for a healthy & strong body and mind. 
Customizable Fitness + Programs in 1 App: 
Over 180 on-demand videos ranging from resistance training and high-intensity cardio to beginner strength training and beyond, DTBA now includes yoga and pilates classes to suit your daily fitness needs. With the guidance of physical therapists during each class, our approach combines a deep understanding of the body with injury prevention and rehabilitation at the forefront of our practice.
All DTBA coaches are trained to help you reach your fitness goals—safely. With unique guidance, insights & cues, our team is trained to educate and support you in your fitness journey and address any pain (or limitations) you may have with rehab-focused classes like “Yoga for Back Pain” or “Minimal Equipment Exercises for Knee Pain.” 
Designed With You in Mind:
DTBA is created for all—regardless of fitness level, we have everything from beginner form videos to advanced strength training circuits. Our growing library of highly accessible workout videos teaches the foundations of exercise & injury prevention from trusted physical therapists, empowering you to grow in strength and knowledge to create strong, confident bodies. 
Our goal is to combine fitness rehab and rehab fitness into your daily life through guided movement to help you create a healthy lifestyle, prevent injury and maintain longevity. We understand the importance of increasing daily activity and preventing current (and future) pain caused by immobility with a range of videos on posture, desk stretches and workouts you can do at home or while traveling. 
APP FEATURES + MEMBERSHIP BENEFITS
- Free 14-day trial for new members.
- Over 180 on-demand videos ranging from mobility to strength training, stability, injury prevention, pre and post-natal, Pilates and yoga.
- Challenges, daily workouts, and two custom weekly beginner and advanced schedules.
- New weekly little-to-no equipment workouts you can do anytime, anywhere.
- Full access to Live workouts and classes taught by DTBA coaches.
- Customizable search functionality based on coach, duration, equipment or workout focus.
- Save favorite workouts to your profile, add them to your calendar or create your own playlists.
- Access to 15-minute or less Express Workouts to fit your busy schedule and keep you consistent.
- Access to all videos from 5–45 minutes to fit into your schedule, regardless of time.
- Pre + postnatal workouts filmed in real-time by Dr. LA Thoma Gustin + Dr. Joyce Shaw.
- A community forum to ask questions, post updates & get recommendations.
--

Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings.

【卡通特效】可以把您的照片变成专属您个人的漫画形象，也可以为您打造专属您个人的迪士尼卡通人物形象；

bluejetty:00178289:ios.description:
The complete Holy Bible in Afaan Oromoo (Macaafa Qulqulluu), Old and New Testament. 
Fully offline, no internet needed, so you can read anywhere
READING THE BIBLE
• Every book of the Bible, with Oromo and English book names side by side
• Sort books between the Old and New Testaments for an organised selection
• Search books for the fastest selection
• Select a chapter with an easy button interface
• Move between chapters with a swipe or the page buttons
• Picks up where you left off
• Highlight verses in several colours and find them all again in Highlighted
• Copy and share verses with family and friends
READING PLANS
Build a daily habit with a plan that fits your season:
• Bible in a Year
• New Testament in 90 Days
• The Gospels in 30 Days
• Psalms in 30 Days
• Proverbs in 31 Days
A calendar shows the days you've read and today's reading. 
Tap a day to read it, and continue from where you stopped.
WORSHIP: FIND THE KIÑIT AND KEY OF ANY SONG
Made for worship teams, choirs and musicians. Play or sing a song and Worship listens, then shows:
• Which Kiñit it uses: Tizita, Baatii, Ambaasal or Ancihooyee
• The key the song is in
• Which shape to play and how far to transpose, so you can play it in the key you know
Includes Learn Kiñit, a short guide to the five-note scales and the four Kiñit for worship teams.
Audio is analysed live on your device. Nothing is recorded or saved.
SYSTEM FEATURES
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a wide reading page on iPad in portrait and landscape
• Supports Dynamic Type for those who prefer larger text, plus an in-app text size control
• Supports Dark Mode, easy on the eyes for reading at night
ADVANCED FEATURES
Reading and Reading Plans are free. 
A one-time in-app purchase unlocks Advanced Features: highlighting, book search and unlimited use of Worship. 
Worship includes 30 free tries so you can try it first. Purchases can be restored on all your devices from Settings.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your highlights and reading progress stay on your device (Worship NEVER records).

bluejetty:00073716:ios.description:
CorrLinks is a way for family and friends to electronically communicate with their loved ones incarcerated in institutions. Established through a relationship between a corrections agency and ATG, this system allows family and friends to subscribe to CorrLinks services. Currently all Federal Bureau of Prisons, US Navy Brig (Charleston and Miramar), and Department of Corrections (DOC) for the States of Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, Nevada, and Wisconsin institutions allow such communication.
Note: To use this app, you must have a paid Premier Account subscription.
The app has the following features:
Stay in contact with your loved ones with real time alerts. Receive immediate push notifications to your device every time you receive a new message!
Eliminates login on a mobile device!
Messages downloaded significantly faster!
Messages previously read are in your inbox and don’t need to be downloaded again!
Retain messages on your device for 60 days – server still only keep 30 day.
Attach up to 3 mobile devices to your account!
Eliminates Captcha on the mobile app – making it much easier to interact. 
If you have issues with the app, please contact CorrLinks support at: https://www.corrlinks.com/en-US/help

bluejetty:00178212:ios.name: Kauldron Synthesizer
bluejetty:00178212:ios.summary: Kauldron is where classic warmth meets Artificial Intelligence. One of our toniest and punchiest synths, Kauldron features a completely new analog modeling technology. The full spectrum of rich synth textures is bolstered by the groundbreak
bluejetty:00178212:ios.description:
Kauldron is where classic warmth meets Artificial Intelligence. One of our toniest and punchiest synths, Kauldron features a completely new analog modeling technology. The full spectrum of rich synth textures is bolstered by the groundbreaking SPAWN intelligent preset generation system that allows new patches to be created at the touch of a button. Abounding with pure hard-hitting tones, Kauldron requires little to no FX or production gimmicks to sound big.
Kauldron is designed with modulation and fine dynamic control in mind. The two fully-featured LFOs and the mod envelope combine with a wide variety of MIDI learnable controls to manipulate multiple parameters. Everything is easily set up in a clearly laid out ‘mod matrix.’ The dual XY-pads can be used for controlling modulation or a wide range of synth parameters. MIDI aftertouch can be routed via the matrix for even greater control over expression and tonality.
Kauldron also debuts the next generation of our Artificial Intelligence preset creation system, SPAWN². Completely reimagining the groundbreaking SPAWN algorithms in our hugely popular Magellan, the new SPAWN² gives you unprecedented control over generating presets. In the expert mode, you can accomplish anything from subtle ‘variations on a theme’ to bold new sounds. In the basic mode, where Kauldron does all the thinking, you get preset after usable preset with just a touch. This is not simple randomization: it is the power of A.I. put to benevolent use!
Kauldron also includes its AUv3 plugin version so that you can seamlessly run multiple instances in your favorite DAW. Powerful arp with both live & program modes; comprehensive MIDI features with effortless MIDI learn; over 900 presets; recording, sharing, these are just some of the features brewing inside Yonac’s Kauldron.
Selected specs include,
SYNTH
• 3 analog modeling oscillators w/ multiple waveforms & true PWM
• FM via Osc 2
• Maximizer module with drift, spread & voice count for huge, stereophonic all-synth sounds
• New vAnalog filter design w/ ‘dirt’ overload for even warmer, harmonically complex tones
• Dedicated filter ADSR envelope
• Filter tracking, contour & more
• Pink/white noise generator
• Osc. phase reset & sync
• Retro & modern glide algorithms
• Virtual VCA envelope with 2 attack types
• Poly/mono operation
• Legato mode for buttery smooth passages
• Extensive modulation options via the ‘mod matrix’
• 2 LFOs w/ BPM sync, keytracking, trigger mode & more
• Assignable mod envelope
• 23 mod targets
• 11 mod controllers, including aftertouch, velocity & keytracking
• 2 XY-Pads for controlling mod targets or synth parameters
• Arpeggiator with live & program modes, 11 algorithms, gate, swing, note value, octaving & more
• Stereo mod effect with chorus & flanger modes
• BPM-syncable stereo delay
• Studio quality reverb w/ 7 room types, damping, time & mix
• 900+ presets in a wide variety of styles & sounds
SPAWN²
• Automatic preset generation via artificial intelligence
• Generate infinite new, usable presets at the touch of a button
• Expert mode lets specify Variation & Autonomy for each major synth module
• 3 unique A.I. algorithms
• Auto arp programming in any listed scale
PRO FEATURES
• AUv3 - use as Audio Unit instrument plugin on iPad & iPhone
• Fullscreen AU mode
• Extensive MIDI: MIDI learn, aftertouch, MIDI CC map save/share, KB mapping, program changes & more
APP
• iPhone & iPad Compatibility
• Powerful YPAT2 preset management system
• Classic or ribbon key controller
• Ribbon controller: Poly aftertouch into Kauldron
• Ribbon controller: Settable musical key & scale
• Classic KB: Velocity w/ sensitivity setting
• Tapedeck: Record, loop & share
• Metronome
• Tap BPM

bluejetty:00141230:ios.name: Password Safe Manager & Vault
bluejetty:00141230:ios.summary:
Password Safe is an offline-first password manager that keeps every password, passkey, and secret on your device. No account. No tracking. Just AES-256 encryption and one master password.
WHY PASSWORD SAFE
• Offline-first — your vault live
bluejetty:00141230:ios.description:
Password Safe is an offline-first password manager that keeps every password, passkey, and secret on your device. No account. No tracking. Just AES-256 encryption and one master password.
WHY PASSWORD SAFE
• Offline-first — your vault lives on your device, not on a server
• AES-256 encryption, the same standard used by banks and governments
• Optional end-to-end encrypted iCloud sync across your devices (Pro)
• Face ID / Touch ID vault unlock (Pro)
• Passkeys, passwords, credentials, notes — one secure vault
• Built-in 2FA authenticator with QR code scanning
• Autofill passwords and passkeys system-wide
• Built-in password generator for strong, unique passwords
• Password strength indicator and vault statistics
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac
• Apple Watch app for selected entries and 2FA codes
FREE FEATURES
• Secure password storage for logins, passkeys, and access data
• Categorize and favorite your entries
• One master password, AES-256 encrypted
• Autofill support
• Password generator
• Backup, restore, and CSV password import/export
• Automatic clipboard clearing and auto-logout
• Password strength indicator
• Vault statistics
• AutoFill suggestions in the QuickType bar for all logins and passkeys
• Grid or list view, category filter, sorting and quick actions
• Pure black dark mode
• Keyboard shortcuts on iPad
• Up to 50 entries
PRO FEATURES
• Unlimited entries
• Optional end-to-end encrypted cloud sync via iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or pCloud
• Face ID / Touch ID unlock
• Image and file attachments per entry
• Custom, reorderable entry fields
• Reusable fields (multiple URLs, emails, etc.)
• Multiple categories per entry
• Archive entries and full password history
• PDF export and printing
• Automatic sync that merges changes from all your devices entry by entry
• Excel (.xlsx) import and export
• 8 additional color schemes
OFFLINE-FIRST, NEVER REQUIRED ONLINE
Password Safe has no account, no analytics, and no tracking service. Your encrypted vault stays on your device — only you hold the master password. Want it on more than one device? Enable optional cloud sync: your vault is encrypted on-device before it ever leaves, so no one can read it. Prefer pure offline? Skip sync entirely and back up manually to any file provider you trust.
PASSKEY SUPPORT
Save and use passkeys alongside your passwords in the same secure vault. Password Safe is a private password and passkey manager — no cloud account required to get started. With sync, your passkeys are available on all your devices.
SECURITY YOU CONTROL
• AES-256 encryption on the entire vault
• Optional end-to-end encrypted sync — off by default, you choose
• Master password never leaves your device
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID unlock (Pro)
• Auto-logout and clipboard clearing by default
VAULT INSIGHTS
Statistics show which passwords are reused, weak, or too short — so you know exactly what to rotate next.
EASE OF USE
Remember one master password, access everything. An intuitive, categorized vault makes organizing hundreds of logins effortless.
Whole vault encrypted with SQLCipher 4: AES-256 + HMAC-SHA512, key derived with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (256,000 iterations, random salt).
Questions, bug reports, feature requests, or want to help translate? I'd love to hear from you.
Privacy Policy: https://passwordsafe.app/policies/priv_policy.html
Terms of Service: https://passwordsafe.app/policies/terms.html

Whether your goal is to read more books, improve your fitness routine, or simply drink more water, Get Habit is the powerful habit tracker that's with you every step of the way.

Discover the profound impact of regular, positive habits on your mental and physical health. With Get Habit, you're not just checking off tasks - you're building the foundation for lasting change and a better you.

Upgrade to Get Habit today and embrace the journey to better living. Because a better me is not a destination - it's a journey, one habit at a time.

bluejetty:00167948:ios.name: GPS - Phone Location Tracker
bluejetty:00167948:ios.summary: GeoTrack360 is a reliable way to track your loved ones' location in real-time. Using our app, you can ensure the safety of your family and friends by knowing their exact whereabouts. Our app ensures you stay connected with those who matter
bluejetty:00167948:ios.description:
GeoTrack360 is a reliable way to track your loved ones' location in real-time. Using our app, you can ensure the safety of your family and friends by knowing their exact whereabouts. Our app ensures you stay connected with those who matter most, providing real-time location updates and a comprehensive location history.
Key Features:- Real-Time Location Tracking: Know the current location of your loved ones on a live map.- Accurate GPS Tracking: Find the exact location of your family members and friends in real-time.- Location History: Access past location data to see where they've been.- Geofence Zones: Set up geofence zones to receive notifications when someone enters or leaves a specific area.- Device Tracking: Find lost or stolen phones using another family member's registered device.- Place Alerts: Get notified when family members arrive or leave specific locations like home or school.- Privacy and Consent: Location sharing is only possible with mutual consent to ensure privacy.
How It Works:1. Add your family members' phone numbers to the app.2. They accept the invite and share their location.3. Track their location on the map in real-time.
Why GeoTrack360?- Easy Setup: Simply add your loved ones by their phone number and start tracking.- Peace of Mind: Ensure your kids, elderly parents, and loved ones are safe at all times.- Lost Phone Recovery: Track your lost or stolen phone using the app.
Please note that continuous use of location services can decrease battery life.
Subscription Information:GeoTrack360 offers a premium subscription plan with additional features, including unlimited location alerts, extended location history, and an ad-free experience. Subscription plans are available on a weekly, monthly, and yearly basis. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in your account settings.
By using GeoTrack360, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:Privacy Policy: https://geotrack360.pages.dev/privacy-policyTerms of Use: https://geotrack360.pages.dev/terms

bluejetty:00099982:ios.summary: Stay protected without compromise. Atomic Mail is a secure email app that puts your privacy first with advanced encryption, zero-access architecture, and strong spam protection. Easily manage your inbox in a fast, modern email client built
bluejetty:00099982:ios.description:
Stay protected without compromise. Atomic Mail is a secure email app that puts your privacy first with advanced encryption, zero-access architecture, and strong spam protection. Easily manage your inbox in a fast, modern email client built both for personal and business communication.
No trackers. No profiling. No data selling. Just secure, fast, and private email.
Why Choose Atomic Mail?
• Free to use – Sign up for free in seconds and access all core features of a private email.
• Encrypted email – Messages and attachments are protected with end-to-end encryption.
• Zero-access protection: Even we can’t access your messages.
• Private and anonymous – No phone number required. We don’t collect or sell your data.
• Spam free – Built-in AI spam & phishing protection for a cleaner, quieter inbox.
• Easy setup – No technical knowledge required.
Powerful Email Features You’ll Love:
• Alias support – Create your @atomicmail.io address and up to 10 free email aliases for extra privacy.
• Password-protected messages – Send encrypted emails to anyone, even if they use another provider.
• Self-destructing messages – Set messages to auto-delete for maximum confidentiality.
• Seed phrase account recovery – Secure account recovery inspired by modern crypto apps.
• Unlimited storage – Keep everything safe without worrying about limits.
Built with Security at the Core:
Atomic Mail uses industry-leading encryption standards (AES-256, RSA-2048, ECIES) to protect every message. With zero-access architecture, only you and your recipient can read your emails. Data is hosted in ISO 27001-certified data centers in Germany and is fully GDPR-compliant, ensuring the highest level of email security and privacy.
Encryption Without Any Effort:
With Atomic Mail, sending a secure message is as easy as a regular email. You can send encrypted messages instantly with zero setup. No technical knowledge is needed for you, and no special software or preparation is required for your recipients.
Feature-Rich Free Plan:
Get more than most other email clients offer. Multiple encryption options, spam protection, aliases, generous storage, and customer support are included in your free plan. Powerful privacy-focused email without restrictions.
Who Should Use Atomic Mail?
• Anyone looking for an email app that truly respects their privacy
• Professionals in privacy-sensitive fields (e.g., journalism, legal, healthcare, finance)
• Personal users exchanging sensitive information via email
• Crypto users, Web3 builders, and privacy focused tech enthusiasts
• Anyone tired of spam, ads, and being tracked online
Trusted & Recognized by Industry Experts:
“Atomic Mail emerges as a game-changer, combining cutting-edge encryption with user-friendly design to create the most secure email platform on the market.”
- Yahoo Finance
“The design of the platform prioritizes ease of use in order to make encryption technologies accessible to a broader audience.”
- Trendhunter
Download Atomic Mail now and keep your email private, secure, and only yours.
Follow Atomic Mail for Updates & Support
Website: https://atomicmail.io/
Twitter/X: @atomic_mail
Telegram: @atomic_mail

bluejetty:00062092:ios.description:
When you look out the window, what do you see? Colors and shapes, green trees, square windows, a whole world of things to identify! Colors and Shapes is a fun and educational game for preschool children that helps teach object matching and color recognition skills. It's a beautiful world out there. Help your children learn to recognize and draw it!
Colors and Shapes focuses on basic tracing, matching, and building skills kindergarten kids need to train. It features a number of unique mini-games designed to increase a child's ability to recognize and match shapes, identify and pair up colours, and even solve puzzles through simple touch screen interactions. It's incredibly easy to use and provides a fun learning environment kids will love.
Colors and Shapes includes the following mini-games: 
1. Painting - Kids love colouring games! Fill in the blank objects with all kinds of fun paint, then identify the objects one by one. A fun way for children to recognize colours and shapes.
2. Collecting - A fun and challenging game where children tap the correct colored objects and gather them in a basket!
3. Look-alikes - Match up the different items by picking the ones with the same colour. A challenging but fun way to learn colours and drawing skills.
4. Matching - Outlines are at the top of the screen, and a handful of shapes are at the bottom. Challenge your kids to match them up!
5. Tracing - Help your kids trace shapes by following the outline on the screen. Great for teaching shape patterns and recognition.
6. Building - Drag and drop animated pieces on the screen to create a shape in the middle.
Colors & Shapes - Learn Coloring For Toddler Kids is a great learning experience for toddlers, preschoolers, kindergarteners, and children of all ages. Parents will appreciate the customizable difficulty settings. Kids will have a great time learning to recognize different colors and shapes, completing all of the mini-games, and earning sticker rewards!
Best of all, Colors and Shapes is absolutely free! No annoying third party ads, no in-app purchases, just pure educational fun for you and your family.
Note to Parents:
When creating Colors and Shapes, we wanted to create the most entertaining and educational game possible for both parents and their children. We're parents ourselves, and we know how frustrating intrusive third party ads and in-app purchases can be. That's why we decided to release this game for free. You and your child can enjoy an uninterrupted learning experience without having to worry about micro-transactions and the like. Just sit down and start learning. It's exactly the sort of educational experience we want for our children, which is why we know your family will love it, too!
Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

bluejetty:00151298:ios.name: Conecta Recife App
bluejetty:00151298:ios.summary:
Quer ter acesso aos serviços prestados pela Prefeitura do Recife sem sair de casa? Tudo em um único local? Conecta Recife App, são mais de 100 serviços ofertados já em sua primeira versão!
O Aplicativo Conecta Recife oferece um jeito total
bluejetty:00151298:ios.description:
Quer ter acesso aos serviços prestados pela Prefeitura do Recife sem sair de casa? Tudo em um único local? Conecta Recife App, são mais de 100 serviços ofertados já em sua primeira versão!
O Aplicativo Conecta Recife oferece um jeito totalmente novo de interagir com a Prefeitura do Recife. Pessoa física ou jurídica, você terá em mãos informação seus imóveis, suas empresas ou autônomos, seus processos e suas solicitações de serviço. Além de muitas informações, orientações e serviços de utilidade que são ofertados publicamente, de forma intuitiva, com agilidade e rapidez.
Você pode se identificar apenas com uma selfie! Mas existem outras formas de se identificar que pode ser através das redes sociais, ou utilizando os acessos já cadastrados na Prefeitura com no Portal da Nota Fiscal Eletrônica, através da plataforma .gov.br, do Ministério da Economia ou diretamente no aplicativo.
Você possui imóveis e/ou deseja obter serviços de um imóvel onde reside?
Então você terá acesso às informações desses imóveis, poderá obter documentos, consultar o extrato de débitos e gerar os boletos de pagamentos.
Você é um autônomo, MEI ou é sócio de uma empresa?
Então rapidamente você vai verificar seus cadastros de autônomo, empresas e MEI (Micro Empreendedor Individual) e para esses você poderá consultar o extrato de débitos e gerar boletos de pagamento e vários outros documentos.
Você deseja solicitar à Prefeitura a execução de um serviço para na cidade?
Então venha e conheça a forma mais simples, rápida e direta de fazer a sua solicitação de serviços para a Prefeitura, seja ela de reposição de lâmpadas, de tapa-buraco, de remoção de entulhos e vários outros serviços prestados. Você pode disponibilizar fotos, consultar e acompanhar todas as suas solicitações de serviços, sendo notificado a cada mudança de estágio de sua solicitação.
Como você se locomove na cidade do Recife?
Você terá acesso a todas as estações de bicicletas (Bike PE), mostrando no mapa da cidade a disponibilidade de bicicletas e vagas para depositar. Poderá também visualizar geograficamente toda a Malha Cicloviária Permanente da cidade como também a que fica disponível nos Domingos e Feriados.
Poderá saber onde ficam as Paradas de Ônibus Próximas de onde você se encontra e pesquisar as Linhas e Paradas de Ônibus do Consórcio Grande Recife e consultar as imagens das Câmeras de Trânsito.
Tudo em tempo real!
Você conhece ou utiliza os serviços de saúde prestados pela Prefeitura do Recife?
Você conhecer os critérios de utilização, visualizar no mapa e ver como chegar a toda a rede de assistência à saúde. Lá poderá também encontrar os locais preparados para atender as Vítimas de Violência. Informações sobre as Infecções Sexualmente Transmissíveis (IST), Distribuição de Camisinhas (preservativos), Dentistas, Calendário de Vacinas, Fisioterapia, Urgências e Emergências, Hospitais e Maternidades e Exames Laboratoriais.
Você conhece a rede de ensino municipal e de parceiros da Prefeitura do Recife?
Aqui você poder pesquisar, visualizar e ver como chegar até as Escolas, as Unidades de Educação Infantil, Unidades Profissionalizantes e Unidades Tecnológicas.
Você desejar conhecer um pouco mais e falar com a Prefeitura do Recife?
Então você pode consultar os locais onde está disponível o Conecta Recife Wifi, que é Internet, pública e gratuita, ofertada pela Prefeitura do Recife. Pode ter acesso às notícias mais recentes da Prefeitura do Recife e verificar como falar com Ouvidoria da Prefeitura do Recife.
E é por isso e muito mais que esse aplicativo foi criado, para dar mais transparência na relação da Prefeitura com você, deixando mais simples e intuitiva a sua relação, refletindo assim o desejo da Prefeitura do Recife de chegar junto a você.
Convide seus amigos e familiares para fazer parte desse mundo e desfrutar das facilidades que o Conecta Recife oferece.
Prometemos continuar a disponibilizar mais e mais serviços a cada nova versão lançada. 
Confiram!

bluejetty:00063532:ios.name: Infinite Painter
bluejetty:00063532:ios.summary: Experience one of the best-designed painting, sketching, and drawing apps created for iPad and iPhone. Used by millions, this award-winning app brings a rich, powerful feature set to artists of all levels, whether art is your hobby, passion
bluejetty:00063532:ios.description:
Experience one of the best-designed painting, sketching, and drawing apps created for iPad and iPhone. Used by millions, this award-winning app brings a rich, powerful feature set to artists of all levels, whether art is your hobby, passion or career.
HIGHLIGHTS
- Best-in-class pencils
- Minimal and intuitive interface
- Easily group layers
- Share Time-lapse recordings with your social networks
- Convert any stroke into an editable shape
REIMAGINING BRUSHES
- Hundreds of built-in brushes: Airbrushes, Calligraphy, Chalk, Charcoal, Glow, Lasso Fills, Pencils, Markers, Oil Paint, Paint Splatter, Spray Paint, Screentones, and Watercolor
- Realistic brush to canvas interaction
- Over 100 customizable settings for every brush
- Organize and share your favorite brushes and brush sets
- Designed for the Apple Pencil with full pressure and tilt support
- Apply real-time color adjustments and live filters to any brush
- Sample lower layers when blending
- Import and export custom brushes and sets
GETTING THE MOST OUT OF YOUR SPACE
- More canvas, less clutter with a clean, customizable interface
- Assign finger functions separate from the Apple Pencil
- Expand and collapse layers with a flick
- Dock brushes and brush settings for quick, easy editing
- Quick access eyedropper
- Rotate and flip canvas
- Group layers with a pinch
MAKING ART LESS WORK
- Pin tools and actions to the main interface
- Pull the color wheel right on the canvas with two fingers
- Add multiple reference images
- Lighting-fast saving and loading
- Step back in time with Project History
DIVERSIFYING TOOLS
- Simple or complex symmetry with Radial or Kaleidoscope
- Draw with precision using Guides or Shapes
- Smart shape detection by pausing when drawing
- Innovative Hatching guide
NEVER LOSING PERSPECTIVE
- Design 3D cityscapes with five different perspective guides or a standard 2D grid
- Drag Rectangle and Circle shapes in perspective
PIXEL-PERFECT EDITING
- Seamless pattern projects
- Selection tools: Lasso, Rectangle, Circle, Poly, Path, Wand, Brush, and Color Range
- Industry-leading Transformations
- Transform multiple layers at once
- Gradient and Pattern Fill tools
- Target separate layers or all layers with Fill tools
- Drag with Fill tool or Magic Wand for live tolerance adjustment
- Bring your painting to life with Time-lapse
- Canvas Navigator with flip and grayscale support (for proportions and value checking)
- Clone tool with offset
- Tools for pattern creation
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO CREATE
- 64-bit color when painting
- Layer support with 30 blend modes
- Masks for layers, adjustments, and groups
- Clipping masks
- Gradient map, Color Curves, and Filter layers
- Industry-leading color correction
- Over 40 live Filters
- Focus and Tilt-shift masking
- Liquify
- Crop and Resize tool
- Pattern and Array tools
- Powerful selection workspace
- Photoshop®-like smart layers for multiple transformations without loss of quality
- Solo & Trace modes
- Print presets & CMYK color modes
ACCELERATE YOUR WORKFLOW
- Import from Photos, Camera, Clipboard, or Image Search
- Search over 1 million free for commercial-use images
- Export images as JPG, PNG, ZIP, layered PSD files, or Painter projects
- Share artwork to Infinite Painter's ever-growing community and see what others are creating, #InfinitePainter
WHAT’S FREE?
- 7 days to try out everything
- 5 layers at the device resolution
- Solid Fill, Lasso selection, Basic Transform and Symmetry
- Seamless pattern projects
- All the built-in brushes and brush editing
- Smart shape detection
WHAT’S PRO?
- HD canvas sizes and tons of layers*
- Adjustments and live Filter layers
- Layer groups
- Layer masks
- Over 40 powerful, professional tools
* Maximum number of layers depends on the canvas size and your device
TAKE INFINITE PAINTER WITH YOU
See what you can do.

bluejetty:00014365:ios.description:
Welcome to krungsri app, the latest mobile banking service that simplifies all your financial needs. Whether you're looking to open a savings account, apply for loans, a credit card, or manage your mutual funds, krungsri app has got you covered. It is user-friendly, convenient, and more secure than ever, allowing you to effortlessly monitor your financial transactions and improve your money management.
You can apply immediately through the app and receive Krungsri GIFT for year-round discounts at various delicious food and drinks outlets when you use the app in accordance with the terms and conditions.
Manage all your finances with ease and convenience, now simpler than ever before
• Access the new Quick Menu on the home screen for fast and convenient shortcuts for Transfer, Pay Bill, Top Up and Scan 
• Stay up-to-date with the latest transactions, privileges, and news through easily accessible categorized notifications 
• Customize your home screen to your unique preference by managing widgets for Quick Balance, Favorites, and Quick Menu
• Change Background to fit your own personal lifestyle.
• Request an online statement that is available for up to the past 12 months
• Get all your needs fulfilled with features such as cardless withdrawal, managing favorites, scheduling transfers or bill payments, making international transfers, scanning for QR cross-border payments, and much more.
Your One-Stop Banking Solution
• Track your income and expenses visually through your new summary dashboard combining assets, loans and insurance

bluejetty:00179654:ios.description:
Sosta, trasporti, telepedaggio autostradale e oggi anche pagamenti e ricariche
MooneyGo è l’app gratuita con la più ampia offerta di servizi di mobilità in Italia: parcheggia sulle strisce blu e nei parcheggi in struttura, pianifica ogni giorno i tuoi spostamenti, acquista biglietti di mezzi pubblici e treni, muoviti con i servizi in sharing o in taxi, viaggia in autostrada senza code al casello e in sicurezza grazie al servizio di assistenza stradale, gestisci pagamenti e ricariche in modo sostenibile e veloce.
PAGAMENTI E RICARICHE (Novità)
- Paga il bollo auto, anche di targhe non registrate in app
- Paga bollettini e avvisi PagoPA
- Effettua ricariche telefoniche
TI SPOSTI IN AUTO?
- Paga la sosta su Strisce Blu in oltre 500 comuni italiani, terminandola in anticipo o prolungandola quando vuoi: paghi solo i minuti effettivi
- Prenota in anticipo il tuo posto in più di 450 parcheggi in struttura, presso aeroporti, stazioni, porti e in città
- Attiva il dispositivo di telepedaggio MooneyGo: potrai saltare le code al casello su tutte le autostrade italiane, pagare automaticamente Area C Milano, traghetti e oltre 380 parcheggi convenzionati, richiedere il servizio di Assistenza Stradale MooneyGo, attivo 24 ore su 24, direttamente dall’app.
UTILIZZI I MEZZI PUBBLICI?
- Acquista biglietti, carnet e abbonamenti per autobus e metro di oltre 140 compagnie di trasporto in tutta Italia, tra cui ATAC Roma, ATMA, TPL FVG, Autoguidovie e molte altre
- Compra biglietti del treno per Trenitalia (Regionali, Intercity, Frecce) e Italo
- Prenota o richiedi un taxi e paga direttamente dall’app
- Noleggia monopattini o bici elettriche per muoverti in modo veloce e sostenibile nelle principali città italiane, grazie alla mappa interattiva che ti mostra il mezzo più vicino
- Consulta orari, fermate e aggiornamenti in tempo reale di bus, metro e treni
- Confronta le diverse soluzioni di viaggio e scegli la combinazione di mezzi più comoda per arrivare a destinazione
MOONEYGO INCONTRA IL DIVERTIMENTO
- Acquista biglietti d’ingresso per musei, mostre, parchi acquatici, eventi e luoghi di interesse direttamente dall’app
- Pianifica e organizza i tuoi spostamenti per vivere al meglio ogni esperienza, in città o in viaggio
ASSISTENZA DEDICATA
Hai bisogno di supporto? Entra in app, vai nel Profilo e scopri come contattare l’assistenza.
Bollo auto, bollettini e pagoPA sono servizi erogati da Mooney S.p.A.

bluejetty:00134474:ios.summary: The Raptor® Alert mobile app is used with Raptor Technologies® newest emergency management solutions – Raptor Alert™, Raptor Reunification®, Raptor Accountability™ and Raptor Drill Manager®. Those who purchased Raptor Alert individually or
bluejetty:00134474:ios.description:
The Raptor® Alert mobile app is used with Raptor Technologies® newest emergency management solutions – Raptor Alert™, Raptor Reunification®, Raptor Accountability™ and Raptor Drill Manager®. Those who purchased Raptor Alert individually or with other Raptor Emergency Management solutions – should download this new Raptor Alert mobile app. Speak with your system administrator or Raptor support if you have questions. Raptor Emergency Management solutions include: 
RAPTOR ALERT™: Designed to work under duress, Raptor Alert is a silent panic alert system that works on the devices your schools use every day. Raptor Alert expedites and streamlines emergency response by allowing users to initiate an emergency alert directly through 911 and provide critical information to first responders, law enforcement and campus personnel.
RAPTOR CONNECT™: Raptor Connect enables native, bi-directional integration with a school’s existing digital security systems and peripherals. It streamlines a school’s digital emergency response activations, speeding notifications and minimizing the impact of the situation. 
RAPTOR DRILL MANAGER®: Raptor Drill Manager gives you the power to prepare your schools for any situation. Simplify federal and state-mandated drill compliance and management by scheduling, initiating, logging and tracking drills from any smart device. District-level and school-level reports show drill status and crucial insights to help schools improve with each drill. 
RAPTOR ACCOUNTABILITY™: Connected with your student information system, Raptor enables teachers and staff to account for themselves, students and visitors directly in the mobile app while providing real-time status and location information. 
RAPTOR REUNIFICATION®: Recovery starts when the crisis begins. Minimizing trauma is directly correlated to safe, efficient reunification. Raptor Reunification software includes a patented reunification workflow and is aligned with and officially licensed by The “I Love U Guys” Foundation®. With Raptor, your reunification team can quickly confirm the location and status of each student and staff member in the mobile app. Connected to your student information system, Raptor helps ensure students are reunified only with approved guardians.
Raptor Reunification includes Student Reunification®, Parent Reunification®, Guardian Reunification® and Family Reunification®.
Transforming School Safety Through Software.
Founded in 2002, Raptor Technologies has partnered with over 60,000 schools globally, including over 7,300 K-12 US school districts. Our team of safety software experts and our suite of industry-leading solutions provide schools with confidence in their safety and student wellbeing programs so they can focus on teaching. Driven by our shared mission to protect every child, every school, every day™, Raptor helps customers mitigate risks—from prevention and preparedness to reunifying families.
