bluejetty:00167551:ios.description:
Poop Log: Your Comprehensive Bowel Movement Tracker
Poop Log, is the ultimate bowel movement tracker designed to help you monitor and maintain your digestive health. The app offers a range of features that make tracking your bowel activity effortless and insightful. Whether you're managing a health condition, optimizing your diet, or simply curious about your digestive patterns, Poop Log is here to assist you every step of the way.
Why Track Your Bowel Movements?
Understanding your bowel habits can provide valuable insights into your overall health. Irregularities in bowel movements can be indicators of underlying health issues, dietary imbalances, or stress. By consistently tracking your bowel activity, you can identify patterns, make informed decisions about your health, and share detailed reports with healthcare professionals if needed.
Key Features of Poop Log:
Create a Bowel Log
With Poop Log, logging your bowel movements is quick and easy. Simply input details such as the date, time, type, and consistency of your bowel movements. You can also add notes, and pictures as well as any additional symptoms or factors that might have influenced your bowel activity.
View Historical Data
Keep track of your bowel movements over time with our comprehensive historical data feature. Easily access past entries and review patterns or changes in your bowel habits. This long-term tracking capability is essential for identifying trends and making informed decisions about your health and lifestyle.
View Statistics
Poop Log provides detailed statistics on your bowel activity. Analyze data such as the frequency, consistency, and time of day of your bowel movements. Our app generates easy-to-understand stats on your digestive health over time.
Export Reports
Need to share your bowel movement data with a healthcare provider? Poop Log makes it simple. Export detailed reports that include all your logged information and statistics. These reports can be invaluable for medical consultations, helping healthcare professionals understand your digestive health more comprehensively.
Get Notified
Stay on top of your bowel health with our notification feature. Poop Log will alert you if you haven’t had a bowel movement in a while, ensuring you’re aware of any potential irregularities. Timely notifications can prompt you to take action or seek medical advice if needed.
No Ads
We believe that your health tracking experience should be free from distractions. Poop Log offers an ad-free environment, allowing you to focus solely on your bowel health without interruptions.
Poop Log is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive. Logging your bowel movements takes just a few seconds, and accessing your data is straightforward. The app's clean interface ensures a smooth and hassle-free experience.
Take control of your digestive health with Poop Log. Download the app and start tracking your bowel movements effortlessly. With comprehensive features, detailed statistics, and an ad-free experience, Poop Log is your trusted companion for maintaining a healthy digestive system.
Thank you for choosing Poop Log. An app that is committed to helping you maintain and improve your digestive health through comprehensive tracking and insightful analysis. Start your journey to better bowel health today!
Contact Us
If you have any questions, feedback, or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at hussain@hussainmustafa.com. We're here to help you make the most out of Poop Log and support your journey to better digestive health.

Poop Log, is the ultimate bowel movement tracker designed to help you monitor and maintain your digestive health. The app offers a range of features that make tracking your bowel activity effortless and insightful. Whether you're managing a health condition, optimizing your diet, or simply curious about your digestive patterns, Poop Log is here to assist you every step of the way.

Why Track Your Bowel Movements?
Understanding your bowel habits can provide valuable insights into your overall health. Irregularities in bowel movements can be indicators of underlying health issues, dietary imbalances, or stress. By consistently tracking your bowel activity, you can identify patterns, make informed decisions about your health, and share detailed reports with healthcare professionals if needed.

Key Features of Poop Log:

Create a Bowel Log
With Poop Log, logging your bowel movements is quick and easy. Simply input details such as the date, time, type, and consistency of your bowel movements. You can also add notes, and pictures as well as any additional symptoms or factors that might have influenced your bowel activity.

View Historical Data
Keep track of your bowel movements over time with our comprehensive historical data feature. Easily access past entries and review patterns or changes in your bowel habits. This long-term tracking capability is essential for identifying trends and making informed decisions about your health and lifestyle.

View Statistics
Poop Log provides detailed statistics on your bowel activity. Analyze data such as the frequency, consistency, and time of day of your bowel movements. Our app generates easy-to-understand stats on your digestive health over time.

Export Reports
Need to share your bowel movement data with a healthcare provider? Poop Log makes it simple. Export detailed reports that include all your logged information and statistics. These reports can be invaluable for medical consultations, helping healthcare professionals understand your digestive health more comprehensively.

Get Notified
Stay on top of your bowel health with our notification feature. Poop Log will alert you if you haven’t had a bowel movement in a while, ensuring you’re aware of any potential irregularities. Timely notifications can prompt you to take action or seek medical advice if needed.

bluejetty:00062553:ios.description:
Are you a curious student eager to explore deeper into the physics world?
Are you a science enthusiast who wants to share your ideas with others?
Are you an adventurer bounded by textbook instructions and budget limits?
Are you a romantic dreaming of having your own customized galaxy?
Are you a teacher who wants to use fun and interactive demonstrations in your physics lessons?
Learn science by doing experiments in your virtual lab with Physics Lab. With our new AR mode, you can even bring your experiments to life!
In Physics Lab, you can play with various circuit components, build your own 3D electric circuits, and see how they work in real time. With 100+ circuit components to choose from (and more coming soon), the possibilities are endless. Plus, all of our experiments are backed by science and calculated with precise numbers, so you can learn and have fun at the same time.
Physics Lab is not only for students, but for teachers too! Use it to demonstrate experiments in class, and help your students learn and explore in a new way. And because it's virtual, you don't have to worry about expensive lab equipment or safety concerns.
Explore with freedom
- Pick from 100+ circuit components (more coming!)
- Drag them from the toolbox to the virtual desk and connect them the way you like
- All experiment results are backed by science and calculated in precise numbers
- Design your own galaxy or load from our solar system
- Electromagnetic experiments with field line visualization
Better than real life
- Set properties of circuit components to different figures and observe changes of behavior and stats in real time
- One-click to turn what you have built into an editable circuit diagram and vice versa
- No expenses on lab equipments, no worry about safety issues
A lab for everyone
- Teachers have been using Physics Lab to demonstrate experiments and assist teaching in class
- Students, in primary or high schools, can learn science and explore freely anywhere, anytime
- Kids or not, curious minds now have their own virtual lab to learn knowledge by doing experiments
Whether you're a teacher, student, or just someone who loves learning about physics, Physics Lab has something for everyone. Connect with us and let us know what you think, and check out our subscription options to access even more experiments and components. We can't wait to see what you create!
Email: turtlesim@u.northwestern.edu
===========================
Concerning Component Subscription
During your subscription period, you will have access to all paid components for free, including future ones.
1) Subscription periods are one month long and will be charged to your iTunes Account at the time of purchase.
2) Your subscription is linked to your Physics Lab account.
3) You will be charged for renewals 24 hours before the end of the current period, and will be notified of the cost.
4) You can manage your subscriptions at any time in your Account Settings.
5) By purchasing a subscription, you are agreeing to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
Terms of Use: https://static.turtlesim.com/products/Term-Of-Use.txt
Privacy Policy: https://static.turtlesim.com/products/Privacy-Policy.txt

bluejetty:00178044:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Impossible Date, where you can find solutions for helpless lovers!
Impossible Date is a riddle game in which you try to solve the troubles in male-female relations by completing the puzzles you encounter. This new fun game gives you the chance to solve new challenges of brain teasers!
All the riddles will challenge your attention and improve your thinking skills! You will see each level has a scenario that you will need to use your brain to solve all problems between the lovers. Only the smartest people will be able to solve these IQ tests! 
Impossible Date has various brain teasers, puzzles, IQ tests and mind games where you can solve the issues between couples. To solve these riddles, you need to brainstorm and think well! If you act wisely, you can quickly move to the next level and improve your intelligence!
Impossible Date is a simple and fluid game where you can use drawing, erasing, tapping, swiping, clicking, dragging, x-ray options. In this game, you can correct misunderstandings between couples and save couples' relationships, introduce the love of his life to the man who always lost his chance in love and you can make famous people into a couple! 
You have to find solutions for all the seemingly impossible dates and ensure that the couples reach their happy ending. While accomplishing this goal, you will encounter riddles full of challenging obstacles, and you will find yourself in challenges to complete puzzles, brain teasers, thinking games and IQ tests.
You have to find the clues hidden inside the game and solve the riddles faster. As you get faster, the difficulty of the challenges will increase and you will improve your brain. You should continue to improve your way of thinking by playing thinking games!
Feature of the Game:
- Simple to learn and fun to play!
- Hundreds of puzzles and IQ tests to solve!
- Relax, find missing clues and solve all puzzles!
- Challenging mind games full of various obstacles!
- Improve your thinking skills by playing thinking games!
- Quick thinking and smart moves in various tricky riddles!
- Challenge your brain with thousands of fun brain teasers!
You can keep the couple together or break them up. Their fate is in your hands! The choice is yours! Test your brain's limits! 
If you want them to live a happy life together, help them out!
Enjoy the Impossible Date! 
This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.
Privacy Policy: https://pofudukgames.com/privacy-policy

Key features:
- Choose from different exams
- Practice with 2000+ questions written by recruited instructors and expert tutors
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
***

bluejetty:00178825:ios.description:
Welcome Archer Heroes, to the magic world of Idle Archer - Tower Defense!
As a Lone Archer, you swore to protect the kingdom against vicious monsters summoned by the evil dark lord. Defend your tower, upgrade your archer, defeat waves of evil and once you are defeated, come back stronger!
Idle Archer is an incremental idle tower defense game where you take the role of an archer defending his tower against waves of monsters. Defeat is a crucial part of the game, collect loot, cards, upgrade your tower and archer and try again!
==== Game Features ====
- Addicting and simple tower defense gameplay
- Idle game with strategy and RPG elements
- Invest valuable gold to permanently upgrade your archer
- Collect unique and powerful skill cards that offer different play styles
- Fight waves of evil monsters and defeat bosses
- As in every strategy game, put your strategic thinking to the test
Defend your tower and remember, once you die, use what you have learned and fight again! Will you be the chosen Archer in this new idle game?
This is the tower game you want to download and the best tower RPG game to play on mobile. Tower defense and tower games have never been more fun and full of RPG action!
Be an archer hero as you battle the evil monsters from your Tower as they hunt you down in a battle royale of good versus evil. It’s TD at its RPG best - can you be king or queen of this royale game. Don’t rush though, learn from your tower defense defeats and collect loot and money and gold to upgrade your tower defense and get ready for some more RPG battle action.
You could go from arch hero to arch zero in a moment, but play again and don’t give up your tower. The tower is yours to upgrade and defend in RPG battle action. They will try to hunt you down in a battle royale, but don’t let them get you down. Don’t idle though, you’re in a rush in this tower defense RPG action battle game, so keep fighting and upgrading your archer.
This is your kingdom, so defend it with all your might against evil monsters. Upgrade your cards when you can use loot and gold and your tower will be ready for RPG battle action. It’s a tower defense game (or is that tower defence…never know!), and in this incremental idle archer game, it’s non-stop RPG action, battle action, you’re in the hunt and you’re in a rush to save your tower. Don’t be an idle archer but an action archer so the evil monsters can’t win the battle. You can do it!!

bluejetty:00140717:ios.description:
About this game
Visit Sunny City; merge, restore and design while you solve a fiery mystery.
Welcome to County Story
Follow Ileana Johnson as her picture perfect life in Sunny City crumbles around her. Run away from wedding, sabotage and secrets. Help answer the question everyone's thinking: Who's trying to ruin her life? Merge flavorful dishes, restore and decorate Ileana's restaurant and watch the mystery unfold. But what will happen?
Whip Up Tasty Dishes
Serve coffee, sandwiches, seafood, and a range of other dishes, to your customers. The more you play, the more dishes you'll find to add to your menu!
Restore the Restaurant
Rebuild and design the best county restaurant around! Choose the flooring, wallpaper and furniture to restore restaurant to its former glory!
Build Relationships
Converse with customers and hang out with old friends. Or explore the possibility of a new budding romance.
Catch up on the Gossip
You'll renovate and merge to reveal clues, and uncover hidden secrets of the residents of Sunny City. And perhaps even unveil the Johnson's hidden secrets...
If you have any questions, please contact us by sending an email to mwledk042@gmail.com 
We would be more than happy to assist you. 
Privacy Policy: http://www.xfunwork.com/website-cfg/policy

bluejetty:00069106:ios.description:
From the team behind WatchMaker, the world’s largest watch face community, widgetopia gives you everything you need to make your Home Screen and Lock Screen feel like your own.
100,000+ WIDGETS
Explore a huge library of widgets created by our community, with new designs added every day. Find clocks, weather, calendars, photos, fitness, quotes, anime, aesthetic designs and much more.
MAKE IT YOURS
Found something you like? Remix it. Or start from scratch and design your own with powerful tools for layers, fonts, colours, gradients, charts, formulas and live data.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Weather — current, hourly and daily
• Calendars and agendas
• Photos and animated GIFs
• Steps, Activity rings and heart rate with Apple Health
• Battery, time, date and analog or digital clocks
• Countdowns, moon phases, progress bars and charts
• 70+ widget themes
• Transparent widgets
• 5,000+ icons and complete icon packs
• Wallpapers for Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Custom JSON endpoints and JavaScript expressions
• Import and share widgets
FREE TO USE
widgetopia is free to use, including the full design tools.
Some widgets are marked PLUS. You can unlock them individually by watching a short video, or unlock everything with widgetopia+ and remove ads.
widgetopia+
• Weekly: $3.99 USD
• Yearly: $19.99 USD
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID settings. Prices may vary by country and are charged in your local currency.
Requires iOS 18 or later.
Privacy Policy: https://widgetopia.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://widgetopia.io/terms
OPTIONAL PERMISSIONS
widgetopia only asks for access when a widget needs it:
• Location — weather for where you are
• Calendar — show your events on widgets
• Apple Health — steps, Activity rings and heart rate on widgets you choose
• Photos — save wallpapers to your library
• Notifications — new widgets and tips

bluejetty:00016366:ios.description:
Get set to experience F1® like never before, with the F1 TV app. Watch every race, stream every session, and access every last bit of race data. Available on your favourite devices. And you can watch it live or on-demand, from wherever you want. 
It gets even better with our latest immersive innovation: F1 TV Premium. Build a custom multi-feed live race view with Multi View, watch everything in 4K UHD/HDR on a large screen, and stream on up to 6 devices at once. It's the ultimate way to experience the race, and it's all right here. 
F1 TV PREMIUM: ULTIMATE F1 LIVE IMMERSION
Get the Race Director’s view with Multi View for every session, all live in 4K HDR.
• Multi View – build your custom multi-feed view
• Watch F1 live in 4K UHD/ HDR on your large screen
• Multiple devices – watch live on up to 6 devices simultaneously
• + Official live stream
• + Essential live timing
F1 TV PRO: OFFICIAL F1 LIVE STREAM
Get the Team Principal’s view with onboards, live team radio and every session live and on demand, ad-free.
• Stream all F1 sessions live and on demand.
• Live onboard cameras and Live team radio
• Live access to F2, F3, F1 Academy and Porsche Supercup
• Exclusive race weekend shows and content
• + Essential live timing
F1 TV ACCESS: ESSENTIAL LIVE TIMING
Get the Strategist’s view, with live timings, live telemetry, race replays. and the best of team radio.
• Live timings, telemetry, tyre usage and driver maps.
• Delayed race replays
• Best of team radio recaps
• Exclusive shows, documentaries and race archives
For help with F1 TV, please visit: https://support.f1.tv/s/?language=en_US
Terms of use: https://account.formula1.com/#/en/f1-apps-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00086440:ios.name: PERFUMIST Perfumes Advisor
bluejetty:00086440:ios.summary:
PERFUMIST was made to help you find the perfect match in just a few clicks!
PERFUMIST is the number one mobile app designed to rank a selection of the perfumes you are most likely to love with an ever-growing database of over 50k perfumes
bluejetty:00086440:ios.description:
PERFUMIST was made to help you find the perfect match in just a few clicks!
PERFUMIST is the number one mobile app designed to rank a selection of the perfumes you are most likely to love with an ever-growing database of over 50k perfumes from nearly 2000 different brands.
We aim to gather information on every perfume in the world, from extremely rare niche brands to major bestsellers.
Anywhere, anytime, PERFUMIST is the perfect tool to help you discover the right perfumes. It gives you the ability to : 
Browse our huge perfumes database, learn about their olfactory description.
Create your own olfactory profile and discover a bespoke selection of fragrances
Search by notes, brands, new products or barcodes
Add perfumes to your lists : Favorite / I like / I dislike / Gift / To try / Other lists
Discover perfumes recommendations with similar scents 
Filter suggestions to the assortment of a store.
Share your favorite perfumes with your community and friends
Using PERFUMIST you join the largest community of perfume enthusiasts in the world! You can browse your friends profile or follow people around the world.
We believe that everybody should have access to the best possible information when it comes to choosing or trying new perfumes.
We believe scent should be the main reason for choosing a perfume.
We also aim to educate consumers by bringing them the best perfumes standards.
---
OUR MISSION
Bring more people to perfumes and more perfumes to people .
---
OUR TEAM
We are passionate people on a mission.
We are 100% independent and cross-cultural.
We do not belong to any brand or retailer.
We do not sell but only give impartial advice.
---
PERFUMIST is made for and by the users.
If you have any comments or possible improvement, please write to us by mail via PERFUMIST app under CONTACT US.
For professional inquiries : contact@perfumist.fr

gnome-extensions:serenity-desktop@sisujs.name: Serenity Desktop
gnome-extensions:serenity-desktop@sisujs.summary:
A Per-Monitor-Workspace window manager designed for productive use. It offers two main features:
 - Per-monitor workspaces: Compatible with both static and dynamic workspaces.
 - Application/Window shortcuts: Assign shortcuts to windows and bring the workspace containing the window into view, regardless of its location. apple-macos:6800796689.name: When to Post: Boost Your Reach
apple-macos:6800796689.description:
Know the best time to post on social media, anywhere in the world.
When to Post instantly tells you whether now is a peak posting window for your audience, even if they're in a different timezone.
A single colored dot gives you the answer at a glance. Green means a peak posting window is happening right now. Orange means it isn't, and the app tells you exactly what's next: "Ends in 18m", "Today 9PM", or "Tomorrow 3AM".
-- SEVEN SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS
See the best posting times for:
• Facebook
• Instagram
• LinkedIn
• TikTok
• X
• YouTube
• YouTube Shorts
Each platform includes its own weekly schedule based on peak engagement times. Hide the platforms you don't use to keep the menu clean and focused.
-- BUILT AROUND YOUR AUDIENCE, NOT YOUR CLOCK
The best time to post depends on where your audience is, not where you are.
Choose your audience's location once, and every posting window is automatically converted to your local time. Search by city, country, timezone, or GMT.
Whether you're posting from Paris for New York, Sydney for London, or Tokyo for Los Angeles, the app does the timezone math for you.
-- WIDGETS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Keep the next posting window on your phone (directly on your lock and apps screens) with small and medium widgets.
Prefer not to keep checking? Get notified the moment a peak window begins.
-- RESEARCH-BASED RECOMMENDATIONS
Posting windows are based on published engagement research across billions of social media posts. Studies identify the strongest hours and weekdays for each platform using the audience's local timezone.
These are population averages, not guarantees. Every audience is different, so use the suggested windows as a starting point and refine them with your own analytics over time.
-- PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign in. No tracking.
Everything ships inside the app, works completely offline, and never sends your data anywhere.

fdroid:com.kapoue.hemera.name: Héméra
fdroid:com.kapoue.hemera.summary: Keeps the screen on for a chosen time, and adjusts the brightness
fdroid:com.kapoue.hemera.description:
Héméra has two functions, one tab each.
Time: keeps the screen on for the time you choose, then hands back to the phone's own sleep delay.
* Default: the phone decides, as usual
* 30 min or 1 h
* Custom: from 5 min to 12 h, remembered for next time
* Endless: until it is stopped
Light: adjusts the brightness, right in the app or with an optional slider on the edge of the screen, over other apps.
* Edge slider: 13 positions, adjustable size, color and visibility, long press for automatic brightness
* Calibration to match the phone's own brightness slider (each manufacturer uses its own curve)
Also:
* Two quick settings tiles: cycle through the modes, show or hide the edge slider
* Shortcuts on the app icon for each mode
* Notification with the time left, the end time and a Stop button
* Available in English and French
It is named after Hemera, the Greek goddess of day, who drives the night away: the longer the mode, the brighter the day on screen.
How it works: Héméra never changes the sleep delay. It places an invisible 1-pixel window that keeps the screen on: if the app stops, the phone goes back to normal on its own. Locking the phone stops the mode.
Permissions: display over other apps (to keep the screen on and show the edge slider), modify system settings (brightness only), notifications, run at startup (to show the edge slider again if it is on; a mode never restarts on its own).
Free and open source: no account, no ads, no trackers, no Internet access.
